verses.fr: Maaca, femme de Makir, enfanta un fils, et l''appela du nom de Péresch; le nom de son frère était Schéresch, et ses fils étaient Ulam et Rékem.
verses.am: የማኪርም ሚስት መዓካ ልጅ ወለደች፥ ስሙንም ፋሬስ ብላ ጠራችው፤ የወንድሙም ስም ሱሮስ ነበረ፤ ልጆቹም ኡላም፥ ራቄም ነበሩ።

verses.en: And the sons of Ulam; Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.
verses.fr: Fils d''Ulam: Bedan. Ce sont là les fils de Galaad, fils de Makir, fils de Manassé.
verses.am: የኡላምም ልጅ ባዳን ነበረ፤ እነዚህ የምናሴ ልጅ የማኪር ልጅ የገለዓድ ልጆች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And his sister Hammoleketh bare Ishod, and Abiezer, and Mahalah.
verses.fr: Sa soeur Hammoléketh enfanta Ischhod, Abiézer et Machla.
verses.am: እኅቱ መለኬት ኢሱድን፥ አቢዔዝርን፥ መሕላን ወለደች።

verses.en: And the sons of Shemidah were, Ahian, and Shechem, and Likhi, and Aniam.
verses.fr: Les fils de Schemida étaient: Achjan, Sichem, Likchi et Aniam.
verses.am: የሸሚዳም ልጆች አሒያን፥ ሴኬም፥ ሊቅሒ፥ አኒዓም ነበሩ።

verses.en: And the sons of Ephraim; Shuthelah, and Bered his son, and Tahath his son, and Eladah his son, and Tahath his son,
verses.fr: Fils d''Ephraïm: Schutélach; Béred, son fils; Thachath, son fils; Eleada, son fils; Thachath, son fils;
verses.am: የኤፍሬም ልጆች፤ ሹቱላ፥ ልጁ ባሬድ፥ ልጁ ታሐት፥ ልጁ ኤልዓዳ፥ ልጁ ታሐት፥ ልጁ ዛባድ፥ ልጁ ሽቱላ፥

verses.en: And Zabad his son, and Shuthelah his son, and Ezer, and Elead, whom the men of Gath that were born in that land slew, because they came down to take away their cattle.
verses.fr: Zabad, son fils; Schutélach, son fils; Ezer et Elead. Les hommes de Gath, nés dans le pays, les tuèrent, parce qu''ils étaient descendus pour prendre leurs troupeaux.
verses.am: የአገሩም ተወላጆች የጌት ሰዎች ከብቶቻቸውን ሊወስዱ ወርደው ነበርና የገደሉአቸው ልጆቹ ኤድርና ኤልዓድ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brethren came to comfort him.
verses.fr: Ephraïm, leur père, fut longtemps dans le deuil, et ses frères vinrent pour le consoler.
verses.am: አባታቸውም ኤፍሬም ብዙ ቀን አለቀሰ፥ ወንድሞቹም ሊያጽናኑት መጡ።

verses.en: And when he went in to his wife, she conceived, and bare a son, and he called his name Beriah, because it went evil with his house.
verses.fr: Puis il alla vers sa femme, et elle conçut et enfanta un fils; il l''appela du nom de Beria, parce que le malheur était dans sa maison.
verses.am: ወደ ሚስቱም ገባ፥ አረገዘችም፥ ወንድ ልጅም ወለደች፤ በቤቱም መከራ ሆኖአልና ስሙ በሪዓ ብሎ ጠራው።

verses.en: (And his daughter was Sherah, who built Bethhoron the nether, and the upper, and Uzzensherah.)
verses.fr: Il eut pour fille Schééra, qui bâtit Beth-Horon la basse et Beth-Horon la haute, et Uzzen-Schééra.
verses.am: ሴት ልጁም ታችኛውንና ላይኛውን ቤትሖሮንንና ኡዜንሼራን የሠራች ሲአራ ነበረች።

verses.en: And Rephah was his son, also Resheph, and Telah his son, and Tahan his son.
verses.fr: Réphach, son fils, et Réscheph; Thélach, son fils; Thachan, son fils;
verses.am: ወንዶች ልጆቹም ፋፌ፥ ሬሴፍ፥ ልጁ ቴላ፥

verses.en: Laadan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son.
verses.fr: Laedan, son fils; Ammihud, son fils; Elischama, son fils;
verses.am: ልጁ ታሐን፥ ልጁ ለአዳን፥ ልጁ ዓሚሁድ፥ ልጁ ኤሊሳማ፥

verses.en: Non his son, Jehoshuah his son.
verses.fr: Nun, son fils; Josué, son fils.
verses.am: ልጁ ነዌ፥ ልጁ ኢያሱ።

verses.en: And their possessions and habitations were, Bethel and the towns thereof, and eastward Naaran, and westward Gezer, with the towns thereof; Shechem also and the towns thereof, unto Gaza and the towns thereof:
verses.fr: Ils avaient en propriété et pour habitations Béthel et les villes de son ressort; à l''orient, Naaran; à l''occident, Guézer et les villes de son ressort, Sichem et les villes de son ressort, jusqu''à Gaza et aux villes de son ressort.
verses.am: ግዛታቸውና ማደሪያቸው ቤቴልና መንደሮችዋ፥ በምሥራቅም በኩል ነዓራን፥ በምዕራብም በኩል ጌዝርና መንደሮችዋ፥ ደግሞ ሴኬምና መንደሮችዋ እስከ ጋዛና እስከ መንደሮችዋ ድረስ፥

verses.en: And by the borders of the children of Manasseh, Bethshean and her towns, Taanach and her towns, Megiddo and her towns, Dor and her towns. In these dwelt the children of Joseph the son of Israel.
verses.fr: Les fils de Manassé possédaient Beth-Schean et les villes de son ressort, Thaanac et les villes de son ressort, Meguiddo et les villes de son ressort, Dor et les villes de son ressort. Ce fut dans ces villes qu''habitèrent les fils de Joseph, fils d''Israël.
verses.am: በምናሴም ልጆች ዳርቻ ቤትሳንና መንደሮችዋ፥ ታዕናክና መንደሮችዋ፥ መጊዶና መንደሮችዋ፥ ዶርና መንደሮችዋ ነበሩ፤ በእነዚህ የእስራኤል ልጅ የዮሴፍ ልጆች ተቀመጡ።

verses.en: The sons of Asher; Imnah, and Isuah, and Ishuai, and Beriah, and Serah their sister.
verses.fr: Fils d''Aser: Jimna, Jischva, Jischvi et Beria; et Sérach, leur soeur.
verses.am: የአሴር ልጆች ዪምና፥ የሱዋ፥ የሱዊ፥ በሪዓ፥ እኅታቸውም ሤራሕ።

verses.en: And the sons of Beriah; Heber, and Malchiel, who is the father of Birzavith.
verses.fr: Fils de Beria: Héber et Malkiel. Malkiel fut père de Birzavith.
verses.am: የበሪዓም ልጆች፤ ሔቤር፥ የቢርዛዊት አባት የነበረው መልኪኤል።

verses.en: And Heber begat Japhlet, and Shomer, and Hotham, and Shua their sister.
verses.fr: Et Héber engendra Japhleth, Schomer et Hotham, et Schua, leur soeur. -
verses.am: ሔቤርም ያፍሌጥን፥ ሳሜንር፥ ኮታምን፥ እኅታቸውንም ሶላን ወለደ።

verses.en: And the sons of Japhlet; Pasach, and Bimhal, and Ashvath. These are the children of Japhlet.
verses.fr: Fils de Japhleth: Pasac, Bimhal et Aschvath. Ce sont là les fils de Japhleth. -
verses.am: የያፍሌጥም ልጆች ፋሴክ፥ ቢምሃል፥ ዓሲት ነበሩ፤ እነዚህ የያፍሌጥ ልጆች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And the sons of Shamer; Ahi, and Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram.
verses.fr: Fils de Schamer: Achi, Rohega, Hubba et Aram. -
verses.am: የሳሜርም ልጆች አኪ፥ ሮኦጋ፥ ይሑባ፥ አራም ነበሩ።

verses.en: And the sons of his brother Helem; Zophah, and Imna, and Shelesh, and Amal.
verses.fr: Fils d''Hélem, son frère: Tsophach, Jimna, Schélesch et Amal.
verses.am: የወንድሙም የኤላም ልጆች ጾፋ፥ ይምና፥ ሰሌስ፥ ዓማል ነበሩ።

verses.en: The sons of Zophah; Suah, and Harnepher, and Shual, and Beri, and Imrah,
verses.fr: Fils de Tsophach: Suach, Harnépher, Schual, Béri, Jimra,
verses.am: የጾፋም ልጆች ሱዋ፥ ሐርኔፍር፥

verses.en: Bezer, and Hod, and Shamma, and Shilshah, and Ithran, and Beera.
verses.fr: Betser, Hod, Schamma, Schilscha, Jithran et Beéra.
verses.am: ሦጋል፥ ቤሪ፥ ይምራ፥ ቤጼር፥ ሆድ፥ ሳማ፥ ሰሊሳ፥ ይትራን፥ ብኤራ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And the sons of Jether; Jephunneh, and Pispah, and Ara.
verses.fr: Fils de Jéther: Jephunné, Pispa et Ara.
verses.am: የዬቴር ልጆች ዮሮኒ፥ ፊስጳ፥ አራ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And the sons of Ulla; Arah, and Haniel, and Rezia.
verses.fr: Fils d''Ulla: Arach, Hanniel et Ritsja. -
verses.am: የዑላ ልጆች ኤራ፥ ሐኒኤል፥ ሪጽያ ነበሩ።

verses.en: All these were the children of Asher, heads of their father's house, choice and mighty men of valour, chief of the princes. And the number throughout the genealogy of them that were apt to the war and to battle was twenty and six thousand men.
verses.fr: Tous ceux-là étaient fils d''Aser, chefs des maisons de leurs pères, hommes d''élite et vaillants, chefs des princes, enregistrés au nombre de vingt-six mille hommes, en état de porter les armes et d''aller à la guerre.
verses.am: እነዚህ ሁሉ የአሴር ልጆች፥ የአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች አለቆች፥ የተመረጡ ጽኑዓን ኃያላን ሰዎች፥ የመኳንንቱ አለቆች ነበሩ። በትውልዳቸውም በሰልፍ ለመዋጋት የተቈጠሩ ሀያ ስድስት ሺህ ሰዎች ነበሩ።

verses.en: Now Benjamin begat Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second, and Aharah the third,
verses.fr: Benjamin engendra Béla, son premier-né, Aschbel le second, Achrach le troisième,
verses.am: ብንያምም በኵሩን ቤላን፥ ሁለተኛውንም አስቤልን፥

verses.en: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.
verses.fr: Nocha le quatrième, et Rapha le cinquième.
verses.am: ሦስተኛውንም አሐራን፥ አራተኛውንም ኖሐን፥ አምስተኛውንም ራፋን ወለደ።

verses.en: And the sons of Bela were, Addar, and Gera, and Abihud,
verses.fr: Les fils de Béla furent: Addar, Guéra, Abihud,
verses.am: ለቤላም ልጆች ነበሩት፤ አዳር፥

verses.en: And Abishua, and Naaman, and Ahoah,
verses.fr: Abischua, Naaman, Achoach,
verses.am: ጌራ፥ አቢሁድ፥ አቢሱ፥ ናዕማን፥ አሖዋ፥ ጌራ፥ ሰፉፋም፥ ሑራም።

verses.en: And Gera, and Shephuphan, and Huram.
verses.fr: Guéra, Schephuphan et Huram.
verses.am: እነዚህም የኤሁድ ልጆች ናቸው፤ እነዚህ በጌባ የሚቀመጡ የአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች አለቆች ናቸው፤

verses.en: And these are the sons of Ehud: these are the heads of the fathers of the inhabitants of Geba, and they removed them to Manahath:
verses.fr: Voici les fils d''Echud, qui étaient chefs de famille parmi les habitants de Guéba, et qui les transportèrent à Manachath:
verses.am: እነዚህም የኤሁድ ልጆች ናቸው፤ እነዚህ በጌባ የሚቀመጡ የአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች አለቆች ናቸው፤

verses.en: And Naaman, and Ahiah, and Gera, he removed them, and begat Uzza, and Ahihud.
verses.fr: Naaman, Achija et Guéra. Guéra, qui les transporta, engendra Uzza et Achichud.
verses.am: ወደ መናሐትም ተማረኩ፤ ናዕማን፥ አኪያ፥ ጌራ፥ እነርሱም ተማረኩ። ዖዛንና አሒሑድን ወለደ።

verses.en: And Shaharaim begat children in the country of Moab, after he had sent them away; Hushim and Baara were his wives.
verses.fr: Schacharaïm eut des enfants au pays de Moab, après qu''il eut renvoyé Huschim et Baara, ses femmes.
verses.am: ሸሐራይምም ሚስቶቹን ሑሺምንና በዕራን ከሰደደ በኋላ በሞዓብ ሜዳ ልጆች ወለደ።

verses.en: And he begat of Hodesh his wife, Jobab, and Zibia, and Mesha, and Malcham,
verses.fr: Il eut de Hodesch, sa femme: Jobab, Tsibja, Méscha, Malcam,
verses.am: ከሚስቱ ከሖዴሽ ዮባብን፥

verses.en: And Jeuz, and Shachia, and Mirma. These were his sons, heads of the fathers.
verses.fr: Jeuts, Schocja et Mirma. Ce sont là ses fils, chefs de famille.
verses.am: ዲብያን፥ ማሴን፥ ማልካምን፥ ይዑጽን፥ ሻክያን፥ ሚርማን ወለደ። እነዚህም ልጆች የአባቶች ቤቶች አለቆች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And of Hushim he begat Abitub, and Elpaal.
verses.fr: Il eut de Huschim: Abithub et Elpaal.
verses.am: ከሑሺምም አቢጡብንና ኤልፍዓልን ወለደ።

verses.en: The sons of Elpaal; Eber, and Misham, and Shamed, who built Ono, and Lod, with the towns thereof:
verses.fr: Fils d''Elpaal: Eber, Mischeam, et Schémer, qui bâtit Ono, Lod et les villes de son ressort.
verses.am: የኤልፍዓልም ልጆች፤ ዔቤር፥ ሚሻም፥ ኦኖንና ሎድን መንደሮቻቸውንም የሠራ ሻሚድ፤

verses.en: Beriah also, and Shema, who were heads of the fathers of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who drove away the inhabitants of Gath:
verses.fr: Beria et Schéma, qui étaient chefs de famille parmi les habitants d''Ajalon, mirent en fuite les habitants de Gath.
verses.am: በሪዓ፥ ሽማዕ የጌትን ሰዎች ያሳደዱ የኤሎን ሰዎች የአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች አለቆች ነበሩ፤

verses.en: And Ahio, Shashak, and Jeremoth,
verses.fr: Achjo, Schaschak, Jerémoth,
verses.am: አሒዮ፥ ሻሻቅ፥ ይሬምት፥

verses.en: And Zebadiah, and Arad, and Ader,
verses.fr: Zebadja, Arad, Eder,
verses.am: ዝባድያ፥ ሜሱላም፥

verses.en: And Michael, and Ispah, and Joha, the sons of Beriah;
verses.fr: Micaël, Jischpha et Jocha étaient fils de Beria. -
verses.am: ዝባድያ፥ ሜሱላም፥

verses.en: And Zebadiah, and Meshullam, and Hezeki, and Heber,
verses.fr: Zebadja, Meschullam, Hizki, Héber,
verses.am: ሕዝቂ፥ ሔቤር፥ ይሽምራይ፥ ይዝሊያ፥ ዮባብ፥ የኤልፍዓል ልጆች፤

verses.en: Ishmerai also, and Jezliah, and Jobab, the sons of Elpaal;
verses.fr: Jischmeraï, Jizlia et Jobab étaient fils d''Elpaal. -
verses.am: ያቂም፥ ዝክሪ፥ ዘብዲ፥

verses.en: And Jakim, and Zichri, and Zabdi,
verses.fr: Jakim, Zicri, Zabdi,
verses.am: ይሽጳን፥

verses.en: And Elienai, and Zilthai, and Eliel,
verses.fr: Eliénaï, Tsilthaï, Eliel,
verses.am: ይሽጳን፥

verses.en: And Adaiah, and Beraiah, and Shimrath, the sons of Shimhi;
verses.fr: Adaja, Beraja et Schimrath étaient fils de Schimeï. -
verses.am: ዔቤር፥ ኤሊኤል፥ ዓብዶን፥ ዝክሪ፥

verses.en: And Ishpan, and Heber, and Eliel,
verses.fr: Jischpan, Eber, Eliel,
verses.am: ሸምሽራይ፥

verses.en: And Abdon, and Zichri, and Hanan,
verses.fr: Abdon, Zicri, Hanan,
verses.am: ሸምሽራይ፥

verses.en: And Hananiah, and Elam, and Antothijah,
verses.fr: Hanania, Elam, Anthothija,
verses.am: ሸሃሪያ፥ ጎቶልያ፥ ያሬሽያ፥ ኤልያስ፥ ዝክሪ፥ የይሮሐም ልጆች።

verses.en: And Iphedeiah, and Penuel, the sons of Shashak;
verses.fr: Jiphdeja et Penuel étaient fils de Schaschak. -
verses.am: እነዚህ በትውልዶቻቸው አለቆች ነበሩ፤ የአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች አለቆች ነበሩ፤ እነዚህ በኢየሩሳሌም ተቀመጡ።

verses.en: And Shamsherai, and Shehariah, and Athaliah,
verses.fr: Schamscheraï, Schecharia, Athalia,
verses.am: የሚስቱ ስም መዓካ የነበረው የገባዖን አባት ይዒኤል፥

verses.en: And Jaresiah, and Eliah, and Zichri, the sons of Jeroham.
verses.fr: Jaaréschia, Elija et Zicri étaient fils de Jerocham. -
verses.am: የበኵር ልጁ ዓብዶን፥

verses.en: These were heads of the fathers, by their generations, chief men. These dwelt in Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Ce sont là des chefs de famille, chefs selon leurs générations. Ils habitaient à Jérusalem.
verses.am: ዱር፥ ቂስ፥ በኣል፥ ናዳብ፥ ጌዶር፥ አሒዮ፥ ዛኩር በገባዖን ተቀመጡ።

verses.en: And at Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon; whose wife's name was Maachah:
verses.fr: Le père de Gabaon habitait à Gabaon, et le nom de sa femme était Maaca.
verses.am: ሚቅሎት ሳምአን ወለደ፤ እነርሱ ደግሞ ከወንድሞቻቸው ጋር በኢየሩሳሌም በወንድሞቻቸው ፊት ለፊት ተቀመጡ።

verses.en: And his firstborn son Abdon, and Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Nadab,
verses.fr: Abdon, son fils premier-né, puis Tsur, Kis, Baal, Nadab,
verses.am: ኔር ቂስን ወለደ፤ ቂስም ሳኦልን ወለደ፤ ሳኦልም ዮናታንን፥ ሚልኪሳን፥ አሚናዳብን፥ አስባኣልን ወለደ።

verses.en: And Gedor, and Ahio, and Zacher.
verses.fr: Guedor, Achjo, et Zéker.
verses.am: የዮናታንም ልጅ መሪበኣል ነበረ፤ መሪበኣልም ሚካን ወለደ።

verses.en: And Mikloth begat Shimeah. And these also dwelt with their brethren in Jerusalem, over against them.
verses.fr: Mikloth engendra Schimea. Ils habitaient aussi à Jérusalem près de leurs frères, avec leurs frères. -
verses.am: የሚካም ልጆች ፒቶን፥ ሜሌክ፥ ታሬዓ፥ አካዝ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And Ner begat Kish, and Kish begat Saul, and Saul begat Jonathan, and Malchishua, and Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
verses.fr: Ner engendra Kis; Kis engendra Saül; Saül engendra Jonathan, Malki-Schua, Abinadab et Eschbaal.
verses.am: አካዝም ይሆዓዳን ወለደ፤ ይሆዓዳም ዓሌሜትን፥ ዓዝሞትን፥ ዘምሪን ወለደ፤ ዘምሪም ሞጻን ወለደ።

verses.en: And the son of Jonathan was Meribbaal; and Meribbaal begat Micah.
verses.fr: Fils de Jonathan: Merib-Baal. Merib-Baal engendra Michée.
verses.am: ሞጻም ቢንዓን ወለደ፤ ልጁም ረፋያ ነበረ፥ ልጁ ኤልዓሣ፥ ልጁ ኤሴል፤

verses.en: And the sons of Micah were, Pithon, and Melech, and Tarea, and Ahaz.
verses.fr: Fils de Michée: Pithon, Mélec, Thaeréa et Achaz.
verses.am: ለኤሴልም ስድስት ልጆች ነበሩት፤ ስማቸውም ይህ ነበረ፤ ዓዝሪቃም፥ ቦክሩ፥ እስማኤል፥ ሽዓርያ፥ አብድዩ፥ ሐናን፤ እነዚህ ሁሉ የኤሴል ልጆች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And Ahaz begat Jehoadah; and Jehoadah begat Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begat Moza,
verses.fr: Achaz engendra Jehoadda; Jehoadda engendra Alémeth, Azmaveth et Zimri; Zimri engendra Motsa;
verses.am: የወንድሙም የአሴል ልጆች፤ በኵሩ ኡላም፥ ሁለተኛውም ኢያስ፥ ሦስተኛውም ኤሊፋላት።

verses.en: And Moza begat Binea: Rapha was his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son:
verses.fr: Motsa engendra Binea. Rapha, son fils; Eleasa, son fils; Atsel, son fils;
verses.am: የኡላም ልጆች ጽኑዓን ኃያላንና ቀስተኞች ነበሩ፤ ለእነርሱም መቶ አምሳ የሚያህሉ ብዙ ልጆችና የልጅ ልጆች ነበሩአቸው፤ እነዚህ ሁሉ የብንያም ልጆች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And Azel had six sons, whose names are these, Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.
verses.fr: Atsel eut six fils, dont voici les noms: Azrikam, Bocru, Ismaël, Schearia, Abdias et Hanan. Tous ceux-là étaient fils d''Atsel. -
verses.am: ፤ ለኤሴልም ስድስት ልጆች ነበሩት፤ ስማቸውም ይህ ነበረ፤ ዓዝሪቃም፥ ቦክሩ፥ እስማኤል፥ ሽዓርያ፥ አብድዩ፥ ሐናን፤ እነዚህ ሁሉ የኤሴል ልጆች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And the sons of Eshek his brother were, Ulam his firstborn, Jehush the second, and Eliphelet the third.
verses.fr: Fils d''Eschek, son frère: Ulam, son premier-né, Jeusch le second, et Eliphéleth le troisième.
verses.am: ፤ የወንድሙም የአሴል ልጆች፤ በኵሩ ኡላም፥ ሁለተኛውም ኢያስ፥ ሦስተኛውም ኤሊፋላት።

verses.en: And the sons of Ulam were mighty men of valour, archers, and had many sons, and sons' sons, an hundred and fifty. All these are of the sons of Benjamin.
verses.fr: Les fils d''Ulam furent de vaillants hommes, tirant de l''arc; et ils eurent beaucoup de fils et de petits-fils, cent cinquante. Tous ceux-là sont des fils de Benjamin.
verses.am: ፤ የኡላም ልጆች ጽኑዓን ኃያላንና ቀስተኞች ነበሩ፤ ለእነርሱም መቶ አምሳ የሚያህሉ ብዙ ልጆችና የልጅ ልጆች ነበሩአቸው፤ እነዚህ ሁሉ የብንያም ልጆች ነበሩ።

verses.en: So all Israel were reckoned by genealogies; and, behold, they were written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah, who were carried away to Babylon for their transgression.
verses.fr: Tout Israël est enregistré dans les généalogies et inscrit dans le livre des rois d''Israël. Et Juda fut emmené captif à Babylone, à cause de ses infidélités.
verses.am: እስራኤልም ሁሉ በየትውልዳቸው ተቈጠሩ፤ እነሆም፥ በእስራኤል ነገሥታት መጽሐፍ ተጽፈዋል። ይሁዳም ስለ ኃጢአታቸው ወደ ባቢሎን ተማረኩ።

verses.en: Now the first inhabitants that dwelt in their possessions in their cities were, the Israelites, the priests, Levites, and the Nethinims.
verses.fr: Les premiers habitants qui demeuraient dans leurs possessions, dans leurs villes, étaient les Israélites, les sacrificateurs, les Lévites, et les Néthiniens.
verses.am: በአውራጃዎቻቸውና በከተሞቻቸው መጀመሪያ የተቀመጡ እስራኤልና ካህናት ሌዋውያንም ናታኒምም ነበሩ።

verses.en: And in Jerusalem dwelt of the children of Judah, and of the children of Benjamin, and of the children of Ephraim, and Manasseh;
verses.fr: A Jérusalem habitaient des fils de Juda, des fils de Benjamin, et des fils d''Ephraïm et de Manassé. -
verses.am: ከይሁዳ ልጆችና ከብንያም ልጆች ከኤፍሬምና ከምናሴ ልጆች በኢየሩሳሌም ተቀመጡ።

verses.en: Uthai the son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, of the children of Pharez the son of Judah.
verses.fr: Des fils de Pérets, fils de Juda: Uthaï, fils d''Ammihud, fils d''Omri, fils d''Imri, fils de Bani.
verses.am: ከይሁዳ ልጅ ከፋሬስ ልጆች የባኒ ልጅ የአምሪ ልጅ የፆምሪ ልጅ የዓሚሁድ ልጅ ዑታይ ደግሞ ተቀመጠ።

verses.en: And of the Shilonites; Asaiah the firstborn, and his sons.
verses.fr: Des Schilonites: Asaja, le premier-né, et ses fils.
verses.am: ከሴሎናዊያንም በኵሩ ዓሣያና ልጆቹ።

verses.en: And of the sons of Zerah; Jeuel, and their brethren, six hundred and ninety.
verses.fr: Des fils de Zérach: Jeuel, et ses frères, six cent quatre-vingt-dix. -
verses.am: ከዛራም ልጆች ይዑኤልና ወንድሞቻቸው፥ ስድስት መቶ ዘጠና።

verses.en: And of the sons of Benjamin; Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hasenuah,
verses.fr: Des fils de Benjamin: Sallu, fils de Meschullam, fils d''Hodavia, fils d''Assenua;
verses.am: ከብንያምም ልጆች የሐስኑአ ልጅ የሆዳይዋ ልጅ የሜሱላም ልጅ ሰሉ፤

verses.en: And Ibneiah the son of Jeroham, and Elah the son of Uzzi, the son of Michri, and Meshullam the son of Shephathiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah;
verses.fr: Jibneja, fils de Jerocham; Ela, fils d''Uzzi, fils de Micri; Meschullam, fils de Schephathia, fils de Reuel, fils de Jibnija;
verses.am: የይሮሐም ልጅ ብኔያ፤ የሚክሪ ልጅ የኦዚ ልጅ ኤላ፤ የዪብኒያ ልጅ የራጉኤል ልጅ የሰፋጥያስ ልጅ ሜሱላም፤

verses.en: And their brethren, according to their generations, nine hundred and fifty and six. All these men were chief of the fathers in the house of their fathers.
verses.fr: et leurs frères, selon leurs générations, neuf cent cinquante-six. Tous ces hommes étaient chefs de famille dans les maisons de leurs pères.
verses.am: በየትውልዳቸውም ወንድሞቻቸው ዘጠኝ መቶ ሃምሳ ስድስት ነበሩ፤ እነዚህ ሰዎች ሁሉ የአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች አለቆች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And of the priests; Jedaiah, and Jehoiarib, and Jachin,
verses.fr: Des sacrificateurs: Jedaeja; Jehojarib; Jakin;
verses.am: ከካህናቱም ዮዳሄ፥ ዮአሪብ፥ ያኪን፤

verses.en: And Azariah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of the house of God;
verses.fr: Azaria, fils de Hilkija, fils de Meschullam, fils de Tsadok, fils de Merajoth, fils d''Achithub, prince de la maison de Dieu;
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቤት አለቃ የአኪጦብ ልጅ የመራዮት ልጅ የሳዶቅ ልጅ ሜሱላም ልጅ የኬልቂያስ ልጅ ዓዛርያስ፤

verses.en: And Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pashur, the son of Malchijah, and Maasiai the son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer;
verses.fr: Adaja, fils de Jerocham, fils de Paschhur, fils de Malkija; Maesaï, fils d''Adiel, fils de Jachzéra, fils de Meschullam, fils de Meschillémith, fils d''Immer;
verses.am: የመልኪያ ልጅ የጳስኮር ልጅ የይሮሐም ልጅ ዓዳያ፤ የኢሜር ልጅ የምሺላሚት ልጅ የሜሱላም ልጅ የየሕዜራ ልጅ የዓዲኤል ልጅ መዕሣይ፤

verses.en: And their brethren, heads of the house of their fathers, a thousand and seven hundred and threescore; very able men for the work of the service of the house of God.
verses.fr: et leurs frères, chefs des maisons de leurs pères, mille sept cent soixante, hommes vaillants, occupés au service de la maison de Dieu.
verses.am: የአባቶቻቸውም ቤቶች አለቆች ወንድሞቻቸው ሺህ ሰባት መቶ ስድሳ ነበሩ፤ ለእግዚአብሔር ቤት ማገልገል ሥራ እጅግ ብልሃተኞች ሰዎች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And of the Levites; Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;
verses.fr: Des Lévites: Schemaeja, fils de Haschub, fils d''Azrikam, fils de Haschabia, des fils de Merari;
verses.am: ከሌዋውያንም የሜራሪ ልጆች የአሳብያ ልጅ የዓዝሪቃም ልጅ የአሱብ ልጅ ሸማያ፤

verses.en: And Bakbakkar, Heresh, and Galal, and Mattaniah the son of Micah, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph;
verses.fr: Bakbakkar; Héresch; Galal; Matthania, fils de Michée, fils de Zicri, fils d''Asaph;
verses.am: በቅበቃር፥ ኤሬስ፥ ጋላል፥ የኣሳፍ ልጅ የዝክሪ ልጅ የሚካ ልጅ መታንያ፤

verses.en: And Obadiah the son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun, and Berechiah the son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, that dwelt in the villages of the Netophathites.
verses.fr: Abdias, fils de Schemaeja, fils de Galal, fils de Jeduthun; Bérékia, fils d''Asa, fils d''Elkana, qui habitait dans les villages des Nethophathiens.
verses.am: የኤዶታም ልጅ የጋላል ልጅ የሰሙስ ልጅ አብድያ፤ በነጦፋውያንም መንደሮች የተቀመጠው የሕልቃና ልጅ የአሳ ልጅ በራክያ።

verses.en: And the porters were, Shallum, and Akkub, and Talmon, and Ahiman, and their brethren: Shallum was the chief;
verses.fr: Et les portiers: Schallum, Akkub, Thalmon, Achiman, et leurs frères; Schallum était le chef,
verses.am: በረኞችም ሰሎም፥ ዓቁብ፥ ጤልሞን፥ አሒማን፥ ወንድሞቻቸውም ነበሩ፤ ሰሎምም አለቃ ነበረ።

verses.en: Who hitherto waited in the king's gate eastward: they were porters in the companies of the children of Levi.
verses.fr: et jusqu''à présent il est à la porte du roi, à l''orient. Ce sont là les portiers pour le camp des fils de Lévi.
verses.am: እስከ ዛሬም ድረስ በንጉሥ በር በምሥራቅ በኩል ነበሩ፤ ለሌዊ ልጆች ሰፈር በረኞች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And Shallum the son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his brethren, of the house of his father, the Korahites, were over the work of the service, keepers of the gates of the tabernacle: and their fathers, being over the host of the Lord, were keepers of the entry.
verses.fr: Schallum, fils de Koré, fils d''Ebiasaph, fils de Koré, et ses frères de la maison de son père, les Koréites, remplissaient les fonctions de gardiens des seuils de la tente; leurs pères avaient gardé l''entrée du camp de l''Eternel,
verses.am: የቆሬም ልጅ የአብያሳፍ ልጅ የቆሬ ልጅ ሰሎም ከአባቱም ቤት የነበሩ ወንድሞቹ ቆሬያውያን በማገልገል ሥራ ላይ ነበሩ፥ የድንኳኑንም መድረክ ይጠብቁ ነበር። አባቶቻቸውም የእግዚአብሔርን ሰፈር መግቢያ ጠብቀው ነበር።

verses.en: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar was the ruler over them in time past, and the Lord was with him.
verses.fr: et Phinées, fils d''Eléazar, avait été autrefois leur chef, et l''Eternel était avec lui.
verses.am: አስቀድሞም የአልዓዛር ልጅ ፊንሐስ አለቃቸው ነበረ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ከእርሱ ጋር ነበረ።

verses.en: And Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah was porter of the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.fr: Zacharie, fils de Meschélémia, était portier à l''entrée de la tente d''assignation.
verses.am: የሜሱላም ልጅ ዘካርያስ የመገናኛው ድንኳን ደጅ በረኛ ነበረ።

verses.en: All these which were chosen to be porters in the gates were two hundred and twelve. These were reckoned by their genealogy in their villages, whom David and Samuel the seer did ordain in their set office.
verses.fr: Ils étaient en tout deux cent douze, choisis pour portiers des seuils, et enregistrés dans les généalogies d''après leurs villages; David et Samuel le voyant les avaient établis dans leurs fonctions.
verses.am: የመድረኩ በረኞች ይሆኑ ዘንድ የተመረጡ እነዚህ ሁሉ ሁለት መቶ አሥራ ሁለት ነበሩ። ዳዊትና ነቢዩ ሳሙኤል በሥራቸው ያቆሙአቸው እነዚህ በመንደሮቻቸው በየትውልዳቸው ተቈጠሩ።

verses.en: So they and their children had the oversight of the gates of the house of the Lord, namely, the house of the tabernacle, by wards.
verses.fr: Eux et leurs enfants gardaient les portes de la maison de l''Eternel, de la maison de la tente.
verses.am: እነርሱና ልጆቻቸውም በእግዚአብሔር ቤት በድንኳኑ ደጆች ላይ ዘበኞች ነበሩ።

verses.en: In four quarters were the porters, toward the east, west, north, and south.
verses.fr: Il y avait des portiers aux quatre vents, à l''orient, à l''occident, au nord et au midi.
verses.am: በአራቱ ማዕዘኖች፥ በምሥራቅ፥ በምዕራብ፥ በሰሜን፥ በደቡብ፥ በረኞች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And their brethren, which were in their villages, were to come after seven days from time to time with them.
verses.fr: Leurs frères, qui demeuraient dans leurs villages, devaient de temps à autre venir auprès d''eux pendant sept jours.
verses.am: ወንድሞቻቸውም በመንደሮቻቸው ሆነው፥ በየሰባትም ቀን ከእነርሱ ጋር ሊሆኑ ከጊዜ ወደ ጊዜ ይገቡ ነበር።

verses.en: For these Levites, the four chief porters, were in their set office, and were over the chambers and treasuries of the house of God.
verses.fr: Car ces quatre chefs des portiers, ces Lévites, étaient toujours en fonctions, et ils avaient encore la surveillance des chambres et des trésors de la maison de Dieu;
verses.am: ከሌዋውያንም የነበሩ አራቱ የበረኞች አለቆች ዘወትር በሥራቸው ይቀመጡ ነበር፤ በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት ባሉ ጓዳዎችና ቤተ መዛግብት ላይ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And they lodged round about the house of God, because the charge was upon them, and the opening thereof every morning pertained to them.
verses.fr: ils passaient la nuit autour de la maison de Dieu, dont ils avaient la garde, et qu''ils devaient ouvrir chaque matin.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርንም ቤት የሚጠብቁ፥ ጥዋት ጥዋትም ደጆቹን የሚከፍቱ እነርሱ ነበሩና በዚያ ያድሩ ነበር።

verses.en: And certain of them had the charge of the ministering vessels, that they should bring them in and out by tale.
verses.fr: Quelques-uns des Lévites prenaient soin des ustensiles du service, qu''ils rentraient en les comptant et sortaient en les comptant.
verses.am: ዕቃውም በቍጥር ይገባና ይወጣ ነበርና ከእነዚህ አንዳንዱ በማገልገያው ዕቃ ላይ ሹሞች ነበሩ።

verses.en: Some of them also were appointed to oversee the vessels, and all the instruments of the sanctuary, and the fine flour, and the wine, and the oil, and the frankincense, and the spices.
verses.fr: D''autres veillaient sur les ustensiles, sur tous les ustensiles du sanctuaire, et sur la fleur de farine, le vin, l''huile, l''encens et les aromates.
verses.am: ከእነርሱም አንዳንዶቹ በመቅደሱ ዕቃ ሁሉ በመልካሙም ዱቄት፥ በወይን ጠጁ፥ በዘይቱም፥ በዕጣኑም፥ በሽቱውም ላይ ሹሞች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And some of the sons of the priests made the ointment of the spices.
verses.fr: C''étaient des fils de sacrificateurs qui composaient les parfums aromatiques.
verses.am: ከካህናቱም ልጆች አንዳንዶቹ የሽቱውን ቅባት ያጣፍጡ ነበር።

verses.en: And Mattithiah, one of the Levites, who was the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, had the set office over the things that were made in the pans.
verses.fr: Matthithia, l''un des Lévites, premier-né de Schallum le Koréite, s''occupait des gâteaux cuits sur la plaque.
verses.am: የቆሬያዊውም የሰሎም በኵር ሌዋዊው ማቲትያ በምጣድ በሚጋገረው ነገር ላይ ሹም ነበረ።

verses.en: And other of their brethren, of the sons of the Kohathites, were over the shewbread, to prepare it every sabbath.
verses.fr: Et quelques-uns de leurs frères, parmi les Kehathites, étaient chargés de préparer pour chaque sabbat les pains de proposition.
verses.am: በየሰንበቱም ያዘጋጁ ዘንድ ከወንድሞቻቸው ከቀዓታውያን አንዳንዱ በገጹ ኅብስት ላይ ሹሞች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And these are the singers, chief of the fathers of the Levites, who remaining in the chambers were free: for they were employed in that work day and night.
verses.fr: Ce sont là les chantres, chefs de famille des Lévites, demeurant dans les chambres, exempts des autres fonctions parce qu''ils étaient à l''oeuvre jour et nuit.
verses.am: ከሌዋውያኑም ወገን የአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች አለቆች የነበሩ መዘምራን እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ሥራቸውም ሌሊትና ቀን ነበረና ያለሌላ ሥራ በየጓዳቸው ይቀመጡ ነበር።

verses.en: These chief fathers of the Levites were chief throughout their generations; these dwelt at Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Ce sont là les chefs de famille des Lévites, chefs selon leurs générations. Ils habitaient à Jérusalem.
verses.am: እነዚህ ከሌዋውያን የአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች አለቆች በየትውልዳቸው አለቆች ነበሩ። እነዚህም በኢየሩሳሌም ይቀመጡ ነበር።

verses.en: And in Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon, Jehiel, whose wife's name was Maachah:
verses.fr: Le père de Gabaon, Jeïel, habitait à Gabaon, et le nom de sa femme était Maaca.
verses.am: የሚስቱ ስም መዓካ የነበረው የገባዖን አባት ይዒኤል፥

verses.en: And his firstborn son Abdon, then Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Ner, and Nadab.
verses.fr: Abdon, son fils premier-né, puis Tsur, Kis, Baal, Ner, Nadab,
verses.am: የበኵር ልጁም ዓብዶን፥

verses.en: And Gedor, and Ahio, and Zechariah, and Mikloth.
verses.fr: Guedor, Achjo, Zacharie et Mikloth.
verses.am: ዱር፥ ቂስ፥ በኣል፥ ኔር፥ ናዳብ፥ ጌዶር፥ አሒዮ፥ ዛኩር፥ ሚቅሎት፥ በገባኦን ይቀመጡ ነበር።

verses.en: And Mikloth begat Shimeam. And they also dwelt with their brethren at Jerusalem, over against their brethren.
verses.fr: Mikloth engendra Schimeam. Ils habitaient aussi à Jérusalem près de leurs frères, avec leurs frères. -
verses.am: ሚቅሎትም ሳምአን ወለደ፤ እነርሱ ደግሞ ከወንድሞቻቸው ጋር በኢየሩሳሌም በወንድሞቻቸው ፊት ለፊት ይቀመጡ ነበር።

verses.en: And Ner begat Kish; and Kish begat Saul; and Saul begat Jonathan, and Malchishua, and Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
verses.fr: Ner engendra Kis; Kis engendra Saül; Saül engendra Jonathan, Malki-Schua, Abinadab et Eschbaal.
verses.am: ኔርም ቂስን ወለደ፤ ቂስም ሳኦልን ወለደ፤ ሳኦልም ዮናታንን፥ ሚልኪሳን፥ አሚናዳብን፥ አስበኣልን ወለደ።

verses.en: And the son of Jonathan was Meribbaal: and Meribbaal begat Micah.
verses.fr: Fils de Jonathan: Merib-Baal. Merib-Baal engendra Michée.
verses.am: የዮናታንም ልጅ መሪበኣል ነበረ፤ መሪበኣልም ሚካን ወለደ።

verses.en: And the sons of Micah were, Pithon, and Melech, and Tahrea, and Ahaz.
verses.fr: Fils de Michée: Pithon, Mélec, et Thachréa.
verses.am: የሚካም ልጆች ፒቶን፥ ሜሌክ፥ ታሬዓ፥ አካዝ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And Ahaz begat Jarah; and Jarah begat Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begat Moza;
verses.fr: Achaz engendra Jaera; Jaera engendra Alémeth, Azmaveth et Zimri; Zimri engendra Motsa;
verses.am: አካዝም የዕራን ወለደ፤ የዕራም ዓሌሜትን፥ ዓዝሞትን፥ ዘምሪን ወለደ፤ ዘምሪም ሞጻን ወለደ።

verses.en: And Moza begat Binea; and Rephaiah his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son.
verses.fr: Motsa engendra Binea. Rephaja, son fils; Eleasa, son fils; Atsel, son fils.
verses.am: ሞጻም ቢንዓን ወለደ፥ ልጁም ረፋያ ነበረ፥ ልጁ ኤልዓሣ፥ ልጁ ኤሴል፤

verses.en: And Azel had six sons, whose names are these, Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan: these were the sons of Azel.
verses.fr: Atsel eut six fils, dont voici les noms: Azrikam, Bocru, Ismaël, Schearia, Abdias et Hanan. Ce sont là les fils d''Atsel.
verses.am: ለኤሴልም ስድስት ልጆች ነበሩት፤ ስማቸውም ይህ ነበረ፤ ዓዝሪቃም፥ ቦክሩ፥ እስማኤል፥ ሸዓሪያ፥ አብድዩ፥ ሐናን፤ እነዚህ የኤሴል ልጆች ነበሩ።

verses.en: Now the Philistines fought against Israel; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain in mount Gilboa.
verses.fr: Les Philistins livrèrent bataille à Israël, et les hommes d''Israël prirent la fuite devant les Philistins et tombèrent morts sur la montagne de Guilboa.
verses.am: ፍልስጥኤማውያንም ከእስራኤል ጋር ተዋጉ፤ የእስራኤልም ሰዎች ከፍልስጥኤማውያን ፊት ሸሹ፥ ተወግተውም በጊልቦአ ተራራ ላይ ወደቁ።

verses.en: And the Philistines followed hard after Saul, and after his sons; and the Philistines slew Jonathan, and Abinadab, and Malchishua, the sons of Saul.
verses.fr: Les Philistins poursuivirent Saül et ses fils, et tuèrent Jonathan, Abinadab et Malki-Schua, fils de Saül.
verses.am: ፍልስጥኤማውያንም ሳኦልንና ልጆቹን በእግር በእግራቸው ተከትለው አባረሩአቸው፤ ፍልስጥኤማውያንም የሳኦልን ልጆች ዮናታንንና አሚናዳብን ሜልኪሳንም ገደሉ።

verses.en: And the battle went sore against Saul, and the archers hit him, and he was wounded of the archers.
verses.fr: L''effort du combat porta sur Saül; les archers l''atteignirent et le blessèrent.
verses.am: ሰልፍም በሳኦል ላይ ጠነከረ፥ ቀስተኞችም አገኙት፤ ከቀስተኞችም የተነሣ ተጨነቀ።

verses.en: Then said Saul to his armourbearer, Draw thy sword, and thrust me through therewith; lest these uncircumcised come and abuse me. But his armourbearer would not; for he was sore afraid. So Saul took a sword, and fell upon it.
verses.fr: Saül dit alors à celui qui portait ses armes: Tire ton épée, et transperce-m''en, de peur que ces incirconcis ne viennent me faire subir leurs outrages. Celui qui portait ses armes ne voulut pas, car il était saisi de crainte. Et Saül prit son épée, et se jeta dessus.
verses.am: ሳኦልም ጋሻ ጃግሬውን። እነዚህ ቈላፋን መጥተው እንዳይዘብቱብኝ ሰይፍህን መዝዘህ ውጋኝ አለው። ጋሻ ጃግሬው ግን እጅግ ፈርቶ ነበርና እንቢ አለ። ሳኦልም ሰይፉን ወስዶ በላዩ ወደቀ።

verses.en: And when his armourbearer saw that Saul was dead, he fell likewise on the sword, and died.
verses.fr: Celui qui portait les armes de Saül, le voyant mort, se jeta aussi sur son épée, et mourut.
verses.am: ጋሻ ጃግሬውም ሳኦል እንደ ሞተ ባየ ጊዜ እርሱ ደግሞ በሰይፉ ላይ ወድቆ ሞተ።

verses.en: So Saul died, and his three sons, and all his house died together.
verses.fr: Ainsi périrent Saül et ses trois fils, et toute sa maison périt en même temps.
verses.am: ሳኦልና ሦስቱ ልጆቹ የቤቱም ሰዎች ሁሉ በአንድ ላይ ሞቱ።

verses.en: And when all the men of Israel that were in the valley saw that they fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, then they forsook their cities, and fled: and the Philistines came and dwelt in them.
verses.fr: Tous ceux d''Israël qui étaient dans la vallée, ayant vu qu''on avait fui et que Saül et ses fils étaient morts, abandonnèrent leurs villes pour prendre aussi la fuite. Et les Philistins allèrent s''y établir.
verses.am: በሸለቆውም የነበሩት የእስራኤል ሰዎች ሁሉ እንደ ሸሹ፥ ሳኦልና ልጆቹም እንደ ሞቱ ባዩ ጊዜ ከተሞቻቸውን ለቅቀው ሸሹ፤ ፍልስጥኤማውያንም መጥተው ተቀመጡባቸው።

verses.en: And it came to pass on the morrow, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, that they found Saul and his sons fallen in mount Gilboa.
verses.fr: Le lendemain, les Philistins vinrent pour dépouiller les morts, et ils trouvèrent Saül et ses fils tombés sur la montagne de Guilboa.
verses.am: በነጋውም ፍልስጥኤማውያን የሞቱትን ለመግፈፍ በመጡ ጊዜ ሳኦልንና ልጆቹን በጊልቦአ ተራራ ላይ ወድቀው አገኙአቸው።

verses.en: And when they had stripped him, they took his head, and his armour, and sent into the land of the Philistines round about, to carry tidings unto their idols, and to the people.
verses.fr: Ils le dépouillèrent, et emportèrent sa tête et ses armes. Puis ils firent annoncer ces bonnes nouvelles par tout le pays des Philistins à leurs idoles et au peuple.
verses.am: ገፈፉትም፥ ራሱንና መሣሪያውንም አንሥተው ለጣኦቶቻቸውና ለሕዝቡ የምሥራች ይወስዱ ዘንድ ወደ ፍልስጥኤማውያን አገር ዙሪያ ሰደዱ።

verses.en: And they put his armour in the house of their gods, and fastened his head in the temple of Dagon.
verses.fr: Ils mirent les armes de Saül dans la maison de leur dieu, et ils attachèrent son crâne dans le temple de Dagon.
verses.am: መሣሪያውንም በአምላኮቻቸው ቤት ውስጥ አኖሩ፤ ራሱንም በዳጎን ቤት ውስጥ ቸነከሩት።

verses.en: And when all Jabeshgilead heard all that the Philistines had done to Saul,
verses.fr: Tout Jabès en Galaad ayant appris tout ce que les Philistins avaient fait à Saül,
verses.am: የኢያቢስ ገለዓድም ሰዎች ሁሉ ፍልስጥኤማውያን በሳኦል ላይ ያደረጉትን ሁሉ በሰሙ ጊዜ፥

verses.en: They arose, all the valiant men, and took away the body of Saul, and the bodies of his sons, and brought them to Jabesh, and buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.
verses.fr: tous les hommes vaillants se levèrent, prirent le corps de Saül et ceux de ses fils, et les transportèrent à Jabès. Ils enterrèrent leurs os sous le térébinthe, à Jabès, et ils jeûnèrent sept jours.
verses.am: ጽኑአን ሰዎች ሁሉ ተነሥተው የሳኦልን ሬሳ የልጆቹንም ሬሳ ወሰዱ፥ ወደ ኢያቢስም አመጡአቸው፤ በኢያቢስም ካለው ከትልቁ ዛፍ በታች አጥንቶቻቸውን ቀበሩ፥ ሰባት ቀንም ጾሙ።

verses.en: So Saul died for his transgression which he committed against the Lord, even against the word of the Lord, which he kept not, and also for asking counsel of one that had a familiar spirit, to enquire of it;
verses.fr: Saül mourut, parce qu''il se rendit coupable d''infidélité envers l''Eternel, dont il n''observa point la parole, et parce qu''il interrogea et consulta ceux qui évoquent les morts.
verses.am: እንዲሁ ሳኦል በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ስላደረገው ኃጢአት፥ የእግዚአብሔርንም ቃል ስላልጠበቀ ሞተ። ደግሞም መናፍስት ጠሪ

verses.en: And enquired not of the Lord: therefore he slew him, and turned the kingdom unto David the son of Jesse.
verses.fr: Il ne consulta point l''Eternel; alors l''Eternel le fit mourir, et transféra la royauté à David, fils d''Isaï.
verses.am: ስለ ጠየቀ እግዚአብሔርንም ስላልጠየቀ፥ ስለዚህ ገደለው፥ መንግሥቱንም ወደ እሴይ ልጅ ወደ ዳዊት አሳለፈው።

verses.en: Then all Israel gathered themselves to David unto Hebron, saying, Behold, we are thy bone and thy flesh.
verses.fr: Tout Israël s''assembla auprès de David à Hébron, en disant: Voici, nous sommes tes os et ta chair.
verses.am: እስራኤልም ሁሉ በኬብሮን ወደ ዳዊት ተሰብስበው። እነሆ፥ እኛ የአጥንትህ ፍላጭ የሥጋህ ቍራጭ ነን፤

verses.en: And moreover in time past, even when Saul was king, thou wast he that leddest out and broughtest in Israel: and the Lord thy God said unto thee, Thou shalt feed my people Israel, and thou shalt be ruler over my people Israel.
verses.fr: Autrefois déjà, même lorsque Saül était roi, c''était toi qui conduisais et qui ramenais Israël. L''Eternel, ton Dieu, t''a dit: Tu paîtras mon peuple d''Israël, et tu seras le chef de mon peuple d''Israël.
verses.am: አስቀድሞ ሳኦል ንጉሥ ሆኖ ሳለ እስራኤልን የምታወጣና የምታገባ አንተ ነበርህ፤ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔርም። ሕዝቤን እስራኤልን አንተ ትጠብቃለህ፤ በሕዝቤም በእስራኤል ላይ አለቃ ትሆናለህ 5ብሎህ ነበር አሉት።

verses.en: Therefore came all the elders of Israel to the king to Hebron; and David made a covenant with them in Hebron before the Lord; and they anointed David king over Israel, according to the word of the Lord by Samuel.
verses.fr: Ainsi tous les anciens d''Israël vinrent auprès du roi à Hébron, et David fit alliance avec eux à Hébron, devant l''Eternel. Ils oignirent David pour roi sur Israël, selon la parole de l''Eternel, prononcée par Samuel.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ሽማግሌዎች ሁሉ ወደ ንጉሡ ወደ ኬብሮን መጡ፤ ዳዊትም በኬብሮን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ቃል ኪዳን ከእነርሱ ጋር አደረገ፤ በሳሙኤልም እጅ እንደ ተናገረው እንደ እግዚአብሔር ቃል በእስራኤል ላይ ንጉሥ ይሆን ዘንድ ዳዊትን ቀቡት።

verses.en: And David and all Israel went to Jerusalem, which is Jebus; where the Jebusites were, the inhabitants of the land.
verses.fr: David marcha avec tout Israël sur Jérusalem, qui est Jebus. Là étaient les Jébusiens, habitants du pays.
verses.am: ዳዊትም እስራኤልም ሁሉ ኢያቡስ ወደምትባል ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ሄዱ፤ በአገሩም የተቀመጡ ኢያቡሳውያን በዚያ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And the inhabitants of Jebus said to David, Thou shalt not come hither. Nevertheless David took the castle of Zion, which is the city of David.
verses.fr: Les habitants de Jebus dirent à David: Tu n''entreras point ici. Mais David s''empara de la forteresse de Sion: c''est la cité de David.
verses.am: በኢያቡስም የተቀመጡ ዳዊትን። ወደዚህ አትገባም አሉት፤ ዳዊት ግን አምባይቱን ጽዮንን ያዘ፤ እርሷም የዳዊት ከተማ ናት።

verses.en: And David said, Whosoever smiteth the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain. So Joab the son of Zeruiah went first up, and was chief.
verses.fr: David avait dit: Quiconque battra le premier les Jébusiens sera chef et prince. Joab, fils de Tseruja, monta le premier, et il devint chef.
verses.am: ዳዊትም። ኢያቡሳውያንን አስቀድሞ የሚመታ ሰው አለቃና መኰንን ይሆናል አለ። የጽሩያም ልጅ ኢዮአብ አስቀድሞ ወጣ፥ አለቃም ሆነ።

verses.en: And David dwelt in the castle; therefore they called it the city of David.
verses.fr: David s''établit dans la forteresse; c''est pourquoi on l''appela cité de David.
verses.am: ዳዊትም በአምባይቱ ውስጥ ተቀመጠ፤ ስለዚህም የዳዊት ከተማ ብለው ጠሩአት።

verses.en: And he built the city round about, even from Millo round about: and Joab repaired the rest of the city.
verses.fr: Il fit tout autour de la ville des constructions, depuis Millo et aux environs; et Joab répara le reste de la ville.
verses.am: ከሚሎም ጀምሮ በዙሪያው ከተማ ሠራ፤ ኢዮአብም የቀረውን ከተማ አበጀ።

verses.en: So David waxed greater and greater: for the Lord of hosts was with him.
verses.fr: David devenait de plus en plus grand, et l''Eternel des armées était avec lui.
verses.am: ዳዊትም የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ከእርሱ ጋር ነበርና እየበረታ ሄደ።

verses.en: These also are the chief of the mighty men whom David had, who strengthened themselves with him in his kingdom, and with all Israel, to make him king, according to the word of the Lord concerning Israel.
verses.fr: Voici les chefs des vaillants hommes qui étaient au service de David, et qui l''aidèrent avec tout Israël à assurer sa domination, afin de l''établir roi, selon la parole de l''Eternel au sujet d''Israël.
verses.am: ለዳዊትም የነበሩት የኃያላን አለቆች እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ስለ እስራኤል እንደ ተናገረው የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ያነግሡት ዘንድ ከእስራኤል ሁሉ ጋር በመንግሥቱ ላይ አጸኑት።

verses.en: And this is the number of the mighty men whom David had; Jashobeam, an Hachmonite, the chief of the captains: he lifted up his spear against three hundred slain by him at one time.
verses.fr: Voici, d''après leur nombre, les vaillants hommes qui étaient au service de David. Jaschobeam, fils de Hacmoni, l''un des principaux officiers. Il brandit sa lance sur trois cents hommes, qu''il fit périr en une seule fois.
verses.am: የዳዊትም ኃያላን ቍጥር ይህ ነበረ፤ የሠላሳው አለቃ የአክሞናዊው ልጅ ያሾብአም ነበረ፤ እርሱ ጦሩን አንሥቶ ሦስት መቶ ሰው በአንድ ጊዜ ገደለ።

verses.en: And after him was Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite, who was one of the three mighties.
verses.fr: Après lui, Eléazar, fils de Dodo, l''Achochite, l''un des trois guerriers.
verses.am: ከእርሱም በኋላ በሦስቱ ኃያላን መካከል የነበረ የአሆሃሂው የዱዲ ልጅ አልዓዛር ነበር።

verses.en: He was with David at Pasdammim, and there the Philistines were gathered together to battle, where was a parcel of ground full of barley; and the people fled from before the Philistines.
verses.fr: Il était avec David à Pas-Dammim, où les Philistins s''étaient rassemblés pour combattre. Il y avait là une pièce de terre remplie d''orge; et le peuple fuyait devant les Philistins.
verses.am: እርሱ ከዳዊት ጋር በፈስደሚም ነበረ፥ በዚያም ገብስ በሞላበት እርሻ ውስጥ ፍልስጥኤማውያን ለሰልፍ ተሰብስበው ነበር፤ ሕዝቡም ከፍልስጥኤማውያን ፊት ሸሹ።

verses.en: And they set themselves in the midst of that parcel, and delivered it, and slew the Philistines; and the Lord saved them by a great deliverance.
verses.fr: Ils se placèrent au milieu du champ, le protégèrent, et battirent les Philistins. Et l''Eternel opéra une grande délivrance.
verses.am: በእርሻውም መካከል ቆመው ጠበቁት፥ ፍልስጥኤማውያንንም ገደሉ፤ እግዚአብሔርም በታላቅ ማዳን አዳናቸው።

verses.en: Now three of the thirty captains went down to the rock to David, into the cave of Adullam; and the host of the Philistines encamped in the valley of Rephaim.
verses.fr: Trois des trente chefs descendirent auprès de David sur le rocher dans la caverne d''Adullam, lorsque le camp des Philistins était dressé dans la vallée des Rephaïm.
verses.am: ከሠላሳውም አለቆች ሦስቱ ወርደው ዳዊት ወዳለበት ወደ ዓለቱ ወደ ዓዶላም ዋሻ መጡ፤ የፍልስጥኤማውያንም ጭፍራ በራፋይም ሸለቆ ሰፍሮ ነበር።

verses.en: And David was then in the hold, and the Philistines' garrison was then at Bethlehem.
verses.fr: David était alors dans la forteresse, et il y avait un poste de Philistins à Bethléhem.
verses.am: በዚያም ጊዜ ዳዊት በምሽጉ ውስጥ ነበረ፥ የፍልስጥኤማውያንም ጭፍራ በቤተ ልሔም ነበረ።

verses.en: And David longed, and said, Oh that one would give me drink of the water of the well of Bethlehem, that is at the gate!
verses.fr: David eut un désir, et il dit: Qui me fera boire de l''eau de la citerne qui est à la porte de Bethléhem?
verses.am: ዳዊትም። በበሩ አጠገብ ካለችው ከቤተ ልሔም ምንጭ ውሃ ማን ይሰጠኛል? ብሎ ተመኘ።

verses.en: And the three brake through the host of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem, that was by the gate, and took it, and brought it to David: but David would not drink of it, but poured it out to the Lord.
verses.fr: Alors les trois hommes passèrent au travers du camp des Philistins, et puisèrent de l''eau de la citerne qui est à la porte de Bethléhem. Ils l''apportèrent et la présentèrent à David; mais David ne voulut pas la boire, et il la répandit devant l''Eternel.
verses.am: እነዚህም ሦስቱ የፍልስጥኤማውያንን ሠራዊት ቀድደው ሄዱ፥ በበሩም አጠገብ ካለችው ከቤተ ልሔም ምንጭ ውሃ ቀዱ፤ ይዘውም ለዳዊት አመጡለት። እርሱ ግን ሊጠጣ አልወደደም፥ ነገር ግን ለእግዚአብሔር አፍስሶ።

verses.en: And said, My God forbid it me, that I should do this thing: shall I drink the blood of these men that have put their lives in jeopardy? for with the jeopardy of their lives they brought it. Therefore he would not drink it. These things did these three mightiest.
verses.fr: Il dit: Que mon Dieu me garde de faire cela! Boirais-je le sang de ces hommes qui sont allés au péril de leur vie? Car c''est au péril de leur vie qu''ils l''ont apportée. Et il ne voulut pas la boire. Voilà ce que firent ces trois vaillants hommes.
verses.am: ይህን አደርግ ዘንድ አምላኬ ይከልክለኝ፤ በነፍሳቸው የደፈሩትም እነዚህ ሰዎች ደም እጠጣለሁን? በነፍሳቸው አምጥተውታል አለ። ስለዚህም ይጠጣ ዘንድ አልወደደም። ሦስቱም ኃያላን ያደረጉት ይህ ነው።

verses.en: And Abishai the brother of Joab, he was chief of the three: for lifting up his spear against three hundred, he slew them, and had a name among the three.
verses.fr: Abischaï, frère de Joab, était le chef des trois. Il brandit sa lance sur trois cents hommes, et les tua; et il eut du renom parmi les trois.
verses.am: የኢዮአብም ወንድም አቢሳ የሦስቱ አለቃ ነበረ፤ ጦሩንም በሦስት መቶ ላይ አንሥቶ ገደላቸው፥ በሦስቱም መካከል ስሙ የተጠራ ነበረ።

verses.en: Of the three, he was more honourable than the two; for he was their captain: howbeit he attained not to the first three.
verses.fr: Il était le plus considéré des trois de la seconde série, et il fut leur chef; mais il n''égala pas les trois premiers.
verses.am: በሁለተኛውም ተራ በሆኑት በሦስቱ መካከል የከበረ ነበረ፥ አለቃቸውም ሆነ፤ ነገር ግን ወደ ፊተኞቹ ወደ ሦስቱ አልደረሰም።

verses.en: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done many acts; he slew two lionlike men of Moab: also he went down and slew a lion in a pit in a snowy day.
verses.fr: Benaja, fils de Jehojada, fils d''un homme de Kabtseel, rempli de valeur et célèbre par ses exploits. Il frappa les deux lions de Moab. Il descendit au milieu d''une citerne, où il frappa un lion, un jour de neige.
verses.am: በቀብስኤልም የነበረው፥ ታላቅ ሥራ ያደረገው የጽኑዕ ሰው የዮዳሄ ልጅ በናያስ የሞዓባዊን የአሪኤል ሁለቱን ልጆች ገደለ፤ በአመዳይም ወራት ወርዶ በጕድጓድ ውስጥ አንበሳ ገደለ።

verses.en: And he slew an Egyptian, a man of great stature, five cubits high; and in the Egyptian's hand was a spear like a weaver's beam; and he went down to him with a staff, and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian's hand, and slew him with his own spear.
verses.fr: Il frappa un Egyptien d''une stature de cinq coudées et ayant à la main une lance comme une ensouple de tisserand; il descendit contre lui avec un bâton, arracha la lance de la main de l''Egyptien, et s''en servit pour le tuer.
verses.am: ቁመቱም አምስት ክንድ የነበረውን ረጅሙን ግብጻዊውን ሰው ገደለ፤ በግብጻዊውም እጅ የሸማኔ መጠቅለያ የመሰለ ጦር ነበረ፤ እርሱ ግን በትር ይዞ ወደ እርሱ ወረደ፥ ከግብጻዊውም እጅ ጦሩን ነቅሎ በገዛ ጦሩ ገደለው።

verses.en: These things did Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and had the name among the three mighties.
verses.fr: Voilà ce que fit Benaja, fils de Jehojada; et il eut du renom parmi les trois vaillants hommes.
verses.am: የዮዳሄ ልጅ በናያስ ያደረገው ይህ ነው፤ ስሙም በሦስቱ ኃያላን መካከል የተጠራ ነበር።

verses.en: Behold, he was honourable among the thirty, but attained not to the first three: and David set him over his guard.
verses.fr: Il était le plus considéré des trente; mais il n''égala pas les trois premiers. David l''admit dans son conseil secret.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ከሠላሳው ይልቅ የከበረ ነበረ፥ ነገር ግን ወደ ፊተኞቹ ወደ ሦስቱ አልደረሰም። ዳዊትም በዘበኞቹ ላይ ሾመው።

verses.en: Also the valiant men of the armies were, Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,
verses.fr: Hommes vaillants de l''armée: Asaël, frère de Joab. Elchanan, fils de Dodo, de Bethléhem.
verses.am: ደግሞም በጭፍሮች ዘንድ የነበሩት ኃያላን እነዚህ ናቸው፤ የኢዮአብ ወንድም አሣሄል፥ የቤተ ልሔሙ ሰው የዱዲ ልጅ ኤልያናን፥

verses.en: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,
verses.fr: Schammoth, d''Haror. Hélets, de Palon.
verses.am: ሃሮራዊው ሳሞት፥ ፈሎናዊው ሴሌስ፥

verses.en: Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abiezer the Antothite,
verses.fr: Ira, fils d''Ikkesch, de Tekoa. Abiézer, d''Anathoth.
verses.am: የቴቁሔ ሰው የዒስካ ልጅ ዒራስ፥

verses.en: Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,
verses.fr: Sibbecaï, le Huschatite. Ilaï, d''Achoach.
verses.am: ዓናቶታዊው አቢዔዜር፥ ኩሳታዊው ሴቤካይ፥

verses.en: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled the son of Baanah the Netophathite,
verses.fr: Maharaï, de Nethopha. Héled, fils de Baana, de Nethopha.
verses.am: አሆሃዊው ዔላይ፥ ነጦፋዊው ኖኤሬ፥ የነጦፋዊው የበዓና ልጅ ሔሌድ፥

verses.en: Ithai the son of Ribai of Gibeah, that pertained to the children of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,
verses.fr: Ithaï, fils de Ribaï, de Guibea des fils de Benjamin. Benaja, de Pirathon.
verses.am: ከብንያም ወገን ከግብዓ የሪባይ ልጅ ኤታይ፥

verses.en: Hurai of the brooks of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,
verses.fr: Huraï, de Nachalé-Gaasch. Abiel, d''Araba.
verses.am: ጲርዓቶናዊው በናያስ፥ የገዓስ ወንዝ ሰው ኡሪ፥

verses.en: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,
verses.fr: Azmaveth, de Bacharum. Eliachba, de Schaalbon.
verses.am: ዓረባዊው አቢኤል፥ ባሕሩማዊው ዓዝሞት፥

verses.en: The sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan the son of Shage the Hararite,
verses.fr: Bené-Haschem, de Guizon. Jonathan, fils de Schagué, d''Harar.
verses.am: ሰዓልቦናዊው ኤሊያሕባ፥ የጊዞናዊው የአሳን ልጆች፥ የሃራራዊው የሻጌ ልጅ ዮናታን፥

verses.en: Ahiam the son of Sacar the Hararite, Eliphal the son of Ur,
verses.fr: Achiam, fils de Sacar, d''Harar. Eliphal, fils d''Ur.
verses.am: የአሮዳዊው የአራር ልጅ አምናን፥

verses.en: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,
verses.fr: Hépher, de Mekéra. Achija, de Palon.
verses.am: የኡር ልጅ ኤሊፋል፥ ሚኬራታዊው ኦፌር፥

verses.en: Hezro the Carmelite, Naarai the son of Ezbai,
verses.fr: Hetsro, de Carmel. Naaraï, fils d''Ezbaï.
verses.am: ፍሎናዊው አኪያ፥ ቀርሜሎሳዊው ሐጽሮ፥ የኤዝባይ ልጅ ነዕራይ፥

verses.en: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar the son of Haggeri,
verses.fr: Joël, frère de Nathan. Mibchar, fils d''Hagri.
verses.am: የናታንም ወንድም ኢዮኤል፥ የሐግሪ ልጅ ሚብሐር፥

verses.en: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Berothite, the armourbearer of Joab the son of Zeruiah,
verses.fr: Tsélek, l''Ammonite. Nachraï, de Béroth, qui portait les armes de Joab, fils de Tseruja.
verses.am: አሞናዊው ጼሌቅ፥ የጽሩያ ልጅ የኢዮአብ ጋሻ ጃግሬ ቤሮታዊው ነሃራይ፥

verses.en: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,
verses.fr: Ira, de Jéther. Gareb, de Jéther.
verses.am: ይትራዊው ዒራስ፥ ይትራዊው ጋሬብ፥

verses.en: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad the son of Ahlai,
verses.fr: Urie, le Héthien. Zabad, fils d''Achlaï.
verses.am: ኬጢያዊው ኦርዮ፥ የአሕላይ ልጅ ዛባድ፥

verses.en: Adina the son of Shiza the Reubenite, a captain of the Reubenites, and thirty with him,
verses.fr: Adina, fils de Schiza, le Rubénite, chef des Rubénites, et trente avec lui.
verses.am: የሮቤላዊው የሺዛ ልጅ ዓዲና፥ እርሱ የሮቤላውያን አለቃ ነበረ፥

verses.en: Hanan the son of Maachah, and Joshaphat the Mithnite,
verses.fr: Hanan, fils de Maaca. Josaphat, de Mithni.
verses.am: ከእርሱም ጋር ሠላሳ ሰዎች ነበሩ፥ የማዕካ ልጅ ሐናን፥ ሚትናዊው ኢዮሣፍጥ፥

verses.en: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jehiel the sons of Hothan the Aroerite,
verses.fr: Ozias, d''Aschtharoth. Schama et Jehiel, fils de Hotham, d''Aroër.
verses.am: አስታሮታዊው ዖዝያ፥ የአሮኤራዊው የኮታም ልጆች ሻማና ይዒኤል፥

verses.en: Jediael the son of Shimri, and Joha his brother, the Tizite,
verses.fr: Jediaël, fils de Schimri. Jocha, son frère, le Thitsite.
verses.am: የሽምሪ ልጅ ይድኤል፥ ወንድሙም ይድኤል፥ ወንድሙም ቲዳዊው ዮሐ፥

verses.en: Eliel the Mahavite, and Jeribai, and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam, and Ithmah the Moabite,
verses.fr: Eliel, de Machavim, Jeribaï et Joschavia, fils d''Elnaam. Jithma, le Moabite.
verses.am: መሐዋዊው ኤሊኤል፥ ይሪባይ፥ ዮሻዊያ፥ የኤልናዓም ልጆች፥ ሞዓባዊው ይትማ፥

verses.en: Eliel, and Obed, and Jasiel the Mesobaite.
verses.fr: Eliel, Obed et Jaasiel-Metsobaja.
verses.am: ኤልኤል፥ ዖቤድ፥ ምጾባዊው የዕሢኤል።

verses.en: Now these are they that came to David to Ziklag, while he yet kept himself close because of Saul the son of Kish: and they were among the mighty men, helpers of the war.
verses.fr: Voici ceux qui se rendirent auprès de David à Tsiklag, lorsqu''il était encore éloigné de la présence de Saül, fils de Kis. Ils faisaient partie des vaillants hommes qui lui prêtèrent leur secours pendant la guerre.
verses.am: በጺቅላግም ከቂስ ልጅ ከሳኦል በተሸሸገ ጊዜ ወደ ዳዊት የመጡ እነዚህ ናቸው፤ በሰልፍም ባገዙት ኃያላን መካከል ነበሩ።

verses.en: They were armed with bows, and could use both the right hand and the left in hurling stones and shooting arrows out of a bow, even of Saul's brethren of Benjamin.
verses.fr: C''étaient des archers, lançant des pierres de la main droite et de la main gauche, et tirant des flèches avec leur arc: ils étaient de Benjamin, du nombre des frères de Saül.
verses.am: ቀስተኞችም ነበሩ፥ በቀኝና በግራም እጃቸው ድንጋይ ሊወነጭፉ ፍላጻም ሊወረውሩ ይችሉ ነበር፤ ከብንያም ወገን የሳኦል ወንድሞች ነበሩ።

verses.en: The chief was Ahiezer, then Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; and Jeziel, and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth; and Berachah, and Jehu the Antothite.
verses.fr: Le chef Achiézer et Joas, fils de Schemaa, de Guibea; Jeziel, et Péleth, fils d''Azmaveth; Beraca; Jéhu, d''Anathoth;
verses.am: አለቃቸው አሒዔዝር ነበረ፥ ከእርሱም በኋላ ኢዮአስ፥ የጊብዓዊው የሸማዓ ልጆች፤ ይዝኤል፥ ፋሌጥ፥ የዓዝሞት ልጆች፤ በራኪያ፥ ዓናቶታዊው ኢዩ፥

verses.en: And Ismaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty man among the thirty, and over the thirty; and Jeremiah, and Jahaziel, and Johanan, and Josabad the Gederathite,
verses.fr: Jischmaeja, de Gabaon, vaillant parmi les trente et chef des trente; Jérémie; Jachaziel; Jochanan; Jozabad, de Guedéra;
verses.am: ገባዖናዊው ሰማያስ፥ እርሱ በሠላሳው መካከልና በሠላሳው ላይ ኃያል ሰው ነበረ፤ ኤርምያስ፥ የሕዚኤል፥ ዮሐናን፥

verses.en: Eluzai, and Jerimoth, and Bealiah, and Shemariah, and Shephatiah the Haruphite,
verses.fr: Eluzaï; Jerimoth; Bealia; Schemaria; Schephathia, de Haroph;
verses.am: ገድሮታዊው ዮዛባት፥ ኤሉዛይ፥ ኢያሪሙት፥ በዓልያ፥ ሰማራያ፥ ሀሩፋዊው ሰፋጥያስ፥

verses.en: Elkanah, and Jesiah, and Azareel, and Joezer, and Jashobeam, the Korhites,
verses.fr: Elkana, Jischija, Azareel, Joézer et Jaschobeam, Koréites;
verses.am: ቆርያውያን ሕልቃና፥ ይሺያ፥ አዛርኤል፥ ዮዛር፥ ያሾቢአም፤

verses.en: And Joelah, and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham of Gedor.
verses.fr: Joéla et Zebadia, fils de Jerocham, de Guedor.
verses.am: የጌዶር ሰው የይሮሃም ልጆች የኤላ፥ ዝባድያ

verses.en: And of the Gadites there separated themselves unto David into the hold to the wilderness men of might, and men of war fit for the battle, that could handle shield and buckler, whose faces were like the faces of lions, and were as swift as the roes upon the mountains;
verses.fr: Parmi les Gadites, des hommes vaillants partirent pour se rendre auprès de David dans la forteresse du désert, des soldats exercés à la guerre, armés du bouclier et de la lance, semblables à des lions, et aussi prompts que des gazelles sur les montagnes.
verses.am: ዳዊትም ከምድረ በዳ ውስጥ ባለችው በአንባይቱ ሳለ ከጋድ ወገን የሆኑ እነዚህ ጋሻና ጦር የሚይዙ፥ ጽኑዓን ኃያላን፥ ሰልፈኞች፥ ወደ እርሱ ተጠጉ፤ ፊታቸውም እንደ አንበሳ ፊት ነበረ፥ በተራራም ላይ እንደሚዘልል ሚዳቋ ፈጣኖች ነበሩ።

verses.en: Ezer the first, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third,
verses.fr: Ezer, le chef; Abdias, le second; Eliab, le troisième;
verses.am: አለቃው ዔጼር፥ ሁለተኛው አብድዩ፥

verses.en: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,
verses.fr: Mischmanna, le quatrième; Jérémie, le cinquième;
verses.am: ሦስተኛው ኤልያብ፥ አራተኛው መስመና፥

verses.en: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,
verses.fr: Attaï, le sixième; Eliel, le septième;
verses.am: አምስተኛው ኤርምያስ፥ ስድስተኛው አታይ፥

verses.en: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,
verses.fr: Jochanan, le huitième; Elzabad, le neuvième;
verses.am: ሰባተኛው ኤሊኤል፥ ስምንተኛው ዮሐናን፥

verses.en: Jeremiah the tenth, Machbanai the eleventh.
verses.fr: Jérémie, le dixième; Macbannaï, le onzième.
verses.am: ዘጠነኛው ኤልዛባድ፥ አሥረኛው ኤርምያስ፥ አሥራ አንደኛው መክበናይ።

verses.en: These were of the sons of Gad, captains of the host: one of the least was over an hundred, and the greatest over a thousand.
verses.fr: C''étaient des fils de Gad, chefs de l''armée; un seul, le plus petit, pouvait s''attaquer à cent hommes, et le plus grand à mille.
verses.am: እነዚህ የጋድ ልጆች የጭፍራ አለቆች ነበሩ፤ ከእነርሱም ታናሹ ከመቶ፥ ታላቁ ከሺህ ይመዛዘኑ ነበር።

verses.en: These are they that went over Jordan in the first month, when it had overflown all his banks; and they put to flight all them of the valleys, both toward the east, and toward the west.
verses.fr: Voilà ceux qui passèrent le Jourdain au premier mois, lorsqu''il débordait sur toutes ses rives, et qui mirent en fuite tous les habitants des vallées, à l''orient et à l''occident.
verses.am: በመጀመሪያው ወር ዮርዳኖስ ከዳር እስከ ዳር ሞልቶ በነበረ ጊዜ የተሻገሩት እነዚህ ናቸው፤ በሸለቆውም ውስጥ በምሥራቅና በምዕራብ በኩል የተቀመጡትን ሁሉ አባረሩ።

verses.en: And there came of the children of Benjamin and Judah to the hold unto David.
verses.fr: Il y eut aussi des fils de Benjamin et de Juda qui se rendirent auprès de David dans la forteresse.
verses.am: ዳዊትም ወደነበረባት ወደ አምባይቱ ከብንያምና ከይሁዳ ወገን ሰዎች መጡ።

verses.en: And David went out to meet them, and answered and said unto them, If ye be come peaceably unto me to help me, mine heart shall be knit unto you: but if ye be come to betray me to mine enemies, seeing there is no wrong in mine hands, the God of our fathers look thereon, and rebuke it.
verses.fr: David sortit au-devant d''eux, et leur adressa la parole, en disant: Si vous venez à moi dans de bonnes intentions pour me secourir, mon coeur s''unira à vous; mais si c''est pour me tromper au profit de mes ennemis, quand je ne commets aucune violence, que le Dieu de nos pères le voie et qu''il fasse justice!
verses.am: ዳዊትም ሊገናኛቸው ወጥቶ። ትረዱኝ ዘንድ በሠላም ወደ እኔ መጥታችሁ እንደ ሆነ ልቤ ከእናንተ ጋር አንድ ይሆናል፤ ለጠላቶቼ አሳልፋችሁ ልትሰጡኝ መጥታችሁ እንደሆነ ግን፥ በእጄ ዓመፅ የለብኝምና የአባቶቻችን አምላክ ይመልከተው፥ ይፍረደውም አላቸው።

verses.en: Then the spirit came upon Amasai, who was chief of the captains, and he said, Thine are we, David, and on thy side, thou son of Jesse: peace, peace be unto thee, and peace be to thine helpers; for thy God helpeth thee. Then David received them, and made them captains of the band.
verses.fr: Amasaï, l''un des principaux officiers, fut revêtu de l''esprit, et dit: Nous sommes à toi, David, et avec toi, fils d''Isaï! Paix, paix à toi, et paix à ceux qui te secourent, car ton Dieu t''a secouru! Et David les accueillit, et les plaça parmi les chefs de la troupe.
verses.am: መንፈስም በሠላሳው አለቃ በአማሳይ ላይ መጣ፥ እርሱም። ዳዊት ሆይ፥ እኛ የአንተ ነን፤ የእሴል ልጅ ሆይ፥ እኛ ከአንተ ጋር ነን፤ አምላክህ ይረዳሃልና ሰላም ሰላም ለአንተ ይሁን፥ ለሚረዱህም ሰላም ይሁን አለ። ዳዊትም ተቀበላቸው፥ የጭፍራም አለቆች አደረጋቸው።

verses.en: And there fell some of Manasseh to David, when he came with the Philistines against Saul to battle: but they helped them not: for the lords of the Philistines upon advisement sent him away, saying, He will fall to his master Saul to the jeopardy of our heads.
verses.fr: Des hommes de Manassé se joignirent à David, lorsqu''il alla faire la guerre à Saül avec les Philistins. Mais ils ne furent pas en aide aux Philistins; car, après s''être consultés, les princes des Philistins renvoyèrent David, en disant: Il passerait du côté de son maître Saül, au péril de nos têtes.
verses.am: ዳዊትም ከፍልስጥኤማውያን ጋር ሳኦልን ሊወጋ በመጣ ጊዜ ከምናሴ ወገን ሰዎች ወደ ዳዊት ከዱ፤ የፍልስጥኤማውያን አለቆች ግን። በራሳችን ላይ ጕዳት አድርጎ ወደ ጌታው ወደ ሳኦል ይመለሳል ሲሉ ተማክረው ሰድደውታልና እነርሱ አልረዷቸውም።

verses.en: As he went to Ziklag, there fell to him of Manasseh, Adnah, and Jozabad, and Jediael, and Michael, and Jozabad, and Elihu, and Zilthai, captains of the thousands that were of Manasseh.
verses.fr: Quand il retourna à Tsiklag, voici ceux de Manassé qui se joignirent à lui: Adnach, Jozabad, Jediaël, Micaël, Jozabad, Elihu et Tsilthaï, chefs des milliers de Manassé.
verses.am: ወደ ጺቅላግም ሲሄድ ከምናሴ ወገን የምናሴ ሻለቆች የነበሩ ዓድና፥ ዮዛባት፥ ይዲኤል፥ ሚካኤል፥ ዮዛባት፥ ኤሊሁ፥ ጺልታይ ወደ እርሱ ከዱ።

verses.en: And they helped David against the band of the rovers: for they were all mighty men of valour, and were captains in the host.
verses.fr: Ils prêtèrent leur secours à David contre la troupe des pillards Amalécites , car ils étaient tous de vaillants hommes, et ils furent chefs dans l''armée.
verses.am: ሁሉም ጽኑዓን ኃያላንና በሠራዊቱ ላይ አለቆች ነበሩና በአደጋ ጣዮቹ ላይ ዳዊትን አገዙት።

verses.en: For at that time day by day there came to David to help him, until it was a great host, like the host of God.
verses.fr: Et de jour en jour des gens arrivaient auprès de David pour le secourir, jusqu''à ce qu''il eût un grand camp, comme un camp de Dieu.
verses.am: እንደ እግዚአብሔርም ሠራዊት ታላቅ ሠራዊት እስኪሆን ድረስ ዳዊትን ለመርዳት ዕለት ዕለት ይመጡ ነበር።

verses.en: And these are the numbers of the bands that were ready armed to the war, and came to David to Hebron, to turn the kingdom of Saul to him, according to the word of the Lord.
verses.fr: Voici le nombre des hommes armés pour la guerre qui se rendirent auprès de David à Hébron, afin de lui transférer la royauté de Saül, selon l''ordre de l''Eternel.
verses.am: እንደ እግዚአብሔርም ቃል የሳኦልን መንግሥት ወደ እርሱ ይመልሱ ዘንድ በኬብሮን ሳለ ወደ ዳዊት የመጡት የሠራዊቱ አለቆች ቍጥር ይህ ነው።

verses.en: The children of Judah that bare shield and spear were six thousand and eight hundred, ready armed to the war.
verses.fr: Fils de Juda, portant le bouclier et la lance, six mille huit cents, armés pour la guerre.
verses.am: ጋሻና ጦር ተሸክመው ለሰልፍ የተዘጋጁ የይሁዳ ልጆች ስድስት ሺህ ስምንት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.en: Of the children of Simeon, mighty men of valour for the war, seven thousand and one hundred.
verses.fr: Des fils de Siméon, hommes vaillants à la guerre, sept mille cent.
verses.am: ለሰልፍ ጽኑዓን ኃያላን ሰዎች የነበሩ የስምዖን ልጆች ሰባት ሺህ አንድ መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.en: Of the children of Levi four thousand and six hundred.
verses.fr: Des fils de Lévi, quatre mille six cents;
verses.am: የሌዊ ልጆች አራት ሺህ ስድስት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And Jehoiada was the leader of the Aaronites, and with him were three thousand and seven hundred;
verses.fr: et Jehojada, prince d''Aaron, et avec lui trois mille sept cents;
verses.am: የአሮንም ቤት አለቃ ዮዳሄ ነበረ፥ ከእርሱም ጋር ሦስት ሺህ ሰባት መቶ ነበሩ፤

verses.en: And Zadok, a young man mighty of valour, and of his father's house twenty and two captains.
verses.fr: et Tsadok, vaillant jeune homme, et la maison de son père, vingt-deux chefs.
verses.am: ከእርሱም ጋር ጽኑዕ ኃያል ጕልማሳ ሳዶቅ ነበረ፥ ከአባቱም ቤት ሃያ ሁለት አለቆች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And of the children of Benjamin, the kindred of Saul, three thousand: for hitherto the greatest part of them had kept the ward of the house of Saul.
verses.fr: Des fils de Benjamin, frères de Saül, trois mille; car jusqu''alors la plus grande partie d''entre eux étaient restés fidèles à la maison de Saül.
verses.am: የሳኦልም ወንድሞች ከሆኑ ከብንያም ወንድሞች የሚበልጠው ክፍል እስከዚያ ዘመን ድረስ የሳኦልን ቤት ይከተል ነበርና ከእነርሱ ዘንድ የመጡ ሦስት ሺህ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And of the children of Ephraim twenty thousand and eight hundred, mighty men of valour, famous throughout the house of their fathers.
verses.fr: Des fils d''Ephraïm, vingt mille huit cents, hommes vaillants, gens de renom, d''après les maisons de leurs pères.
verses.am: ጽኑዓን ኃያላን የሆኑ በአባቶቻቸውም ቤት የታወቁ የኤፍሬም ልጆች ሀያ ሺህ ስምንት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And of the half tribe of Manasseh eighteen thousand, which were expressed by name, to come and make David king.
verses.fr: De la demi-tribu de Manassé, dix-huit mille, qui furent nominativement désignés pour aller établir roi David.
verses.am: በየስማቸውም የተጻፉ ዳዊትን ያነግሡት ዘንድ የመጡ የምናሴ ነገድ እኵሌታ አሥራ ስምንት ሺህ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And of the children of Issachar, which were men that had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do; the heads of them were two hundred; and all their brethren were at their commandment.
verses.fr: Des fils d''Issacar, ayant l''intelligence des temps pour savoir ce que devait faire Israël, deux cents chefs, et tous leurs frères sous leurs ordres.
verses.am: እስራኤልም የሚገባውን ያደርግ ዘንድ ዘመኑን የሚያውቁ ጥበበኞች ሰዎች የይሳኮር ልጆች አለቆች ሁለት መቶ ነበሩ፤ ወንድሞቻቸውም ሁሉ ይታዘዙአቸው ነበር።

verses.en: Of Zebulun, such as went forth to battle, expert in war, with all instruments of war, fifty thousand, which could keep rank: they were not of double heart.
verses.fr: De Zabulon, cinquante mille, en état d''aller à l''armée, munis pour le combat de toutes les armes de guerre, et prêts à livrer bataille d''un coeur résolu.
verses.am: በጭፍራውም ውስጥ የወጡ ለሰልፍም የተዘጋጁ፥ የማያመነቱ፥ መሣሪያም ሁሉ የያዙ የዛብሎን ሰዎች አምሳ ሺህ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And of Naphtali a thousand captains, and with them with shield and spear thirty and seven thousand.
verses.fr: De Nephthali, mille chefs, et avec eux trente-sept mille, portant le bouclier et la lance.
verses.am: የንፍታሌምም አለቆች አንድ ሺህ ነበሩ፥ ከእነርሱም ጋር ጋሻና ጦር የሚይዙ ሠላሳ ሰባት ሺህ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And of the Danites expert in war twenty and eight thousand and six hundred.
verses.fr: Des Danites, armés pour la guerre, vingt-huit mille six cents.
verses.am: ለሰልፍም የተዘጋጁ የዳን ሰዎች ሃያ ስምንት ሺህ ስድስት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And of Asher, such as went forth to battle, expert in war, forty thousand.
verses.fr: D''Aser, en état d''aller à l''armée et prêts à combattre: quarante mille.
verses.am: በጭፍራውም ውስጥ የሚወጡ፥ ለሰልፍም የተዘጋጁ የአሴር ሰዎች አርባ ሺህ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And on the other side of Jordan, of the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and of the half tribe of Manasseh, with all manner of instruments of war for the battle, an hundred and twenty thousand.
verses.fr: Et de l''autre côté du Jourdain, des Rubénites, des Gadites, et de la demi-tribu de Manassé, avec toutes les armes de guerre, cent vingt mille.
verses.am: በዮርዳኖስም ማዶ ካሉ ከሮቤልና ከጋድ ሰዎች ከምናሴም ነገድ እኵሌታ መሣሪያን ሁሉ ይዘው የመጡ መቶ ሀያ ሺህ ነበሩ።

verses.en: All these men of war, that could keep rank, came with a perfect heart to Hebron, to make David king over all Israel: and all the rest also of Israel were of one heart to make David king.
verses.fr: Tous ces hommes, gens de guerre, prêts à combattre, arrivèrent à Hébron en sincérité de coeur pour établir David roi sur tout Israël. Et tout le reste d''Israël était également unanime pour faire régner David.
verses.am: እነዚህ ሁሉ ዳዊትን በእስራኤል ሁሉ ላይ ያነግሡት ዘንድ አርበኞችና ሰልፈኞች እየሆኑ በፍጹም ልባቸው ወደ ኬብሮን መጡ፤ ደግሞም ከእስራኤል የቀሩት ሁሉ ዳዊትን ያነግሡት ዘንድ አንድ ልብ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And there they were with David three days, eating and drinking: for their brethren had prepared for them.
verses.fr: Ils furent là trois jours avec David, mangeant et buvant, car leurs frères leur avaient préparé des vivres.
verses.am: ወንድሞቻቸውም አዘጋጅተውላቸው ነበርና እየበሉና እየጠጡ በዚያ ከዳዊት ጋር ሦስት ቀን ተቀመጡ።

verses.en: Moreover they that were nigh them, even unto Issachar and Zebulun and Naphtali, brought bread on asses, and on camels, and on mules, and on oxen, and meat, meal, cakes of figs, and bunches of raisins, and wine, and oil, and oxen, and sheep abundantly: for there was joy in Israel.
verses.fr: Et même ceux qui habitaient près d''eux jusqu''à Issacar, à Zabulon et à Nephthali, apportaient des aliments sur des ânes, sur des chameaux, sur des mulets et sur des boeufs, des mets de farine, des masses de figues sèches et de raisins secs, du vin, de l''huile, des boeufs et des brebis en abondance, car Israël était dans la joie.
verses.am: ደግሞም በእስራኤል ዘንድ ደስታ ሆኖአልና እስከ ይሳኮርና እስከ ዛብሎን እስከ ንፍታሌምም ድረስ ለእርሱ አቅራቢያ የነበሩ በአህያና በግመል በበቅሎና በበሬ ላይ እንጀራና ዱቄት የበለስ ጥፍጥፍና የዘቢበ ዘለላ የወይንም ጠጅ ዘይትም በሬዎችንና በጎችንም በብዙ አድርገው ያመጡ ነበር።

verses.en: And David consulted with the captains of thousands and hundreds, and with every leader.
verses.fr: David tint conseil avec les chefs de milliers et de centaines, avec tous les princes.
verses.am: ዳዊትም ከሻለቆችና ከመቶ አለቆች ከአለቆቹም ሁሉ ጋር ተማከረ።

verses.en: And David said unto all the congregation of Israel, If it seem good unto you, and that it be of the Lord our God, let us send abroad unto our brethren every where, that are left in all the land of Israel, and with them also to the priests and Levites which are in their cities and suburbs, that they may gather themselves unto us:
verses.fr: Et David dit à toute l''assemblée d''Israël: Si vous le trouvez bon, et si cela vient de l''Eternel, notre Dieu, envoyons de tous côtés vers nos frères qui restent dans toutes les contrées d''Israël, et aussi vers les sacrificateurs et les Lévites dans les villes où sont leurs banlieues, afin qu''ils se réunissent à nous,
verses.am: ዳዊትም የእስራኤልን ጉባኤ ሁሉ። መልካም መስሎ የታያችሁ እንደሆነ፥ ከአምላካችን ከእግዚአብሔርም ወጥቶ እንደ ሆነ፥ በእስራኤል አገር ሁሉ ለቀሩት ወንድሞቻችን በከተሞቻቸውና በመሰምሪያዎቻቸውም ለሚቀመጡ ካህናትና ሌዋውያን ወደ እኛ ይሰበሰቡ ዘንድ እንላክ፤

verses.en: And let us bring again the ark of our God to us: for we enquired not at it in the days of Saul.
verses.fr: et ramenons auprès de nous l''arche de notre Dieu, car nous ne nous en sommes pas occupés du temps de Saül.
verses.am: በሳኦልም ዘመን አልፈለግነውምና የአምላካችንን ታቦት ወደ እኛ እንመልስ አላቸው።

verses.en: And all the congregation said that they would do so: for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people.
verses.fr: Toute l''assemblée décida de faire ainsi, car la chose parut convenable à tout le peuple.
verses.am: ነገሩም በሕዝቡ ሁሉ ዓይን ዘንድ ቅን ነበረና ጉባኤው ሁሉ። እንዲሁ እናደርጋለን አሉ።

verses.en: So David gathered all Israel together, from Shihor of Egypt even unto the entering of Hemath, to bring the ark of God from Kirjathjearim.
verses.fr: David assembla tout Israël, depuis le Schichor d''Egypte jusqu''à l''entrée de Hamath, pour faire venir de Kirjath-Jearim l''arche de Dieu.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርንም ታቦት ከቂርያትይዓሪም ያመጡ ዘንድ ዳዊት እስራኤልን ሁሉ ከግብጽ ወንዝ ከሺሖር ጀምሮ እስከ ሐማት መግቢያ ድረስ ሰበሰበ።

verses.en: And David went up, and all Israel, to Baalah, that is, to Kirjathjearim, which belonged to Judah, to bring up thence the ark of God the Lord, that dwelleth between the cherubims, whose name is called on it.
verses.fr: Et David, avec tout Israël, monta à Baala, à Kirjath-Jearim, qui est à Juda, pour faire monter de là l''arche de Dieu, devant laquelle est invoqué le nom de l''Eternel qui réside entre les chérubins.
verses.am: ዳዊትም እስራኤልም ሁሉ በኪሩቤል ላይ የተቀመጠውን ስሙም በእርሱ የተጠራውን የአምላክን የእግዚአብሔርን ታቦት ከዚያ ያወጡ ዘንድ በይሁዳ ወዳለችው ቂርያትይዓሪም ወደ ተባለች ወደ በኣላ ሄዱ።

verses.en: And they carried the ark of God in a new cart out of the house of Abinadab: and Uzza and Ahio drave the cart.
verses.fr: Ils mirent sur un char neuf l''arche de Dieu, qu''ils emportèrent de la maison d''Abinadab: Uzza et Achjo conduisaient le char.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርንም ታቦት በአዲስ ሰረገላ ላይ ጫኑት፥ ከአሚናዳብም ቤት አመጡት፤ ዖዛና አሒዮም ሠረገላውን ይነዱ ነበር።

verses.en: And David and all Israel played before God with all their might, and with singing, and with harps, and with psalteries, and with timbrels, and with cymbals, and with trumpets.
verses.fr: David et tout Israël dansaient devant Dieu de toute leur force, en chantant, et en jouant des harpes, des luths, des tambourins, des cymbales et des trompettes.
verses.am: ዳዊትና እስራኤል ሁሉ በቅኔና በበገና በመሰንቆና በከበሮ በጸናጽልና በመለከት በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በሙሉ ኃይላቸው ይጫወቱ ነበር።

verses.en: And when they came unto the threshingfloor of Chidon, Uzza put forth his hand to hold the ark; for the oxen stumbled.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''ils furent arrivés à l''aire de Kidon, Uzza étendit la main pour saisir l''arche, parce que les boeufs la faisaient pencher.
verses.am: ወደ ኪዶንም አውድማ በደረሱ ጊዜ በሬዎቹ ይፋንኑ ነበርና ታቦቱን ሊይዝ ዖዛ እጁን ዘረጋ።

verses.en: And the anger of the Lord was kindled against Uzza, and he smote him, because he put his hand to the ark: and there he died before God.
verses.fr: La colère de l''Eternel s''enflamma contre Uzza, et l''Eternel le frappa parce qu''il avait étendu la main sur l''arche. Uzza mourut là, devant Dieu.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቍጣ በዖዛ ላይ ነደደ፥ እጁንም ወደ ታቦቱ ስለ ዘረጋ ቀሠፈው፤ በዚያም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ሞተ።

verses.en: And David was displeased, because the Lord had made a breach upon Uzza: wherefore that place is called Perezuzza to this day.
verses.fr: David fut irrité de ce que l''Eternel avait frappé Uzza d''un tel châtiment. Et ce lieu a été appelé jusqu''à ce jour Pérets-Uzza.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ዖዛን ስለ ቀሠፈው ዳዊት አዘነ፤ እስከ ዛሬም ድረስ የዚያን ስፍራ ስም የዖዛ ስብራት ብሎ ጠራው።

verses.en: And David was afraid of God that day, saying, How shall I bring the ark of God home to me?
verses.fr: David eut peur de Dieu en ce jour-là, et il dit: Comment ferais-je entrer chez moi l''arche de Dieu?
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን ዳዊት። የእግዚአብሔርን ታቦት ወደ እኔ እንዴት አመጣለሁ ብሎ እግዚአብሔርን ፈራ።

verses.en: So David brought not the ark home to himself to the city of David, but carried it aside into the house of Obededom the Gittite.
verses.fr: David ne retira pas l''arche chez lui dans la cité de David, et il la fit conduire dans la maison d''Obed-Edom de Gath.
verses.am: ዳዊትም ታቦቱን ወደ ጌት ሰው ወደ አቢዳራ ቤት አሳለፈው እንጂ ወደ እርሱ ወደ ዳዊት ከተማ አላመጣውም።

verses.en: And the ark of God remained with the family of Obededom in his house three months. And the Lord blessed the house of Obededom, and all that he had.
verses.fr: L''arche de Dieu resta trois mois dans la maison d''Obed-Edom, dans sa maison. Et l''Eternel bénit la maison d''Obed-Edom et tout ce qui lui appartenait.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ታቦት በአቢዳራ ቤተሰብ ዘንድ በቤቱ ውስጥ ሦስት ወር ተቀመጠ፤ እግዚአብሔርም የአቢዳራን ቤትና ያለውን ሁሉ ባረከ።

verses.en: Now Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and timber of cedars, with masons and carpenters, to build him an house.
verses.fr: Hiram, roi de Tyr, envoya des messagers à David, et du bois de cèdre, et des tailleurs de pierres et des charpentiers, pour lui bâtir une maison.
verses.am: የጢሮስም ንጉሥ ኪራም ቤት ይሠሩለት ዘንድ መልእክተኞችን የዝግባ እንጨትንም ጠራቢዎችንም አናጢዎችንም ወደ ዳዊት ላከ።

verses.en: And David perceived that the Lord had confirmed him king over Israel, for his kingdom was lifted up on high, because of his people Israel.
verses.fr: David reconnut que l''Eternel l''affermissait comme roi d''Israël, et que son royaume était haut élevé, à cause de son peuple d''Israël.
verses.am: ስለ ሕዝቡም ስለ እስራኤል መንግሥቱ ከፍ ብሎአልና እግዚአብሔር በእስራኤል ላይ ንጉሥ አድርጎ እንዳጸናው ዳዊት አወቀ።

verses.en: And David took more wives at Jerusalem: and David begat more sons and daughters.
verses.fr: David prit encore des femmes à Jérusalem, et il engendra encore des fils et des filles.
verses.am: ዳዊትም በኢየሩሳሌም ሚስቶችን ጨምሮ ሌሎችን ወንዶችንና ሴቶችን ልጆች ወለደ።

verses.en: Now these are the names of his children which he had in Jerusalem; Shammua, and Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon,
verses.fr: Voici les noms de ceux qui lui naquirent à Jérusalem: Schammua, Schobab, Nathan, Salomon,
verses.am: በኢየሩሳሌምም የወለዳቸው የልጆቹ ስም ይህ ነው፤ ሳሙስ፥

verses.en: And Ibhar, and Elishua, and Elpalet,
verses.fr: Jibhar, Elischua, Elphéleth,
verses.am: ሶባብ፥ ናታን፥ ሰሎሞን፥ ኢያቤሐር፥ ኤሊሱዔ፥

verses.en: And Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,
verses.fr: Noga, Népheg, Japhia,
verses.am: ኤሊፋላት፥ ኖጋ፥ ናፌቅ፥ ያፍያ፥

verses.en: And Elishama, and Beeliada, and Eliphalet.
verses.fr: Elischama, Beéliada et Eliphéleth.
verses.am: ኤሊሳማ፥ ኤሊዳሄ፥ ኤሊፋላት።

verses.en: And when the Philistines heard that David was anointed king over all Israel, all the Philistines went up to seek David. And David heard of it, and went out against them.
verses.fr: Les Philistins apprirent que David avait été oint pour roi sur tout Israël, et ils montèrent tous à sa recherche. David, qui en fut informé, sortit au-devant d''eux.
verses.am: ፍልስጥኤማውያንም ዳዊት በእስራኤል ሁሉ ላይ ንጉሥ ሆኖ እንደተቀባ ሰሙ፥ ፍልስጥኤማውያንም ሁሉ ዳዊትን ሊፈልጉ ወጡ፤ ዳዊትም በሰማ ጊዜ ሊጋጠማቸው ወጣ።

verses.en: And the Philistines came and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.
verses.fr: Les Philistins arrivèrent, et se répandirent dans la vallée des Rephaïm.
verses.am: ፍልስጥኤማውያንም መጥተው በራፋይም ሸለቆ አደጋ ጣሉ።

verses.en: And David enquired of God, saying, Shall I go up against the Philistines? And wilt thou deliver them into mine hand? And the Lord said unto him, Go up; for I will deliver them into thine hand.
verses.fr: David consulta Dieu, en disant: Monterai-je contre les Philistins, et les livreras-tu entre mes mains? Et l''Eternel lui dit: Monte, et je les livrerai entre tes mains.
verses.am: ዳዊትም። ወደ ፍልስጥኤማውያን ልውጣን? በእጄስ አሳልፈህ ትሰጣቸዋለህን? ብሎ እግዚአብሔርን ጠየቀ። እግዚአብሔርም። በእጅህ አሳልፌ እሰጣቸዋለሁና ውጣ አለው።

verses.en: So they came up to Baalperazim; and David smote them there. Then David said, God hath broken in upon mine enemies by mine hand like the breaking forth of waters: therefore they called the name of that place Baalperazim.
verses.fr: Ils montèrent à Baal-Peratsim, où David les battit. Puis il dit: Dieu a dispersé mes ennemis par ma main, comme des eaux qui s''écoulent. C''est pourquoi l''on a donné à ce lieu le nom de Baal-Peratsim.
verses.am: ወደ በአልፐራሲም ወጡ፥ በዚያም ዳዊት መታቸው። ዳዊትም። ውኃ እንዲያፈርስ እግዚአብሔር ጠላቶቼን በእጄ አፈረሳቸው አለ። ስለዚህም የዚያን ስፍራ ስም በአልፐራሲም ብለው ጠሩት።

verses.en: And when they had left their gods there, David gave a commandment, and they were burned with fire.
verses.fr: Ils laissèrent là leurs dieux, qui furent brûlés au feu d''après l''ordre de David.
verses.am: አማልክቶቻቸውንም በዚያ ተዉ፤ ዳዊትም አዘዘ፥ በእሳትም አቃጠሏቸው።

verses.en: And the Philistines yet again spread themselves abroad in the valley.
verses.fr: Les Philistins se répandirent de nouveau dans la vallée.
verses.am: ፍልስጥኤማውያንም ደግሞ በሸለቆው አደጋ ጣሉ።

verses.en: Therefore David enquired again of God; and God said unto him, Go not up after them; turn away from them, and come upon them over against the mulberry trees.
verses.fr: David consulta encore Dieu. Et Dieu lui dit: Tu ne monteras pas après eux; détourne-toi d''eux, et tu arriveras sur eux vis-à-vis des mûriers.
verses.am: ዳዊትም እንደ ገና እግዚአብሔርን ጠየቀ፤ እግዚአብሔርም። ከእነርሱ ዞረህ በሾላው ዛፍ ፊት ለፊት ግጠማቸው እንጂ ወደ እነርሱ አትውጣ።

verses.en: And it shall be, when thou shalt hear a sound of going in the tops of the mulberry trees, that then thou shalt go out to battle: for God is gone forth before thee to smite the host of the Philistines.
verses.fr: Quand tu entendras un bruit de pas dans les cimes des mûriers, alors tu sortiras pour combattre, car c''est Dieu qui marche devant toi pour battre l''armée des Philistins.
verses.am: በሾላውም ዛፍ እራስ ውስጥ የሽውሽውታ ድምፅ ስትሰማ የፍልስጥኤማውያንን ጭፍራ ሊመታ እግዚአብሔር በፊትህ ይወጣልና በዚያን ጊዜ ወደ ሰልፍ ውጣ አለው።

verses.en: David therefore did as God commanded him: and they smote the host of the Philistines from Gibeon even to Gazer.
verses.fr: David fit ce que Dieu lui avait ordonné, et l''armée des Philistins fut battue depuis Gabaon jusqu''à Guézer.
verses.am: ዳዊትም እግዚአብሔር እንዳዘዘው አደረገ፤ ከገባዖንም ጀምሮ እስከ ጌዝር ድረስ የፍልስጥኤማውያንን ጭፍራ መቱት።

verses.en: And the fame of David went out into all lands; and the Lord brought the fear of him upon all nations.
verses.fr: La renommée de David se répandit dans tous les pays, et l''Eternel le rendit redoutable à toutes les nations.
verses.am: የዳዊትም ዝና በየአገሩ ሁሉ ወጣ፤ መፈራቱንም እግዚአብሔር በአሕዛብ ሁሉ ዘንድ አደረገው።

verses.en: And David made him houses in the city of David, and prepared a place for the ark of God, and pitched for it a tent.
verses.fr: David se bâtit des maisons dans la cité de David; il prépara une place à l''arche de Dieu, et dressa pour elle une tente.
verses.am: ዳዊትም በከተማው ላይ ለራሱ ቤቶችን ሠራ፤ ለእግዚአብሔርም ታቦት ስፍራ አዘጋጀ፥ ድንኳንም ተከለለት።

verses.en: Then David said, None ought to carry the ark of God but the Levites: for them hath the Lord chosen to carry the ark of God, and to minister unto him for ever.
verses.fr: Alors David dit: L''arche de Dieu ne doit être portée que par les Lévites, car l''Eternel les a choisis pour porter l''arche de Dieu et pour en faire le service à toujours.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜም ዳዊት። የእግዚአብሔርን ታቦት ይሸከሙ ዘንድ፥ ለዘላለሙም ያገለግሉት ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር ከመረጣቸው ከሌዋውያን በቀር ማንም የእግዚአብሔርን ታቦት ይሸከም ዘንድ አይገባውም አለ።

verses.en: And David gathered all Israel together to Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the Lord unto his place, which he had prepared for it.
verses.fr: Et David assembla tout Israël à Jérusalem pour faire monter l''arche de l''Eternel à la place qu''il lui avait préparée.
verses.am: ዳዊትም ወዳዘጋጀለት ስፍራ የእግዚአብሔርን ታቦት ያመጣ ዘንድ እስራኤልን ሁሉ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ሰበሰበ።

verses.en: And David assembled the children of Aaron, and the Levites:
verses.fr: David assembla les fils d''Aaron et les Lévites:
verses.am: ዳዊትም የአሮንን ልጆችና ሌዋውያንን ሰበሰበ።

verses.en: Of the sons of Kohath; Uriel the chief, and his brethren an hundred and twenty:
verses.fr: des fils de Kehath, Uriel le chef et ses frères, cent vingt;
verses.am: ከቀዓት ልጆች፤ አለቃው ኡርኤል፥ ወንድሞቹም መቶ ሀያ፤

verses.en: Of the sons of Merari; Asaiah the chief, and his brethren two hundred and twenty:
verses.fr: des fils de Merari, Asaja le chef et ses frères, deux cent vingt;
verses.am: ከሜራሪ ልጆች፤ አለቃው ዓሣያ፥ ወንድሞቹም ሁለት መቶ ሀያ፤

verses.en: Of the sons of Gershom; Joel the chief and his brethren an hundred and thirty:
verses.fr: des fils de Guerschom, Joël le chef et ses frères, cent trente;
verses.am: ከጌድሶን ልጆች፤ አለቃው ኢዮኤል፥ ወንድሞቹም መቶ ሠላሳ፤

verses.en: Of the sons of Elizaphan; Shemaiah the chief, and his brethren two hundred:
verses.fr: des fils d''Elitsaphan, Schemaeja le chef et ses frères, deux cents;
verses.am: ከኤሊጻፋን ልጆች፤ አለቃው ሸማያ፥ ወንድሞቹም ሁለት መቶ፤

verses.en: Of the sons of Hebron; Eliel the chief, and his brethren fourscore:
verses.fr: des fils d''Hébron, Eliel le chef et ses frères, quatre-vingts;
verses.am: ከኬብሮን ልጆች፤ አለቃው ኤሊኤል፥ ወንድሞቹም ሰማንያ፤

verses.en: Of the sons of Uzziel; Amminadab the chief, and his brethren an hundred and twelve.
verses.fr: des fils d''Uziel, Amminadab le chef et ses frères, cent douze.
verses.am: ከዑዝኤል ልጆች፤ አለቃው አሚናዳብ፥ ወንድሞቹም መቶ አሥራ ሁለት።

verses.en: And David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the Levites, for Uriel, Asaiah, and Joel, Shemaiah, and Eliel, and Amminadab,
verses.fr: David appela les sacrificateurs Tsadok et Abiathar, et les Lévites Uriel, Asaja, Joël, Schemaeja, Eliel et Amminadab.
verses.am: ዳዊትም ካህናቱን ሳዶቅንና አቢያታርን፥ ሌዋውያንንም ኡርኤልን፥ ዓሣያን፥ ኢዮኤልን፥ ሸማያን፥ ኤሊኤልን፥ አሚናዳብንም ጠርቶ።

verses.en: And said unto them, Ye are the chief of the fathers of the Levites: sanctify yourselves, both ye and your brethren, that ye may bring up the ark of the Lord God of Israel unto the place that I have prepared for it.
verses.fr: Il leur dit: Vous êtes les chefs de famille des Lévites; sanctifiez-vous, vous et vos frères, et faites monter à la place que je lui ai préparée l''arche de l''Eternel, du Dieu d''Israël.
verses.am: እናንተ የሌዋውያን አባቶች ቤቶች አለቆች ናችሁ፤ ወዳዘጋጀሁለት ስፍራ የእስራኤልን አምላክ የእግዚአብሔርን ታቦት ታመጡ ዘንድ እናንተና ወንድሞቻችሁ ተቀደሱ።

verses.en: For because ye did it not at the first, the Lord our God made a breach upon us, for that we sought him not after the due order.
verses.fr: Parce que vous n''y étiez pas la première fois, l''Eternel, notre Dieu, nous a frappés; car nous ne l''avons pas cherché selon la loi.
verses.am: ቀድሞም አልተሸከማችሁምና፥ እንደ ሥርዓቱም አልፈለግነውምና አምላካችን እግዚአብሔር በመካከላችን ስብራት አደረገ አላቸው።

verses.en: So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of the Lord God of Israel.
verses.fr: Les sacrificateurs et les Lévites se sanctifièrent pour faire monter l''arche de l''Eternel, du Dieu d''Israël.
verses.am: የእስራኤልንም አምላክ የእግዚአብሔርን ታቦት ያመጡ ዘንድ ካህናቱና ሌዋውያኑ ተቀደሱ።

verses.en: And the children of the Levites bare the ark of God upon their shoulders with the staves thereon, as Moses commanded according to the word of the Lord.
verses.fr: Les fils des Lévites portèrent l''arche de Dieu sur leurs épaules avec des barres, comme Moïse l''avait ordonné d''après la parole de l''Eternel.
