verses.am: ሙሴም እንዳዘዘው እንደ እግዚአብሔር ቃል የሌዋውያን ልጆች የእግዚአብሔርን ታቦት በትከሻቸው ላይ በመሎጊያዎቹ ተሸከሙ።

verses.en: And David spake to the chief of the Levites to appoint their brethren to be the singers with instruments of musick, psalteries and harps and cymbals, sounding, by lifting up the voice with joy.
verses.fr: Et David dit aux chefs des Lévites de disposer leurs frères les chantres avec des instruments de musique, des luths, des harpes et des cymbales, qu''ils devaient faire retentir de sons éclatants en signe de réjouissance.
verses.am: ዳዊትም በዜማ ዕቃ በመሰንቆና በበገና በጸናጽልም እንዲያዜሙ፥ ድምፃቸውንም በደስታ ከፍ እንዲያደርጉ መዘምራኑን ወንድሞቻቸውን ይሾሙ ዘንድ ለሌዋውያን ኣለቆች ተናገረ።

verses.en: So the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel; and of his brethren, Asaph the son of Berechiah; and of the sons of Merari their brethren, Ethan the son of Kushaiah;
verses.fr: Les Lévites disposèrent Héman, fils de Joël; parmi ses frères, Asaph, fils de Bérékia; et parmi les fils de Merari, leurs frères, Ethan, fils de Kuschaja;
verses.am: ሌዋውያኑም የኢዮኤልን ልጅ ኤማንን፥ ከወንድሞቹም የበራክያን ልጅ አሳፍን፥ ከወንድሞቻቸውም ከሜራሪ ልጆች የቂሳን ልጅ ኤታንን፥

verses.en: And with them their brethren of the second degree, Zechariah, Ben, and Jaaziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, Eliab, and Benaiah, and Maaseiah, and Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obededom, and Jeiel, the porters.
verses.fr: puis avec eux leurs frères du second ordre Zacharie, Ben, Jaaziel, Schemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Benaja, Maaséja, Matthithia, Eliphelé et Miknéja, et Obed-Edom et Jeïel, les portiers.
verses.am: ከእነርሱም ጋር በሁለተኛው ተራ የሆኑትን ወንድሞቻቸውን ዘካርያስን፥ ቤንን፥ ያዝኤልን፥ ሰሚራሞትን፥ ይሒኤልን፥ ዑኒን፥ ኤልያብን፥ በናያስን፥ መዕሤያን፥ መቲትያን፥ ኤሊፍሌሁን፥ ሚቅንያን፥ በረኞችንም ዖቤድኤዶምንና ይዒኤልን አቆሙ።

verses.en: So the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were appointed to sound with cymbals of brass;
verses.fr: Les chantres Héman, Asaph et Ethan avaient des cymbales d''airain, pour les faire retentir.
verses.am: መዘምራንም ኤማንና አሳፍ ኤታንም በናስ ጸናጽል ከፍ አድርገው ያሰሙ ነበር።

verses.en: And Zechariah, and Aziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, and Eliab, and Maaseiah, and Benaiah, with psalteries on Alamoth;
verses.fr: Zacharie, Aziel, Schemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Maaséja et Benaja avaient des luths sur alamoth;
verses.am: ዘካርያስ፥ ዓዝዔል፥ ሰሚራሞት፥ ይሒኤል፥ ዑኒ፥ ኤልያብ፥ መዕሤያ፥ በናያስ በመሰንቆ ምሥጢር ነገር ያዜሙ ነበር።

verses.en: And Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obededom, and Jeiel, and Azaziah, with harps on the Sheminith to excel.
verses.fr: et Matthithia, Eliphelé, Miknéja, Obed-Edom, Jeïel et Azazia, avaient des harpes à huit cordes, pour conduire le chant.
verses.am: መቲትያ፥ ኤልፍሌሁ፥ ሚቅኒያ፥ ዖቤድኤዶም፥ ይዒኤል፥ ዓዛዝያ ስምንት አውታር ባለው በገና ይዘምሩ ነበር።

verses.en: And Chenaniah, chief of the Levites, was for song: he instructed about the song, because he was skilful.
verses.fr: Kenania, chef de musique parmi les Lévites, dirigeait la musique, car il était habile.
verses.am: የሌዋውያኑም አለቃ ክናንያ በዜማ ላይ ተሹሞ ነበር። ብልሃተኛ ነበረና ዜማ ያስተምራቸው ነበር።

verses.en: And Berechiah and Elkanah were doorkeepers for the ark.
verses.fr: Bérékia et Elkana étaient portiers de l''arche.
verses.am: በራክያና ሕልቃናም ለታቦቱ በረኞች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And Shebaniah, and Jehoshaphat, and Nethaneel, and Amasai, and Zechariah, and Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, did blow with the trumpets before the ark of God: and Obededom and Jehiah were doorkeepers for the ark.
verses.fr: Schebania, Josaphat, Nethaneel, Amasaï, Zacharie, Benaja et Eliézer, les sacrificateurs, sonnaient des trompettes devant l''arche de Dieu. Obed-Edom et Jechija étaient portiers de l''arche.
verses.am: ካህናቱም ሰበንያ፥ ኢዮሳፍጥ፥ ናትናኤል፥ ዓማሣይ፥ ዘካርያስ፥ በናያስ፥ አልዓዛር በእግዚአብሔር ታቦይ ፊት መለከት ይነፉ ነበር። ዖቤድኤዶምና ይሒያም ለታቦቱ በረኞች ነበሩ።

verses.en: So David, and the elders of Israel, and the captains over thousands, went to bring up the ark of the covenant of the Lord out of the house of Obededom with joy.
verses.fr: David, les anciens d''Israël, et les chefs de milliers se mirent en route pour faire monter l''arche de l''alliance de l''Eternel depuis la maison d''Obed-Edom, au milieu des réjouissances.
verses.am: ዳዊትም፥ የእስራኤልም ሽማግሌዎች፥ የሻለቆችም የእግዚአብሔርን የቃል ኪዳኑን ታቦት ከአቢዳራ ቤት በደስታ ያመጡ ዘንድ ሄዱ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when God helped the Levites that bare the ark of the covenant of the Lord, that they offered seven bullocks and seven rams.
verses.fr: Ce fut avec l''assistance de Dieu que les Lévites portèrent l''arche de l''alliance de l''Eternel; et l''on sacrifia sept taureaux et sept béliers.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርንም ቃል ኪዳን ታቦት የተሸከሙትን ሌዋውያንን እግዚአብሔር በረዳቸው ጊዜ ሰባት በሬዎችና ሰባት አውራ በጎች ሰዉ።

verses.en: And David was clothed with a robe of fine linen, and all the Levites that bare the ark, and the singers, and Chenaniah the master of the song with the singers: David also had upon him an ephod of linen.
verses.fr: David était revêtu d''un manteau de byssus; il en était de même de tous les Lévites qui portaient l''arche, des chantres, et de Kenania, chef de musique parmi les chantres; et David avait sur lui un éphod de lin.
verses.am: ዳዊትም፥ ታቦቱንም የተሸከሙ ሌዋውያን ሁሉ፥ መዘምራኑም፥ የመዘምራኑም አለቃ ከናንያ የጥሩ በፍታ ቀሚስ ለብሰው ነበር፤ ዳዊትም የበፍታ ኤፉድ ነበረው።

verses.en: Thus all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of the Lord with shouting, and with sound of the cornet, and with trumpets, and with cymbals, making a noise with psalteries and harps.
verses.fr: Tout Israël fit monter l''arche de l''alliance de l''Eternel avec des cris de joie, au son des clairons, des trompettes et des cymbales, et en faisant retentir les luths et les harpes.
verses.am: እንዲሁ እስራኤል ሁሉ ሆ እያሉ ቀንደ መለከትና እምቢልታ እየነፉ፥ ጸናጽልና መሰንቆም በገናም እየመቱ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን የቃል ኪዳን ታቦት አመጡ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, as the ark of the covenant of the Lord came to the city of David, that Michal, the daughter of Saul looking out at a window saw king David dancing and playing: and she despised him in her heart.
verses.fr: Comme l''arche de l''alliance de l''Eternel entrait dans la cité de David, Mical, fille de Saül, regardait par la fenêtre, et voyant le roi David sauter et danser, elle le méprisa dans son coeur.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ኪዳን ታቦት ወደ ዳዊት ከተማ በደረሰ ጊዜ የሳኦል ልጅ ሜልኮል በመስኮት ሆና ተመለከተች፤ ንጉሡም ዳዊት ሲዘፍንና ሲጫወት አይታ በልቧ ናቀችው።

verses.en: So they brought the ark of God, and set it in the midst of the tent that David had pitched for it: and they offered burnt sacrifices and peace offerings before God.
verses.fr: Après qu''on eut amené l''arche de Dieu, on la plaça au milieu de la tente que David avait dressée pour elle, et l''on offrit devant Dieu des holocaustes et des sacrifices d''actions de grâces.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርንም ታቦት ይዘው ገቡ፥ ዳዊትም በተከለለት ድንኳን ውስጥ አኖሩት፤ የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕትና የደኅንነቱን መሥዋዕትም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት አቀረቡ።

verses.en: And when David had made an end of offering the burnt offerings and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the Lord.
verses.fr: Quand David eut achevé d''offrir les holocaustes et les sacrifices d''actions de grâces, il bénit le peuple au nom de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ዳዊትም የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕትና የደኅንነቱን መሥዋዕት ማቅረብ በፈጸመ ጊዜ በእግዚአብሔር ስም ሕዝቡን ባረከ።

verses.en: And he dealt to every one of Israel, both man and woman, to every one a loaf of bread, and a good piece of flesh, and a flagon of wine.
verses.fr: Puis il distribua à tous ceux d''Israël, hommes et femmes, à chacun un pain, une portion de viande et un gâteau de raisins.
verses.am: ለእስራኤልም ለወንዱም ለሴቱም ለእያንዳንዱ አንዳንድ እንጀራ፤ አንዳንድም ቍራጭ ሥጋ፥ አንዳንድም የዘቢብ ጥፍጥፍ አካፈለ።

verses.en: And he appointed certain of the Levites to minister before the ark of the Lord, and to record, and to thank and praise the Lord God of Israel:
verses.fr: Il remit à des Lévites la charge de faire le service devant l''arche de l''Eternel, d''invoquer, de louer et de célébrer l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔርም ታቦት ፊት ያገለግሉ ዘንድ፥ የእስራኤልንም አምላክ እግዚአብሔርን ይወድሱት ዘንድ፥ ያመሰግኑትና ያከብሩትም ዘንድ ከሌዋውያን ወገን አቆመ።

verses.en: Asaph the chief, and next to him Zechariah, Jeiel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Mattithiah, and Eliab, and Benaiah, and Obededom: and Jeiel with psalteries and with harps; but Asaph made a sound with cymbals;
verses.fr: C''étaient: Asaph, le chef; Zacharie, le second après lui, Jeïel, Schemiramoth, Jehiel, Matthithia, Eliab, Benaja, Obed-Edom et Jeïel. Ils avaient des instruments de musique, des luths et des harpes; et Asaph faisait retentir les cymbales.
verses.am: አለቃው አሳፍ ነበረ፤ ከእርሱም በኋላ ዘካርያስ፥ ይዒኤል፥ ሰሚራሞት፥ ይሒኤል፥ መቲትያ፥ ኤልያብ፥ በናያስ፥ ዖቤድኤዶም፥ ይዒኤል በመሰንቆና በበገና አሳፍም በጸናጽል ይዘምሩ ነበር።

verses.en: Benaiah also and Jahaziel the priests with trumpets continually before the ark of the covenant of God.
verses.fr: Les sacrificateurs Benaja et Jachaziel sonnaient continuellement des trompettes devant l''arche de l''alliance de Dieu.
verses.am: ካህናቱም በናያስና የሕዚኤል በእግዚአብሔር ቃል ኪዳን ታቦት ፊት ሁልጊዜ መለከት ይነፉ ነበር።

verses.en: Then on that day David delivered first this psalm to thank the Lord into the hand of Asaph and his brethren.
verses.fr: Ce fut en ce jour que David chargea pour la première fois Asaph et ses frères de célébrer les louanges de l''Eternel.
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን ዳዊት በአሳፍና በወንድሞቹ እጅ እግዚአብሔርን እንዲያመሰግኑ ትእዛዝን ሰጠ።

verses.en: Give thanks unto the Lord, call upon his name, make known his deeds among the people.
verses.fr: Louez l''Eternel, invoquez son nom! Faites connaître parmi les peuples ses hauts faits!
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑ፥ ስሙን ጥሩ፤ ለአሕዛብ ሥራውን አውሩ።

verses.en: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him, talk ye of all his wondrous works.
verses.fr: Chantez, chantez en son honneur! Parlez de toutes ses merveilles!
verses.am: ተቀኙለት፥ ዘምሩለት፤ ተአምራቱንም ሁሉ ተናገሩ።

verses.en: Glory ye in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek the Lord.
verses.fr: Glorifiez-vous de son saint nom! Que le coeur de ceux qui cherchent l''Eternel se réjouisse!
verses.am: በቅዱስ ስሙ ተጓደዱ፤ እግዚአብሔርን የሚፈልግ ልብ ደስ ይበለው።

verses.en: Seek the Lord and his strength, seek his face continually.
verses.fr: Ayez recours à l''Eternel et à son appui, Cherchez continuellement sa face!
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን ፈልጉት፥ ትጸናላችሁም፤ ሁልጊዜ ፊቱን ፈልጉ።

verses.en: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done, his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;
verses.fr: Souvenez-vous des prodiges qu''il a faits, De ses miracles et des jugements de sa bouche,
verses.am: እርሱ እግዚአብሔር አምላካችን ነው

verses.en: O ye seed of Israel his servant, ye children of Jacob, his chosen ones.
verses.fr: Race d''Israël, son serviteur, Enfants de Jacob, ses élus!
verses.am: እርሱ እግዚአብሔር አምላካችን ነው

verses.en: He is the Lord our God; his judgments are in all the earth.
verses.fr: L''Eternel est notre Dieu; Ses jugements s''exercent sur toute la terre.
verses.am: ፍርዱ በምድር ሁሉ ነው። ቃል ኪዳኑን ለዘላለም፥ እስከ ሺህ ትውልድ ያዘዘውን ቃሉን አሰበ፥

verses.en: Be ye mindful always of his covenant; the word which he commanded to a thousand generations;
verses.fr: Rappelez-vous à toujours son alliance, Ses promesses pour mille générations,
verses.am: ለአብርሃም ያደረገውን፥ ለይስሐቅም የማለውን፤

verses.en: Even of the covenant which he made with Abraham, and of his oath unto Isaac;
verses.fr: L''alliance qu''il a traitée avec Abraham, Et le serment qu''il a fait à Isaac;
verses.am: ለያዕቆብ ሥርዓት እንዲሆን ለእስራኤልም የዘላለም ኪዳን እንዲሆን አጸና፤

verses.en: And hath confirmed the same to Jacob for a law, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant,
verses.fr: Il l''a érigée pour Jacob en loi, Pour Israël en alliance éternelle,
verses.am: እንዲህም አለ። ለአንተ የከነዓንን ምድር የርስታችሁን ገመድ እሰጣለሁ፤

verses.en: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance;
verses.fr: Disant: Je te donnerai le pays de Canaan Comme l''héritage qui vous est échu.
verses.am: ይህም የሆነው እነርሱ በቍጥር ጥቂቶች ሰዎች፥ እጅግ ጥቂቶችና ስደተኞች ሲሆኑ ነው።

verses.en: When ye were but few, even a few, and strangers in it.
verses.fr: Ils étaient alors peu nombreux, Très peu nombreux, et étrangers dans le pays,
verses.am: ከሕዝብ ወደ ሕዝብ፥ ከመንግሥትም ወደ ሌላ ሕዝብ አለፉ።

verses.en: And when they went from nation to nation, and from one kingdom to another people;
verses.fr: Et ils allaient d''une nation à l''autre Et d''un royaume vers un autre peuple;
verses.am: ምድር ሁሉ እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑ፤ ዕለት ዕለት ማዳኑን አውሩ።

verses.en: He suffered no man to do them wrong: yea, he reproved kings for their sakes,
verses.fr: Mais il ne permit à personne de les opprimer, Et il châtia des rois à cause d''eux:
verses.am: ምድር ሁሉ እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑ፤ ዕለት ዕለት ማዳኑን አውሩ።

verses.en: Saying, Touch not mine anointed, and do my prophets no harm.
verses.fr: Ne touchez pas à mes oints, Et ne faites pas de mal à mes prophètes!
verses.am: ክብሩን ለአሕዛብ፥ ተአምራቱንም ለወገኖች ሁሉ ንገሩ።

verses.en: Sing unto the Lord, all the earth; shew forth from day to day his salvation.
verses.fr: Chantez à l''Eternel, vous tous habitants de la terre! Annoncez de jour en jour son salut;
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ታላቅ፥ ምስጋናውም ብዙ ነውና፤ በአማልክትም ሁሉ ላይ የተፈራ ነው።

verses.en: Declare his glory among the heathen; his marvellous works among all nations.
verses.fr: Racontez parmi les nations sa gloire, Parmi tous les peuples ses merveilles!
verses.am: የአሕዛብ አማልክት ሁሉ ጣዖታት ናቸው፤ እግዚአብሔር ግን ሰማያትን ሠራ።

verses.en: For great is the Lord, and greatly to be praised: he also is to be feared above all gods.
verses.fr: Car l''Eternel est grand et très digne de louange, Il est redoutable par-dessus tous les dieux;
verses.am: ክብርና ግርማ በፊቱ፥ ኃይልና ደስታ በስፍራው ውስጥ ናቸው።

verses.en: For all the gods of the people are idols: but the Lord made the heavens.
verses.fr: Car tous les dieux des peuples sont des idoles, Et l''Eternel a fait les cieux.
verses.am: የአሕዛብ ወገኖች ለእግዚአብሔር አምጡ፥ ክብርንና ኃይልን ለእግዚአብሔር አምጡ።

verses.en: Glory and honour are in his presence; strength and gladness are in his place.
verses.fr: La majesté et la splendeur sont devant sa face, La force et la joie sont dans sa demeure.
verses.am: ለስሙ የሚገባ ክብርን ለእግዚአብሔር አምጡ፤ ቍርባንን ይዛችሁ በፊቱ ግቡ፤ በቅድስናው ስፍራ ለእግዚአብሔር ስገዱ።

verses.en: Give unto the Lord, ye kindreds of the people, give unto the Lord glory and strength.
verses.fr: Familles des peuples, rendez à l''Eternel, Rendez à l''Eternel gloire et honneur!
verses.am: ምድር ሁሉ በፊቱ ትነዋወጥ፤ ዓለሙም እንዳይናወጥ ጸንቶአል።

verses.en: Give unto the Lord the glory due unto his name: bring an offering, and come before him: worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness.
verses.fr: Rendez à l''Eternel gloire pour son nom! Apportez des offrandes et venez en sa présence, Prosternez-vous devant l''Eternel avec de saints ornements!
verses.am: ሰማያት ደስ ይበላቸው፥ ምድርም ሐሴትን ታድርግ፤ በአሕዛብም መካከል። እግዚአብሔር ነገሠ በሉ።

verses.en: Fear before him, all the earth: the world also shall be stable, that it be not moved.
verses.fr: Tremblez devant lui, vous tous habitants de la terre! Le monde est affermi, il ne chancelle point.
verses.am: ባሕርና ሞላዋ ትናወጥ፤ በረሀ በእርሷም ያሉ ሁሉ ሐሤትን ያድርጉ።

verses.en: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice: and let men say among the nations, The Lord reigneth.
verses.fr: Que les cieux se réjouissent, et que la terre soit dans l''allégresse! Que l''on dise parmi les nations: L''Eternel règne!
verses.am: በምድር ሊፈርድ ይመጣልና፥ የዱር ዛፎች በዚያን ጊዜ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ደስ ይላቸዋል።

verses.en: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof: let the fields rejoice, and all that is therein.
verses.fr: Que la mer retentisse avec tout ce qu''elle contient! Que la campagne s''égaie avec tout ce qu''elle renferme!
verses.am: ቸር ነውና፥ ምህረቱም ለዘላለም ነውና እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑ።

verses.en: Then shall the trees of the wood sing out at the presence of the Lord, because he cometh to judge the earth.
verses.fr: Que les arbres des forêts poussent des cris de joie Devant l''Eternel! Car il vient pour juger la terre.
verses.am: የመዳናችን አምላክ ሆይ፥ አድነን፤ ቅዱስ ስምህን እናመሰግን ዘንድ፥ በምስጋናህም እንመካ ዘንድ፥ ከአሕዛብ ሰብስበህ ታደገን በሉ።

verses.en: O give thanks unto the Lord; for he is good; for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.fr: Louez l''Eternel, car il est bon, Car sa miséricorde dure à toujours!
verses.am: ከዘላለም እስከ ዘላለም፥ የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ይባረክ። ሕዝቡም ሁሉ አሜን ይበሉ፤ እግዚአብሔርንም ያመስግኑ።

verses.en: And say ye, Save us, O God of our salvation, and gather us together, and deliver us from the heathen, that we may give thanks to thy holy name, and glory in thy praise.
verses.fr: Dites: Sauve-nous, Dieu de notre salut, Rassemble-nous, et retire-nous du milieu des nations, Afin que nous célébrions ton saint nom Et que nous mettions notre gloire à te louer!
verses.am: እንዲሁም በየቀኑ እንደሚገባቸው በታቦቱ ፊት ዘወትር ያገለግሉ ዘንድ አሳፍንና ወንድሞቹን፥ ዖቤድኤዶምንም፥ ስድሳ ስምንቱንም ወንድሞቻቸውን በዚያ በእግዚአብሔር ቃል ኪዳን ታቦት ፊት ተዋቸው።

verses.en: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel for ever and ever. And all the people said, Amen, and praised the Lord.
verses.fr: Béni soit l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël, D''éternité en éternité! Et que tout le peuple dise: Amen! Louez l''Eternel!
verses.am: የኤዶታምም ልጅ ዖቤድኤዶምና ሖሳ በረኞች ይሆኑ ዘንድ ተዋቸው።

verses.en: So he left there before the ark of the covenant of the Lord Asaph and his brethren, to minister before the ark continually, as every day's work required:
verses.fr: David laissa là, devant l''arche de l''alliance de l''Eternel, Asaph et ses frères, afin qu''ils fussent continuellement de service devant l''arche, remplissant leur tâche jour par jour.
verses.am: ካህኑም ሳዶቅንና ካህናቱን ወንድሞቹን በገባዖን በኮረብታው መስገጃ ባለው በእግዚአብሔር ማደሪያ ፊት አቆማቸው፥

verses.en: And Obededom with their brethren, threescore and eight; Obededom also the son of Jeduthun and Hosah to be porters:
verses.fr: Il laissa Obed-Edom et Hosa avec leurs frères, au nombre de soixante-huit, Obed-Edom, fils de Jeduthun, et Hosa, comme portiers.
verses.am: ለእስራኤልም ባዘዘው በእግዚአብሔር ሕግ እንደ ተጻፈ ሁሉ ለሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕት በሚሆነው መሠዊያ ላይ የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት ሁል ጊዜ ጥዋትና ማታ ለእግዚአብሔር ያቀርቡ ዘንድ።

verses.en: And Zadok the priest, and his brethren the priests, before the tabernacle of the Lord in the high place that was at Gibeon,
verses.fr: Il établit le sacrificateur Tsadok et les sacrificateurs, ses frères, devant le tabernacle de l''Eternel, sur le haut lieu qui était à Gabaon,
verses.am: ምህረቱም ለዘላለም ነውና እግዚአብሔርን ያመሰግኑ ዘንድ ኤማንንና ኤዶታምን፥ በስማቸውም የተጻፉትን ተመርጠው የቀሩትን ከእነርሱ ጋር አቆመ።

verses.en: To offer burnt offerings unto the Lord upon the altar of the burnt offering continually morning and evening, and to do according to all that is written in the law of the Lord, which he commanded Israel;
verses.fr: pour qu''ils offrissent continuellement à l''Eternel des holocaustes, matin et soir, sur l''autel des holocaustes, et qu''ils accomplissent tout ce qui est écrit dans la loi de l''Eternel, imposée par l''Eternel à Israël.
verses.am: ከእነርሱም ጋር ካህናቱ ከፍ አድርገው ለማሰማት መለከትና ጸናጽል ለእግዚአብሔርም መዝሙራት የዜማ ዕቃ ይዘው ነበር፤ የኤዶታምም ልጆች በረኞች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And with them Heman and Jeduthun, and the rest that were chosen, who were expressed by name, to give thanks to the Lord, because his mercy endureth for ever;
verses.fr: Auprès d''eux étaient Héman et Jeduthun, et les autres qui avaient été choisis et désignés par leurs noms pour louer l''Eternel. Car sa miséricorde dure à toujours.
verses.am: ሕዝቡ ሁሉ እያንዳንዱ ወደ ቤቱ ሄደ፤ ዳዊትም ቤቱን ይባርክ ዘንድ ተመለሰ።

verses.en: And with them Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for those that should make a sound, and with musical instruments of God. And the sons of Jeduthun were porters.
verses.fr: Auprès d''eux étaient Héman et Jeduthun, avec des trompettes et des cymbales pour ceux qui les faisaient retentir, et avec des instruments pour les cantiques en l''honneur de Dieu. Les fils de Jeduthun étaient portiers.
verses.am: ፤ ከእነርሱም ጋር ካህናቱ ከፍ አድርገው ለማሰማት መለከትና ጸናጽል ለእግዚአብሔርም መዝሙራት የዜማ ዕቃ ይዘው ነበር፤ የኤዶታምም ልጆች በረኞች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And all the people departed every man to his house: and David returned to bless his house.
verses.fr: Tout le peuple s''en alla chacun dans sa maison, et David s''en retourna pour bénir sa maison.
verses.am: ፤ ሕዝቡ ሁሉ እያንዳንዱ ወደ ቤቱ ሄደ፤ ዳዊትም ቤቱን ይባርክ ዘንድ ተመለሰ።

verses.en: Now it came to pass, as David sat in his house, that David said to Nathan the prophet, Lo, I dwell in an house of cedars, but the ark of the covenant of the Lord remaineth under curtains.
verses.fr: Lorsque David fut établi dans sa maison, il dit à Nathan le prophète: Voici, j''habite dans une maison de cèdre, et l''arche de l''alliance de l''Eternel est sous une tente.
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ዳዊት በቤቱ በተቀመጠ ጊዜ ዳዊት ነቢዩን ናታንን። እነሆ፥ እኔ ከዝግባ በተሠራ ቤት ተቀምጫለሁ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ኪዳን ታቦት በመጋረጃዎች ውስጥ ተቀምጦአል አለው።

verses.en: Then Nathan said unto David, Do all that is in thine heart; for God is with thee.
verses.fr: Nathan répondit à David: Fais tout ce que tu as dans le coeur, car Dieu est avec toi.
verses.am: ናታንም ዳዊትን። እግዚአብሔር ከአንተ ጋር ነውና በልብህ ያለውን ሁሉ አድርግ አለው።

verses.en: And it came to pass the same night, that the word of God came to Nathan, saying,
verses.fr: La nuit suivante, la parole de Dieu fut adressée à Nathan:
verses.am: በዚያም ሌሊት የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ ናታን መጣ እንዲህም አለው።

verses.en: Go and tell David my servant, Thus saith the Lord, Thou shalt not build me an house to dwell in:
verses.fr: Va dire à mon serviteur David: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Ce ne sera pas toi qui me bâtiras une maison pour que j''en fasse ma demeure.
verses.am: ሂድ፥ ለባሪያዬ ለዳዊት ንገረው። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እስራኤልን ካወጣሁበት ቀን ጀምሮ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ከድንኳን ወደ ድንኳን፥ ከማደሪያም ወደ ማደሪያ እሄድ ነበር እንጂ በቤት ውስጥ አልኖርሁምና የምኖርበትን ቤት አትሠራልኝም።

verses.en: For I have not dwelt in an house since the day that I brought up Israel unto this day; but have gone from tent to tent, and from one tabernacle to another.
verses.fr: Car je n''ai point habité dans une maison depuis le jour où j''ai fait monter Israël jusqu''à ce jour; mais j''ai été de tente en tente et de demeure en demeure.
verses.am: ሂድ፥ ለባሪያዬ ለዳዊት ንገረው። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እስራኤልን ካወጣሁበት ቀን ጀምሮ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ከድንኳን ወደ ድንኳን፥ ከማደሪያም ወደ ማደሪያ እሄድ ነበር እንጂ በቤት ውስጥ አልኖርሁምና የምኖርበትን ቤት አትሠራልኝም።

verses.en: Wheresoever I have walked with all Israel, spake I a word to any of the judges of Israel, whom I commanded to feed my people, saying, Why have ye not built me an house of cedars?
verses.fr: Partout où j''ai marché avec tout Israël, ai-je dit un mot à quelqu''un des juges d''Israël à qui j''avais ordonné de paître mon peuple, ai-je dit: Pourquoi ne me bâtissez-vous pas une maison de cèdre?
verses.am: ከእስራኤል ሁሉ ጋር ባለፍሁበት ስፍራ ሁሉ። ስለ ምን ቤትን ከዝግባ እንጨት አልሠራችሁልኝም? ብዬ ሕዝቤን ይጠብቅ ዘንድ ከእስራኤል ፈራጆች ላዘዝሁት ለአንዱ በውኑ ተናግሬአለሁን?

verses.en: Now therefore thus shalt thou say unto my servant David, Thus saith the Lord of hosts, I took thee from the sheepcote, even from following the sheep, that thou shouldest be ruler over my people Israel:
verses.fr: Maintenant tu diras à mon serviteur David: Ainsi parle l''Eternel des armées: Je t''ai pris au pâturage, derrière les brebis, pour que tu fusses chef de mon peuple d''Israël;
verses.am: አሁንም ባሪያዬን ዳዊትን እንዲህ በለው። የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። አንተ መንጋውን ስትከተል በሕዝቤ በእስራኤል ላይ አለቃ ትሆን ዘንድ ከበግ ጥበቃ ወሰድሁህ።

verses.en: And I have been with thee whithersoever thou hast walked, and have cut off all thine enemies from before thee, and have made thee a name like the name of the great men that are in the earth.
verses.fr: j''ai été avec toi partout où tu as marché, j''ai exterminé tous tes ennemis devant toi, et j''ai rendu ton nom semblable au nom des grands qui sont sur la terre;
verses.am: በሄድህበትም ሁሉ ከአንተ ጋር ነበርሁ፥ ጠላቶችህንም ሁሉ ከፊትህ አጠፋሁ፤ በምድርም ላይ እንዳሉ እንደታላላቆች ስም ለአንተ ስም አደርጋለሁ።

verses.en: Also I will ordain a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, and they shall dwell in their place, and shall be moved no more; neither shall the children of wickedness waste them any more, as at the beginning,
verses.fr: j''ai donné une demeure à mon peuple d''Israël, et je l''ai planté pour qu''il y soit fixé et ne soit plus agité, pour que les méchants ne le détruisent plus comme auparavant
verses.am: ወደ አባቶችህም ትሄድ ዘንድ ዕድሜህ በተፈጸመ ጊዜ ከልጆችህ የሚሆነውን ዘርህን ከአንተ በኋላ አስነሣለሁ፤ መንግሥቱንም አጸናለሁ።

verses.en: And since the time that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel. Moreover I will subdue all thine enemies. Furthermore I tell thee that the Lord will build thee an house.
verses.fr: et comme à l''époque où j''avais établi des juges sur mon peuple d''Israël. J''ai humilié tous tes ennemis. Et je t''annonce que l''Eternel te bâtira une maison.
verses.am: ወደ አባቶችህም ትሄድ ዘንድ ዕድሜህ በተፈጸመ ጊዜ ከልጆችህ የሚሆነውን ዘርህን ከአንተ በኋላ አስነሣለሁ፤ መንግሥቱንም አጸናለሁ።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, when thy days be expired that thou must go to be with thy fathers, that I will raise up thy seed after thee, which shall be of thy sons; and I will establish his kingdom.
verses.fr: Quand tes jours seront accomplis et que tu iras auprès de tes pères, j''élèverai ta postérité après toi, l''un de tes fils, et j''affermirai son règne.
verses.am: እርሱ ቤት ይሠራልኛል፤ ዙፋኑንም ለዘላለም አጸናለሁ።

verses.en: He shall build me an house, and I will stablish his throne for ever.
verses.fr: Ce sera lui qui me bâtira une maison, et j''affermirai pour toujours son trône.
verses.am: እኔም አባት እሆነዋለሁ፥ እርሱም ልጅ ይሆነኛል፤ ከአንተ አስቀድሞ ከነበረው እንዳራቅሁ፥ ምሕረቴን ከእርሱ አላርቅም።

verses.en: I will be his father, and he shall be my son: and I will not take my mercy away from him, as I took it from him that was before thee:
verses.fr: Je serai pour lui un père, et il sera pour moi un fils; et je ne lui retirerai point ma grâce, comme je l''ai retirée à celui qui t''a précédé.
verses.am: በቤቴና በመንግሥቴም ለዘላለም አቆመዋለሁ፤ ዙፋኑም ለዘላለም ይጸናል።

verses.en: But I will settle him in mine house and in my kingdom for ever: and his throne shall be established for evermore.
verses.fr: Je l''établirai pour toujours dans ma maison et dans mon royaume, et son trône sera pour toujours affermi.
verses.am: እንደዚህ ነገር ሁሉ እንደዚህም ራእይ ሁሉ ናታን ለዳዊት ነገረው።

verses.en: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so did Nathan speak unto David.
verses.fr: Nathan rapporta à David toutes ces paroles et toute cette vision.
verses.am: ንጉሡም ዳዊት ገባ፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ተቀምጦ እንዲህ አለ። አቤቱ አምላክ ሆይ፥ እስከዚህ ያደረስኸኝ እኔ ማን ነኝ? ቤቴስ ምንድር ነው?

verses.en: And David the king came and sat before the Lord, and said, Who am I, O Lord God, and what is mine house, that thou hast brought me hitherto?
verses.fr: Et le roi David alla se présenter devant l''Eternel, et dit: Qui suis-je, Eternel Dieu, et quelle est ma maison, pour que tu m''aies fait parvenir où je suis?
verses.am: አምላክ ሆይ ይህ በፊትህ ጥቂት ነበረ፤ አቤቱ አምላክ ሆይ፥ ስለ ባሪያህ ቤት ደግሞ ለሩቅ ዘመን ተናገርህ፤ እንደ አንድ ባለ ማዕርግ ሰው ተመለከትኸኝ።

verses.en: And yet this was a small thing in thine eyes, O God; for thou hast also spoken of thy servant's house for a great while to come, and hast regarded me according to the estate of a man of high degree, O Lord God.
verses.fr: C''est peu de chose à tes yeux, ô Dieu! Tu parles de la maison de ton serviteur pour les temps à venir. Et tu daignes porter les regards sur moi à la manière des hommes, toi qui es élevé, Eternel Dieu!
verses.am: አንተ ባሪያህን ታውቀዋለህና ለባሪያህ ስለ ተደረገ ክብር ዳዊት ጨምሮ የሚለው ምንድር ነው?

verses.en: What can David speak more to thee for the honour of thy servant? for thou knowest thy servant.
verses.fr: Que pourrait te dire encore David sur la gloire accordée à ton serviteur? Tu connais ton serviteur.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ይህን ታላቅ ነገር ሁሉ ታስታውቀው ዘንድ ስለ ባሪያህ እንደ ልብህም ይህን ታአምራት ሁሉ አድርገሃል።

verses.en: O Lord, for thy servant's sake, and according to thine own heart, hast thou done all this greatness, in making known all these great things.
verses.fr: O Eternel! c''est à cause de ton serviteur, et selon ton coeur, que tu as fait toutes ces grandes choses, pour les lui révéler.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ እንዳንተ ያለ የለም፥ በጆሮአችንም እንደሰማን ሁሉ ከአንተ በቀር አምላክ የለም።

verses.en: O Lord, there is none like thee, neither is there any God beside thee, according to all that we have heard with our ears.
verses.fr: O Eternel! nul n''est semblable à toi et il n''y a point d''autre Dieu que toi, d''après tout ce que nous avons entendu de nos oreilles.
verses.am: አንተ እግዚአብሔር ከግብጽ ካወጣኸው ከሕዝብህ ፊት አሕዛብን በማሳደድ በታላቅና በሚያስፈራ ነገር ለአንተ ስም ታደርግ ዘንድ፥ ለአንተም ሕዝብ ትቤዥ ዘንድ እንደሄድህለት እንዳንተ ሕዝብ እንደ እስራኤል ያለ በምድር ላይ ሌላ ሕዝብ አለን?

verses.en: And what one nation in the earth is like thy people Israel, whom God went to redeem to be his own people, to make thee a name of greatness and terribleness, by driving out nations from before thy people whom thou hast redeemed out of Egypt?
verses.fr: Est-il sur la terre une seule nation qui soit comme ton peuple d''Israël, que Dieu est venu racheter pour en former son peuple, pour te faire un nom et pour accomplir des miracles et des prodiges, en chassant des nations devant ton peuple que tu as racheté d''Egypte?
verses.am: ሕዝብህንም እስራኤልን ለዘላለም ሕዝብህ አደረግኸው፤ አንተም፥ አቤቱ፥ አምላክ ሆነኸዋል።

verses.en: For thy people Israel didst thou make thine own people for ever; and thou, Lord, becamest their God.
verses.fr: Tu as établi ton peuple d''Israël, pour qu''il fût ton peuple à toujours; et toi, Eternel, tu es devenu son Dieu.
verses.am: አሁንም፥ አቤቱ፥ ስለ ባሪያህና ስለ ቤቱ የተናገርኸው ለዘላለም የጸና ይሁን፤ እንደተናገርህም አድርግ።

verses.en: Therefore now, Lord, let the thing that thou hast spoken concerning thy servant and concerning his house be established for ever, and do as thou hast said.
verses.fr: Maintenant, ô Eternel! que la parole que tu as prononcée sur ton serviteur et sur sa maison subsiste éternellement, et agis selon ta parole!
verses.am: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እርሱ የእስራኤል አምላክ ነው፥ በእውነት የእስራኤል አምላክ ነው ይባል ዘንድ ስምህ ለዘላለም ጽኑና ታላቅ ይሁን፤ የባሪያህም የዳዊት ቤት በፊትህ ጸንቶአል።

verses.en: Let it even be established, that thy name may be magnified for ever, saying, The Lord of hosts is the God of Israel, even a God to Israel: and let the house of David thy servant be established before thee.
verses.fr: Qu''elle subsiste, afin que ton nom soit à jamais glorifié et que l''on dise: L''Eternel des armées, le Dieu d''Israël, est un Dieu pour Israël! Et que la maison de David, ton serviteur, soit affermie devant toi!
verses.am: አምላኬ ሆይ፥ ቤት እንድሠራለት ለባሪያህ ገልጠሃልና ስለዚህ ባሪያህ ወዳንተ ይጸልይ ዘንድ በልቡ ደፈረ።

verses.en: For thou, O my God, hast told thy servant that thou wilt build him an house: therefore thy servant hath found in his heart to pray before thee.
verses.fr: Car toi-même, ô mon Dieu, tu as révélé à ton serviteur que tu lui bâtirais une maison. C''est pourquoi ton serviteur a osé prier devant toi.
verses.am: አሁንም፥ አቤቱ፥ አንተ አምላክ ነህ፥ ይህንም መልካም ነገር ለባሪያህ ተናግረሃል።

verses.en: And now, Lord, thou art God, and hast promised this goodness unto thy servant:
verses.fr: Maintenant, ô Eternel! tu es Dieu, et tu as annoncé cette grâce à ton serviteur.
verses.am: አሁንም በፊትህ ለዘላለም ይኖር ዘንድ የባሪያህን ቤት እንድትባርክ ፈቅደሃል፤ አንተም፥ አቤቱ፥ ባርከኸዋል፥ ለዘላለምም ቡሩክ ይሆናል።

verses.en: Now therefore let it please thee to bless the house of thy servant, that it may be before thee for ever: for thou blessest, O Lord, and it shall be blessed for ever.
verses.fr: Veuille donc bénir la maison de ton serviteur, afin qu''elle subsiste à toujours devant toi! Car ce que tu bénis, ô Eternel! est béni pour l''éternité.
verses.am: ፤ አሁንም በፊትህ ለዘላለም ይኖር ዘንድ የባሪያህን ቤት እንድትባርክ ፈቅደሃል፤ አንተም፥ አቤቱ፥ ባርከኸዋል፥ ለዘላለምም ቡሩክ ይሆናል።

verses.en: Now after this it came to pass, that David smote the Philistines, and subdued them, and took Gath and her towns out of the hand of the Philistines.
verses.fr: Après cela, David battit les Philistins et les humilia, et il enleva de la main des Philistins Gath et les villes de son ressort.
verses.am: ከዚህም በኋላ ዳዊት ፍልስጥኤማውያንን መታ፥ አዋረዳቸውም፥ ከፍልስጥኤማውያንም እጅ ጌትንና መንደሮችዋን ወሰደ።

verses.en: And he smote Moab; and the Moabites became David's servants, and brought gifts.
verses.fr: Il battit les Moabites, et les Moabites furent assujettis à David et lui payèrent un tribut.
verses.am: ሞዓብን መታ፤ ሞዓባውያንም ለዳዊት ገባሮች ሆኑ፤ ግብርም አመጡለት።

verses.en: And David smote Hadarezer king of Zobah unto Hamath, as he went to stablish his dominion by the river Euphrates.
verses.fr: David battit Hadarézer, roi de Tsoba, vers Hamath, lorsqu''il alla établir sa domination sur le fleuve de l''Euphrate.
verses.am: ዳዊትም በኤፍራጥስ ወንዝ አጠገብ የነበረውን ግዛት ለመያዝ በሄደ ጊዜ የሱባን ንጉሥ አድርአዛርን እስከ ሃማት ድረስ መታ።

verses.en: And David took from him a thousand chariots, and seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen: David also houghed all the chariot horses, but reserved of them an hundred chariots.
verses.fr: David lui prit mille chars, sept mille cavaliers, et vingt mille hommes de pied; il coupa les jarrets à tous les chevaux de trait, et ne conserva que cent attelages.
verses.am: ዳዊትም ከእርሱ አንድ ሺህ ሰረገሎች፥ ሰባት ሺህም ፈረሰኞች፥ ሀያ ሺህም እግረኞች ወሰደ፤ ዳዊት ለመቶ ሰረገሎች የሚሆኑትን ብቻ አስቀርቶ የሰረገሎቹን ፈረሶች ቋንጃ ቆረጠ።

verses.en: And when the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadarezer king of Zobah, David slew of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men.
verses.fr: Les Syriens de Damas vinrent au secours d''Hadarézer, roi de Tsoba, et David battit vingt-deux mille Syriens.
verses.am: ከደማስቆም ሶርያውያን የሱባን ንጉሥ አድርአዛርን ሊረዱ በመጡ ጊዜ ዳዊት ከሶርያውያን ሀያ ሁለት ሺህ ሰዎችን ገደለ።

verses.en: Then David put garrisons in Syriadamascus; and the Syrians became David's servants, and brought gifts. Thus the Lord preserved David whithersoever he went.
verses.fr: David mit des garnisons dans la Syrie de Damas. Et les Syriens furent assujettis à David, et lui payèrent un tribut. L''Eternel protégeait David partout où il allait.
verses.am: ዳዊትም በደማስቆ ሶርያ ጭፍሮች አኖረ፤ ሶርያውያንም ለዳዊት ገባሮች ሆኑ፥ ግብርም አመጡለት። እግዚአብሔርም ዳዊት በሄደበት ሁሉ ድል ይሰጠው ነበር።

verses.en: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadarezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Et David prit les boucliers d''or qu''avaient les serviteurs d''Hadarézer, et les apporta à Jérusalem.
verses.am: ዳዊትም ለአድርአዛር ባሪያዎች የነበሩትን የወርቅ ጋሻዎች ወሰደ፥ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌምም ይዞአቸው መጣ።

verses.en: Likewise from Tibhath, and from Chun, cities of Hadarezer, brought David very much brass, wherewith Solomon made the brasen sea, and the pillars, and the vessels of brass.
verses.fr: David prit encore une grande quantité d''airain à Thibchath et à Cun, villes d''Hadarézer. Salomon en fit la mer d''airain, les colonnes et les ustensiles d''airain.
verses.am: ከአድርአዛርም ከተሞች ከጢብሐትና ከኩን ዳዊት እጅግ ብዙ ናስ ወሰደ፤ ከዚህም ሰሎሞን የናሱን ኵሬና ዓምዶች የናሱንም ዕቃ ሠራ።

verses.en: Now when Tou king of Hamath heard how David had smitten all the host of Hadarezer king of Zobah;
verses.fr: Thohu, roi de Hamath, apprit que David avait battu toute l''armée d''Hadarézer, roi de Tsoba,
verses.am: የሐማትም ንጉሥ ቶዑ ዳዊት የሱባን ንጉሥ የአድርአዛርን ጭፍራ ሁሉ እንደ መታ ሰማ።

verses.en: He sent Hadoram his son to king David, to enquire of his welfare, and to congratulate him, because he had fought against Hadarezer, and smitten him; (for Hadarezer had war with Tou;) and with him all manner of vessels of gold and silver and brass.
verses.fr: et il envoya Hadoram, son fils, vers le roi David, pour le saluer, et pour le féliciter d''avoir attaqué Hadarézer et de l''avoir battu. Car Thohu était en guerre avec Hadarézer. Il envoya aussi toutes sortes de vases d''or, d''argent et d''airain.
verses.am: ቶዑም ከአድርአዛር ጋር ሁል ጊዜ ይዋጋ ነበርና ዳዊት አድርአዛርን ወግቶ ስለመታው ደኅንነቱን ይጠይቅ ዘንድ ይመርቀውም ዘንድ ልጁን አዶራምን ወደ ዳዊት ላከው፤ እርሱም የወርቅና የብር የናስም ዕቃ ይዞ መጣ።

verses.en: Them also king David dedicated unto the Lord, with the silver and the gold that he brought from all these nations; from Edom, and from Moab, and from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines, and from Amalek.
verses.fr: Le roi David les consacra à l''Eternel, avec l''argent et l''or qu''il avait pris sur toutes les nations, sur Edom, sur Moab, sur les fils d''Ammon, sur les Philistins et sur Amalek.
verses.am: ንጉሡም ዳዊት ከአሕዛብ ሁሉ ከኤዶምና ከሞዓብ ከአሞንም ልጆች ከፍልስጥኤማውያንም ከአማሌቅም ከማረከው ብርና ወርቅ ጋር እነዚህን ደግሞ ለእግዚአብሔር ቀደሰ።

verses.en: Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah slew of the Edomites in the valley of salt eighteen thousand.
verses.fr: Abischaï, fils de Tseruja, battit dans la vallée du sel dix-huit mille Edomites.
verses.am: ደግሞ የጽሩያ ልጅ አቢሳ ከኤዶማውያን በጨው ሸለቆ ውስጥ አሥራ ስምንት ሺህ ሰዎች ገደለ።

verses.en: And he put garrisons in Edom; and all the Edomites became David's servants. Thus the Lord preserved David whithersoever he went.
verses.fr: Il mit des garnisons dans Edom, et tout Edom fut assujetti à David. L''Eternel protégeait David partout où il allait.
verses.am: በኤዶምያስም ጭፍሮች አኖረ፥ ኤዶማውያንም ሁሉ ለዳዊት ገባሮች ሆኑ። እግዚአብሔርም ዳዊት በሄደበት ሁሉ ድል ይሰጠው ነበር።

verses.en: So David reigned over all Israel, and executed judgment and justice among all his people.
verses.fr: David régna sur tout Israël, et il faisait droit et justice à tout son peuple.
verses.am: ዳዊትም በእስራኤል ሁሉ ላይ ነገሠ፤ ለሕዝቡም ሁሉ ፍርድንና ጽድቅም አደረገላቸው።

verses.en: And Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the host; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, recorder.
verses.fr: Joab, fils de Tseruja, commandait l''armée; Josaphat, fils d''Achilud, était archiviste;
verses.am: የጽሩያ ልጅ ኢዮአብም የሠራዊት አለቃ ነበረ፤ የአሒሉድም ልጅ ኢዮሣፍጥ ታሪክ ጸሐፊ ነበረ።

verses.en: And Zadok the son of Ahitub, and Abimelech the son of Abiathar, were the priests; and Shavsha was scribe;
verses.fr: Tsadok, fils d''Achithub, et Abimélec, fils d''Abiathar, étaient sacrificateurs; Schavscha était secrétaire;
verses.am: የአኪጦብም ልጅ ሳዶቅ፥ የአቤሜሌክም ልጅ አብያታር ካህናት ነበሩ፤ ሱሳ ጸሐፊ ነበረ።

verses.en: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and the sons of David were chief about the king.
verses.fr: Benaja, fils de Jehojada, était chef des Kéréthiens et des Péléthiens; et les fils de David étaient les premiers auprès du roi.
verses.am: የዮዳሄ ልጅ በናያስ በከሊታውያንና በፈሊታውያን ላይ ነበረ፤ የዳዊትም ልጆች በንጉሡ አጠገብ አለቆች ነበሩ።

verses.en: Now it came to pass after this, that Nahash the king of the children of Ammon died, and his son reigned in his stead.
verses.fr: Après cela, Nachasch, roi des fils d''Ammon, mourut, et son fils régna à sa place.
verses.am: ከዚህም በኋላ የአሞን ልጆች ንጉሥ ናዖስ ሞተ፥ ልጁም በእርሱ ፋንታ ነገሠ።

verses.en: And David said, I will shew kindness unto Hanun the son of Nahash, because his father shewed kindness to me. And David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father. So the servants of David came into the land of the children of Ammon to Hanun, to comfort him.
verses.fr: David dit: Je montrerai de la bienveillance à Hanun, fils de Nachasch, car son père en a montré à mon égard. Et David envoya des messagers pour le consoler au sujet de son père. Lorsque les serviteurs de David arrivèrent dans le pays des fils d''Ammon auprès de Hanun, pour le consoler,
verses.am: ዳዊትም። አባቱ ስላደረገልኝ ወረታ እኔ ለናዖስ ልጅ ለሐኖን ቸርነት አደርጋለሁ አለ። ዳዊትም አባቱ ስለ ሞተ ልያጽናናው መልእክተኞችን ላከ፤ የዳዊትም ባሪያዎች ሊያጽናኑት ወደ ሐኖን ወደ አሞን ልጆች ምድር መጡ።

verses.en: But the princes of the children of Ammon said to Hanun, Thinkest thou that David doth honour thy father, that he hath sent comforters unto thee? are not his servants come unto thee for to search, and to overthrow, and to spy out the land?
verses.fr: les chefs des fils d''Ammon dirent à Hanun: Penses-tu que ce soit pour honorer ton père que David t''envoie des consolateurs? N''est-ce pas pour reconnaître la ville et pour la détruire, et pour explorer le pays, que ses serviteurs sont venus auprès de toi?
verses.am: የአሞን ልጆች አለቆች ግን ሐኖንን። ዳዊት አባትህን አክብሮ የሚያጽናኑህን ወደ አንተ የላከ ይመስልሃልን? ባሪያዎቹስ አገሪቱን ለመመርመር፥ ለማጥፋት፥ ለመሰለልም ወደ አንተ የመጡ አይደሉምን? አሉት።

verses.en: Wherefore Hanun took David's servants, and shaved them, and cut off their garments in the midst hard by their buttocks, and sent them away.
verses.fr: Alors Hanun saisit les serviteurs de David, les fit raser, et fit couper leurs habits par le milieu jusqu''au haut des cuisses. Puis il les congédia.
verses.am: ሐኖንም የዳዊትን ባሪያዎች ወስዶ አስላጫቸው፥ ልብሳቸውንም እስከ ወገባቸው ድረስ ከሁለት ቀድዶ ሰደዳቸው።

verses.en: Then there went certain, and told David how the men were served. And he sent to meet them: for the men were greatly ashamed. And the king said, Tarry at Jericho until your beards be grown, and then return.
verses.fr: David, que l''on vint informer de ce qui était arrivé à ces hommes, envoya des gens à leur rencontre, car ils étaient dans une grande confusion; et le roi leur fit dire: Restez à Jéricho jusqu''à ce que votre barbe ait repoussé, et revenez ensuite.
verses.am: ወሬኞችም ሄደው በሰዎቹ ላይ የተደረገውን ለዳዊት አስታወቁት። ሰዎቹም በብዙ አፍረዋልና ተቀባዮች ላከ፤ ንጉሡም። ጢማችሁ እስኪያድግ ድረስ በኢያሪኮ ተቀመጡ፥ ከዚያም በኋላ ተመለሱ አለ።

verses.en: And when the children of Ammon saw that they had made themselves odious to David, Hanun and the children of Ammon sent a thousand talents of silver to hire them chariots and horsemen out of Mesopotamia, and out of Syriamaachah, and out of Zobah.
verses.fr: Les fils d''Ammon virent qu''ils s''étaient rendus odieux à David, et Hanun et les fils d''Ammon envoyèrent mille talents d''argent pour prendre à leur solde des chars et des cavaliers chez les Syriens de Mésopotamie et chez les Syriens de Maaca et de Tsoba.
verses.am: የአሞንም ልጆች በዳዊት ዘንድ እንደ ተጠሉ ባዩ ጊዜ ሐኖንና የአሞን ልጆች ከመስጴጦምያ፥ ከአራምመዓካ፥ ከሱባ ሰረገሎችንና ፈረሰኞችን ይቀጥሩ ዘንድ አንድ ሺህ መክሊት ብር ላኩ።

verses.en: So they hired thirty and two thousand chariots, and the king of Maachah and his people; who came and pitched before Medeba. And the children of Ammon gathered themselves together from their cities, and came to battle.
verses.fr: Ils prirent à leur solde trente-deux mille chars et le roi de Maaca avec son peuple, lesquels vinrent camper devant Médeba. Les fils d''Ammon se rassemblèrent de leurs villes, et marchèrent au combat.
verses.am: ሠላሳ ሁለትም ሺህ ሰረገሎች የመዓካንም ንጉሥ ሕዝቡንም ቀጠሩ፤ መጥተውም በሜድባ ፊት ለፊት ሰፈሩ። የአሞንም ልጆች ከየከተሞቻቸው ተሰብስበው ወደ ሰልፍ መጡ።

verses.en: And when David heard of it, he sent Joab, and all the host of the mighty men.
verses.fr: A cette nouvelle, David envoya contre eux Joab et toute l''armée, les hommes vaillants.
verses.am: ዳዊትም ይህ በሰማ ጊዜ ኢዮአብንና የኃያላኑን ሠራዊት ሁሉ ላከ።

verses.en: And the children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array before the gate of the city: and the kings that were come were by themselves in the field.
verses.fr: Les fils d''Ammon sortirent, et se rangèrent en bataille à l''entrée de la ville; les rois qui étaient venus prirent position séparément dans la campagne.
verses.am: የአሞንም ልጆች ወጥተው በከተማይቱ በር አጠገብ ተሰለፉ፤ የመጡትም ነገሥታት ለብቻቸው በሜዳው ላይ በሩ።

verses.en: Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind, he chose out of all the choice of Israel, and put them in array against the Syrians.
verses.fr: Joab vit qu''il avait à combattre par devant et par derrière. Il choisit alors sur toute l''élite d''Israël un corps, qu''il opposa aux Syriens;
verses.am: ኢዮአብም በፊትና በኋላ ሰልፍ እንደ ከበበው ባየ ጊዜ ከእስራኤል ምርጥ ምርጦችን ሁሉ ለይቶ በሶርያውያን ላይ አሰለፋቸው።

verses.en: And the rest of the people he delivered unto the hand of Abishai his brother, and they set themselves in array against the children of Ammon.
verses.fr: et il plaça sous le commandement de son frère Abischaï le reste du peuple, pour faire face aux fils d''Ammon.
verses.am: የቀረውንም ሕዝብ ለወንድሙ ለአቢሳ ሰጠው፥ በአሞንም ልጆች ላይ ተሰለፉ።

verses.en: And he said, If the Syrians be too strong for me, then thou shalt help me: but if the children of Ammon be too strong for thee, then I will help thee.
verses.fr: Il dit: Si les Syriens sont plus forts que moi, tu viendras à mon secours; et si les fils d''Ammon sont plus forts que toi, j''irai à ton secours.
verses.am: እርሱም። ሶርያውያን ቢበረቱብኝ እርዳኝ፤ የአሞንም ልጆች ቢበረቱብህ እረዳሃለሁ።

verses.en: Be of good courage, and let us behave ourselves valiantly for our people, and for the cities of our God: and let the Lord do that which is good in his sight.
verses.fr: Sois ferme, et montrons du courage pour notre peuple et pour les villes de notre Dieu, et que l''Eternel fasse ce qui lui semblera bon!
verses.am: አይዞህ፥ ስለ ሕዝባችንና ስለ አምላካችንም ከተሞች እንበርታ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ደስ ያሰኘውን ያድርግ አለ።

verses.en: So Joab and the people that were with him drew nigh before the Syrians unto the battle; and they fled before him.
verses.fr: Joab, avec son peuple, s''avança pour attaquer les Syriens, et ils s''enfuirent devant lui.
verses.am: ኢዮአብና ከእርሱም ጋር የነበረው ሕዝብ ለሰልፍ ወደ ሶርያውያን ፊት ቀረቡ፥ እነርሱም ከፊቱ ሸሹ።

verses.en: And when the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians were fled, they likewise fled before Abishai his brother, and entered into the city. Then Joab came to Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Et quand les fils d''Ammon virent que les Syriens avaient pris la fuite, ils s''enfuirent aussi devant Abischaï, frère de Joab, et rentrèrent dans la ville. Et Joab revint à Jérusalem.
verses.am: የአሞንም ልጆች ሶርያውያን እንደ ሸሹ ባዩ ጊዜ እነርሱ ደግሞ ከወንድሙ ከአቢሳ ፊት ሸሹ፥ ወደ ከተማይቱም ገቡ። ኢዮአብም ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም መጣ።

verses.en: And when the Syrians saw that they were put to the worse before Israel, they sent messengers, and drew forth the Syrians that were beyond the river: and Shophach the captain of the host of Hadarezer went before them.
verses.fr: Les Syriens, voyant qu''ils avaient été battus par Israël, envoyèrent chercher les Syriens qui étaient de l''autre côté du fleuve; et Schophach, chef de l''armée d''Hadarézer, était à leur tête.
verses.am: ሶርያውያንም በእስራኤል ፊት እንደ ተሸነፉ ባዩ ጊዜ መልእክተኞች ልከው በወንዝ ማዶ የነበሩትን ሶርያውያን አስመጡ፤ የአድርአዛርም ሠራዊት አለቃ ሾፋክ በፊታቸው ነበረ።

verses.en: And it was told David; and he gathered all Israel, and passed over Jordan, and came upon them, and set the battle in array against them. So when David had put the battle in array against the Syrians, they fought with him.
verses.fr: On l''annonça à David, qui assembla tout Israël, passa le Jourdain, marcha contre eux, et se prépara à les attaquer. David se rangea en bataille contre les Syriens.
verses.am: ዳዊትም በሰማ ጊዜ እስራኤልን ሁሉ ሰበሰበ፥ ዮርዳኖስንም ተሻግሮ መጣባቸው፥ ከእነርሱም ጋር ተዋጋ፤ ዳዊትም በሶርያውያን ላይ በተሰለፈ ጊዜ እነርሱ ከእርሱ ጋር ተዋጉ።

verses.en: But the Syrians fled before Israel; and David slew of the Syrians seven thousand men which fought in chariots, and forty thousand footmen, and killed Shophach the captain of the host.
verses.fr: Mais les Syriens, après s''être battus avec lui, s''enfuirent devant Israël. David leur tua les troupes de sept mille chars et quarante mille hommes de pied, et il fit mourir Schophach, chef de l''armée.
verses.am: ሶርያውያንም ከእስራኤል ፊት ሸሹ፤ ዳዊትም ከሶርያውያን ሰባት ሺህ ሰረገለኞች፥ አርባ ሺህም እግረኞች ገደለ፥ የሠራዊቱንም አለቃ ሾፋክን ገደለ።

verses.en: And when the servants of Hadarezer saw that they were put to the worse before Israel, they made peace with David, and became his servants: neither would the Syrians help the children of Ammon any more.
verses.fr: Les serviteurs d''Hadarézer, se voyant battus par Israël, firent la paix avec David et lui furent assujettis. Et les Syriens ne voulurent plus secourir les fils d''Ammon.
verses.am: የአድርአዛርም ባሪያዎች በእስራኤል ፊት እንደ ተሸነፉ ባዩ ጊዜ ከዳዊት ጋር ታረቁ፥ ገበሩለትም፤ ሶርያውያንም ከዚያ ወዲያ የአሞንን ልጆች ይረዱ ዘንድ እንቢ አሉ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, that after the year was expired, at the time that kings go out to battle, Joab led forth the power of the army, and wasted the country of the children of Ammon, and came and besieged Rabbah. But David tarried at Jerusalem. And Joab smote Rabbah, and destroyed it.
verses.fr: L''année suivante, au temps où les rois se mettaient en campagne, Joab, à la tête d''une forte armée, alla ravager le pays des fils d''Ammon et assiéger Rabba. Mais David resta à Jérusalem. Joab battit Rabba et la détruisit.
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ በዓመት መለወጫ ነገሥታት ወደ ሰልፍ በሚወጡበት ጊዜ ኢዮአብ ሠራዊቱን አወጣ፥ የአሞንንም ልጆች አገር አጠፋ፤ መጥቶም ረባትን ከበበ። ዳዊትም በኢየሩሳሌም ቈይቶ ነበር።

verses.en: And David took the crown of their king from off his head, and found it to weigh a talent of gold, and there were precious stones in it; and it was set upon David's head: and he brought also exceeding much spoil out of the city.
verses.fr: David enleva la couronne de dessus la tête de son roi, et la trouva du poids d''un talent d''or: elle était garnie de pierres précieuses. On la mit sur la tête de David, qui emporta de la ville un très grand butin.
verses.am: ኢዮአብም ረባትን መትቶ አፈረሳት። ዳዊትም የንጉሣቸውን ዘውድ ከራሱ ላይ ወሰደ፥ ክብደቱም አንድ መክሊት ወርቅ ያህል ነበረ፥ ክቡርም ዕንቍ ነበረበት፥ በዳዊትም ራስ ላይ አስቀመጡት፤ ከከተማይቱም እጅግ ብዙ ምርኮ አወጣ።

verses.en: And he brought out the people that were in it, and cut them with saws, and with harrows of iron, and with axes. Even so dealt David with all the cities of the children of Ammon. And David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Il fit sortir les habitants, et il les mit en pièces avec des scies, des herses de fer et des haches; il traita de même toutes les villes des fils d''Ammon. David retourna à Jérusalem avec tout le peuple.
verses.am: በውስጥዋም የነበረውን ሕዝብ አውጥቶ በመጋዝና በብረት መቈፈሪያ በመጥረቢያም እንዲሠሩ አደረጋቸው። እንዲሁም ዳዊት በአሞን ልጆች ከተሞች ሁሉ አደረገ። ዳዊትም ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ተመለሱ።

verses.en: And it came to pass after this, that there arose war at Gezer with the Philistines; at which time Sibbechai the Hushathite slew Sippai, that was of the children of the giant: and they were subdued.
verses.fr: Après cela, il y eut une bataille à Guézer avec les Philistins. Alors Sibbecaï, le Huschatite, tua Sippaï, l''un des enfants de Rapha. Et les Philistins furent humiliés.
verses.am: ከዚህም በኋላ በጌዝር ላይ ከፍልስጥኤማውያን ጋር ሰልፍ ሆነ፤ ኩሳታዊውም ሴቦካይ ከራፋይም ወገን የነበረውን ሲፋይን ገደለ።

verses.en: And there was war again with the Philistines; and Elhanan the son of Jair slew Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, whose spear staff was like a weaver's beam.
verses.fr: Il y eut encore une bataille avec les Philistins. Et Elchanan, fils de Jaïr, tua le frère de Goliath, Lachmi de Gath, qui avait une lance dont le bois était comme une ensouple de tisserand.
verses.am: ደግሞም ከፍልስጥኤማውያን ጋር ሰልፍ ነበረ፤ የያዒርም ልጅ ኤልያናን የጦሩ የቦ እንደ ሸማኔ መጠቅለያ የነበረውን የጌት ሰው የጎልያድን ወንድም ለሕሚን ገደለ።

verses.en: And yet again there was war at Gath, where was a man of great stature, whose fingers and toes were four and twenty, six on each hand, and six on each foot and he also was the son of the giant.
verses.fr: Il y eut encore une bataille à Gath. Il s''y trouva un homme de haute taille, qui avait six doigts à chaque main et à chaque pied, vingt-quatre en tout, et qui était aussi issu de Rapha.
verses.am: ደግሞ በጌት ላይ ሰልፍ ነበረ፤ ከዚያም በእጁና በእግሩ ስድስት ስድስት ሁላሁሉ ሀያ አራት ጣቶች ያሉት አንድ ረጅም ሰው ነበረ፤ እርሱም ደግሞ ከራፋይም የተወለደ ነበረ።

verses.en: But when he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimea David's brother slew him.
verses.fr: Il jeta un défi à Israël; et Jonathan, fils de Schimea, frère de David, le tua.
verses.am: እስራኤልንም በተገዳደረ ጊዜ የዳዊት ወንድም የሳምዓ ልጅ ዮናታን ገደለው።

verses.en: These were born unto the giant in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David, and by the hand of his servants.
verses.fr: Ces hommes étaient des enfants de Rapha à Gath. Ils périrent par la main de David et par la main de ses serviteurs.
verses.am: እነዚያም በጌት ውስጥ ከራፋይም የተወለዱ ነበሩ፤ በዳዊትም እጅ በባሪያዎቹም እጅ ወደቁ።

verses.en: And Satan stood up against Israel, and provoked David to number Israel.
verses.fr: Satan se leva contre Israël, et il excita David à faire le dénombrement d''Israël.
verses.am: ሰይጣንም በእስራኤል ላይ ተነሣ፥ እስራኤልንም ይቈጥር ዘንድ ዳዊትን አንቀሳቀሰው።

verses.en: And David said to Joab and to the rulers of the people, Go, number Israel from Beersheba even to Dan; and bring the number of them to me, that I may know it.
verses.fr: Et David dit à Joab et aux chefs du peuple: Allez, faites le dénombrement d''Israël, depuis Beer-Schéba jusqu''à Dan, et rapportez-le-moi, afin que je sache à combien il s''élève.
verses.am: ዳዊትም ኢዮአብንና የሕዝቡን አለቆች። ሂዱ፥ ከቤርሳቤህ ጀምሮ እስከ ዳን ድረስ እስራኤልን ቍጠሩ፥ ድምራቸውንም አውቅ ዘንድ አስታውቁኝ አላቸው።

verses.en: And Joab answered, The Lord make his people an hundred times so many more as they be: but, my lord the king, are they not all my lord's servants? why then doth my lord require this thing? why will he be a cause of trespass to Israel?
verses.fr: Joab répondit: Que l''Eternel rende son peuple cent fois plus nombreux! O roi mon seigneur, ne sont-ils pas tous serviteurs de mon seigneur? Mais pourquoi mon seigneur demande-t-il cela? Pourquoi faire ainsi pécher Israël?
verses.am: ኢዮአብም። እግዚአብሔር ሕዝቡን በአሁኑ ላይ መቶ እጥፍ ይጨምር፤ ጌታዬ ንጉሥ ሆይ፥ ሁሉ የጌታዬ ባሪያዎች አይደሉምን? ይህን ነገር ጌታዬ ለምን ይሻል? በእስራኤል ላይ በደል ስለ ምን ያመጣል?

verses.en: Nevertheless the king's word prevailed against Joab. Wherefore Joab departed, and went throughout all Israel, and came to Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Le roi persista dans l''ordre qu''il donnait à Joab. Et Joab partit, et parcourut tout Israël; puis il revint à Jérusalem.
verses.am: ነገር ግን የንጉሡ ቃል በኢዮአብ ላይ አሸነፈ፤ ኢዮአብም ወጥቶ በእስራኤል ሁሉ ላይ ተዘዋወረ፥ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌምም መጣ።

verses.en: And Joab gave the sum of the number of the people unto David. And all they of Israel were a thousand thousand and an hundred thousand men that drew sword: and Judah was four hundred threescore and ten thousand men that drew sword.
verses.fr: Joab remit à David le rôle du dénombrement du peuple: il y avait dans tout Israël onze cent mille hommes tirant l''épée, et en Juda quatre cent soixante-dix mille hommes tirant l''épée.
verses.am: ኢዮአብም የቈጠራቸውን የሕዝቡን ድምር ለዳዊት ሰጠ፤ ከእስራኤልም ሁሉ አንድ ሚሊዮን ከመቶ ሺህ ሰይፍ የሚመዝዙ ሰዎችን አገኘ፤ ከይሁዳም አራት መቶ ሰባ ሺህ ሰይፍ የሚመዝዙ ሰዎችን አገኘ።

verses.en: But Levi and Benjamin counted he not among them: for the king's word was abominable to Joab.
verses.fr: Il ne fit point parmi eux le dénombrement de Lévi et de Benjamin, car l''ordre du roi lui paraissait une abomination.
verses.am: የንጉሡ ትእዛዝ ግን በኢዮአብ ዘንድ የተጠላ ነበርና ሌዊና ብንያም ከእነርሱ ጋር አልተቈጠሩም።

verses.en: And God was displeased with this thing; therefore he smote Israel.
verses.fr: Cet ordre déplut à Dieu, qui frappa Israël.
verses.am: ከዚህም ነገር የተነሣ እግዚአብሔር ተቈጣ፥ እስራኤልንም ቀሠፈ።

verses.en: And David said unto God, I have sinned greatly, because I have done this thing: but now, I beseech thee, do away the iniquity of thy servant; for I have done very foolishly.
verses.fr: Et David dit à Dieu: J''ai commis un grand péché en faisant cela! Maintenant, daigne pardonner l''iniquité de ton serviteur, car j''ai complètement agi en insensé!
verses.am: ዳዊትም እግዚአብሔርን። ይህን በማድረግ እጅግ በድያለሁ፤ አሁን ግን ታላቅ ስንፍና አድርጌአለሁና የባሪያህን ኃጢአት ታስወግድ ዘንድ እለምንሃለሁ አለው።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Gad, David's seer, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel adressa ainsi la parole à Gad, le voyant de David:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ለዳዊት ባለ ራእይ ለጋድ።

verses.en: Go and tell David, saying, Thus saith the Lord, I offer thee three things: choose thee one of them, that I may do it unto thee.
verses.fr: Va dire à David: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Je te propose trois fléaux; choisis-en un, et je t''en frapperai.
verses.am: ሂድ፥ ለዳዊት። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ሦስቱን ነገሮች በፊትህ አኖራለሁ፤ አደርግብህ ዘንድ ከእነርሱ አንዱን ምረጥ ብለህ ንገረው ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: So Gad came to David, and said unto him, Thus saith the Lord, Choose thee
verses.fr: Gad alla vers David, et lui dit: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Accepte,
verses.am: ጋድም ወደ ዳዊት መጥቶ። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። የምትወድደውን ምረጥ፤

verses.en: Either three years' famine; or three months to be destroyed before thy foes, while that the sword of thine enemies overtaketh thee; or else three days the sword of the Lord, even the pestilence, in the land, and the angel of the Lord destroying throughout all the coasts of Israel. Now therefore advise thyself what word I shall bring again to him that sent me.
verses.fr: ou trois années de famine, ou trois mois pendant lesquels tu seras détruit par tes adversaires et atteint par l''épée de tes ennemis, ou trois jours pendant lesquels l''épée de l''Eternel et la peste seront dans le pays et l''ange de l''Eternel portera la destruction dans tout le territoire d''Israël. Vois maintenant ce que je dois répondre à celui qui m''envoie.
verses.am: የሦስት ዓመት ራብ፥ ወይም ሦስት ወር የጠላቶችህ ሰይፍ እንዲያገኝህ ከጠላቶችህ መሰደድን፥ ወይም ሦስት ቀን የእግዚአብሔር ሰይፍ ቸነፈርም በምድር ላይ መሆንን፥ የእግዚአብሔርም መልአክ በእስራኤል ምድር ሁሉ ማጥፋትን ምረጥ፤ አሁንም ለላከኝ ምን እንድመልስ ተመልከት አለው።

verses.en: And David said unto Gad, I am in a great strait: let me fall now into the hand of the Lord; for very great are his mercies: but let me not fall into the hand of man.
verses.fr: David répondit à Gad: Je suis dans une grande angoisse! Oh! que je tombe entre les mains de l''Eternel, car ses compassions sont immenses; mais que je ne tombe pas entre les mains des hommes!
verses.am: ዳዊትም ጋድን። እጅግ ተጨንቄአለሁ፤ ምሕረቱ ብዙ ነውና በእግዚአብሔር እጅ ልውደቅ፤ በሰው እጅ ግን አልውደቅ አለው።

verses.en: So the Lord sent pestilence upon Israel: and there fell of Israel seventy thousand men.
verses.fr: L''Eternel envoya la peste en Israël, et il tomba soixante-dix mille hommes d''Israël.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በእስራኤል ላይ ቸነፈርን ሰደደ፤ ከእስራኤልም ሰባ ሺህ ሰዎች ወደቁ።

verses.en: And God sent an angel unto Jerusalem to destroy it: and as he was destroying, the Lord beheld, and he repented him of the evil, and said to the angel that destroyed, It is enough, stay now thine hand. And the angel of the Lord stood by the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.
verses.fr: Dieu envoya un ange à Jérusalem pour la détruire; et comme il la détruisait, l''Eternel regarda et se repentit de ce mal, et il dit à l''ange qui détruisait: Assez! Retire maintenant ta main. L''ange de l''Eternel se tenait près de l''aire d''Ornan, le Jébusien.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ያጠፋት ዘንድ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም መልአክን ሰደደ፤ ሊያጠፋትም በቀረበ ጊዜ እግዚአብሔር አይቶ ስለ ክፉው ነገር ተጸጸተ፥ የሚያጠፋውንም መልአክ። በቃህ፤ አሁን እጅህን መልስ አለው። የእግዚአብሔርም መልአክ በኢያቡሳዊው በኦርና አውድማ አጠገብ ቆሞ ነበር።

verses.en: And David lifted up his eyes, and saw the angel of the Lord stand between the earth and the heaven, having a drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem. Then David and the elders of Israel, who were clothed in sackcloth, fell upon their faces.
verses.fr: David leva les yeux, et vit l''ange de l''Eternel se tenant entre la terre et le ciel et ayant à la main son épée nue tournée contre Jérusalem. Alors David et les anciens, couverts de sacs, tombèrent sur leur visage.
verses.am: ዳዊትም ዓይኖቹን አነሣ፤ የእግዚአብሔር መልአክ በምድርና በሰማይ መካከል ቆሞ፥ የተመዘዘም ሰይፍ በእጁ ሆኖ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ተዘርግቶ አየ። ዳዊትም ሽማግሌዎችም ማቅ ለብሰው በግምባራቸው ተደፉ።

verses.en: And David said unto God, Is it not I that commanded the people to be numbered? even I it is that have sinned and done evil indeed; but as for these sheep, what have they done? let thine hand, I pray thee, O Lord my God, be on me, and on my father's house; but not on thy people, that they should be plagued.
verses.fr: Et David dit à Dieu: N''est-ce pas moi qui ai ordonné le dénombrement du peuple? C''est moi qui ai péché et qui ai fait le mal; mais ces brebis, qu''ont-elles fait? Eternel, mon Dieu, que ta main soit donc sur moi et sur la maison de mon père, et qu''elle ne fasse point une plaie parmi ton peuple!
verses.am: ዳዊትም እግዚአብሔርን። ሕዝቡ ይቈጠር ዘንድ ያዘዝሁ እኔ አይደለሁምን? የበደልሁና ክፉ የሠራሁ እኔ ነኝ፤ እነዚህ በጎች ግን ምን አድርገዋል? አቤቱ አምላኬ ሆይ፥ እጅህ በእኔና በአባቴ ቤት ላይ ትሁን፥ ነገር ግን ይቀሠፍ ዘንድ በሕዝብህ ላይ አትሁን አለው።

verses.en: Then the angel of the Lord commanded Gad to say to David, that David should go up, and set up an altar unto the Lord in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.
verses.fr: L''ange de l''Eternel dit à Gad de parler à David, afin qu''il montât pour élever un autel à l''Eternel dans l''aire d''Ornan, le Jébusien.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም መልአክ ዳዊት ወጥቶ በኢያቡሳዊው በኦርና አውድማ ላይ ለእግዚአብሔር መሠዊያ ይሠራ ዘንድ ለዳዊት እንዲነግረው ጋድን አዘዘው።

verses.en: And David went up at the saying of Gad, which he spake in the name of the Lord.
verses.fr: David monta, selon la parole que Gad avait prononcée au nom de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ዳዊትም በእግዚአብሔር ስም እንደ ተናገረው እንደ ጋድ ነገር ወጣ።

verses.en: And Ornan turned back, and saw the angel; and his four sons with him hid themselves. Now Ornan was threshing wheat.
verses.fr: Ornan se retourna et vit l''ange, et ses quatre fils se cachèrent avec lui: il foulait alors du froment.
verses.am: ኦርናም ዘወር ብሎ መልአኩን አየ፥ ከእርሱም ጋር የነበሩ አራቱ ልጆቹ ተሸሸጉ፤ ኦርናም ስንዴ ያበራይ ነበር።

verses.en: And as David came to Ornan, Ornan looked and saw David, and went out of the threshingfloor, and bowed himself to David with his face to the ground.
verses.fr: Lorsque David arriva auprès d''Ornan, Ornan regarda, et il aperçut David; puis il sortit de l''aire, et se prosterna devant David, le visage contre terre.
verses.am: ዳዊትም ወደ ኦርና በመጣ ጊዜ ኦርና ተመልክቶ ዳዊትን አየ፤ ከአውድማውም ወጥቶ ዳዊትን እጅ ሊነሣ በምድር ላይ ተደፋ።

verses.en: Then David said to Ornan, Grant me the place of this threshingfloor, that I may build an altar therein unto the Lord: thou shalt grant it me for the full price: that the plague may be stayed from the people.
verses.fr: David dit à Ornan: Cède-moi l''emplacement de l''aire pour que j''y bâtisse un autel à l''Eternel; cède-le-moi contre sa valeur en argent, afin que la plaie se retire de dessus le peuple.
verses.am: ዳዊትም ኦርናን። በላዩ ለእግዚአብሔር መሠዊያ እሠራ ዘንድ ይህን የአውድማ ስፍራ ስጠኝ፤ በሙሉ ዋጋ ስጠኝ፤ መቅሠፍቱን ከሕዝቡ ይከለከላል አለው።

verses.en: And Ornan said unto David, Take it to thee, and let my lord the king do that which is good in his eyes: lo, I give thee the oxen also for burnt offerings, and the threshing instruments for wood, and the wheat for the meat offering; I give it all.
verses.fr: Ornan répondit à David: Prends-le, et que mon seigneur le roi fasse ce qui lui semblera bon; vois, je donne les boeufs pour l''holocauste, les chars pour le bois, et le froment pour l''offrande, je donne tout cela.
verses.am: ኦርናም ዳዊትን። ለአንተ ውሰደው፥ ጌታዬ ንጉሡም ደስ የሚያሰኘውን ያድርግ፤ እነሆ፥ ለሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕት በሬዎቹን፥ ለእንጨትም የአውድማውን ዕቃ፥ ከእህልም ቍርባን ስንዴውን እሰጥሃለሁ፤ ሁሉን እሰጣለሁ አለው።

verses.en: And king David said to Ornan, Nay; but I will verily buy it for the full price: for I will not take that which is thine for the Lord, nor offer burnt offerings without cost.
verses.fr: Mais le roi David dit à Ornan: Non! je veux l''acheter contre sa valeur en argent, car je ne présenterai point à l''Eternel ce qui est à toi, et je n''offrirai point un holocauste qui ne me coûte rien.
verses.am: ንጉሡም ዳዊት ኦርናን። አይደለም፥ ነገር ግን ለአንተ ያለውን ለእግዚአብሔር አምጥቼ የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት በከንቱ አላቀርብምና በሙሉ ዋጋ እገዛዋለሁ አለው።

verses.en: So David gave to Ornan for the place six hundred shekels of gold by weight.
verses.fr: Et David donna à Ornan six cents sicles d''or pour l''emplacement.
verses.am: ዳዊትም ስለ ስፍራው ስድስት መቶ ሰቅል ወርቅ በሚዛን ለኦርና ሰጠው።

verses.en: And David built there an altar unto the Lord, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings, and called upon the Lord; and he answered him from heaven by fire upon the altar of burnt offering.
verses.fr: David bâtit là un autel à l''Eternel, et il offrit des holocaustes et des sacrifices d''actions de grâces. Il invoqua l''Eternel, et l''Eternel lui répondit par le feu, qui descendit du ciel sur l''autel de l''holocauste.
verses.am: ዳዊትም በዚያ ለእግዚአብሔር መሠዊያ ሠራ፥ የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕትና የደኅንነቱን መሥዋዕት አቀረበ፥ እግዚአብሔርንም ጠራ፤ ከሰማይም ለሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕት በሚሆነው መሠዊያ ላይ በእሳት መለሰለት።

verses.en: And the Lord commanded the angel; and he put up his sword again into the sheath thereof.
verses.fr: Alors l''Eternel parla à l''ange, qui remit son épée dans le fourreau.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም መልአኩን አዘዘው፥ ሰይፉንም በአፎቱ ከተተው።

verses.en: At that time when David saw that the Lord had answered him in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite, then he sacrificed there.
verses.fr: A cette époque-là, David, voyant que l''Eternel l''avait exaucé dans l''aire d''Ornan, le Jébusien, y offrait des sacrifices.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ እግዚአብሔር በኢያቡሳዊው በኦርና አውድማ እንደ መለሰለት ዳዊት ባየ ጊዜ፥ በዚያ መሥዋዕት ሠዋ።

verses.en: For the tabernacle of the Lord, which Moses made in the wilderness, and the altar of the burnt offering, were at that season in the high place at Gibeon.
verses.fr: Mais le tabernacle de l''Eternel, construit par Moïse au désert, et l''autel des holocaustes, étaient alors sur le haut lieu de Gabaon.
verses.am: ሙሴም በምድረ በዳ የሠራት የእግዚአብሔር ማደሪያና ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት የሚሆነው መሠዊያ በዚያን ጊዜ በገባዖን ባለው በኮረብታው መስገጃ ነበሩ።

verses.en: But David could not go before it to enquire of God: for he was afraid because of the sword of the angel of the Lord.
verses.fr: David ne pouvait pas aller devant cet autel pour chercher Dieu, parce que l''épée de l''ange de l''Eternel lui avait causé de l''épouvante.
verses.am: ዳዊት ግን የእግዚአብሔርን መልአክ ሰይፍ ስለ ፈራ እግዚአብሔርን ለመጠየቅ ወደዚያ ይሄድ ዘንድ አልቻለም።

verses.en: Then David said, This is the house of the Lord God, and this is the altar of the burnt offering for Israel.
verses.fr: Et David dit: Ici sera la maison de l''Eternel Dieu, et ici sera l''autel des holocaustes pour Israël.
verses.am: ዳዊትም። ይህ የእግዚአብሔር ቤት ነው፥ ይህም ለእስራኤል ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት የሚሆነው መሠዊያ ነው አለ።

verses.en: And David commanded to gather together the strangers that were in the land of Israel; and he set masons to hew wrought stones to build the house of God.
verses.fr: David fit rassembler les étrangers qui étaient dans le pays d''Israël, et il chargea des tailleurs de pierres de préparer des pierres de taille pour la construction de la maison de Dieu.
verses.am: ዳዊትም በእስራኤል ምድር የነበሩትን መጻተኞች ይሰበስቡ ዘንድ አዘዘ፤ የእግዚአብሔርንም ቤት ለመሥራት የሚወቀሩትን ድንጋዮች ይወቅሩ ዘንድ ጠራቢዎችን አኖረ።

verses.en: And David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates, and for the joinings; and brass in abundance without weight;
verses.fr: Il prépara aussi du fer en abondance pour les clous des battants des portes et pour les crampons, de l''airain en quantité telle qu''il n''était pas possible de le peser,
verses.am: ዳዊትም ለበሮቹ ሳንቃ ለሚሆኑ ለምስማርና ለመጠረቂያ ብዙ ብረት፥ ከብዛቱም የተነሣ የማይመዘን ናስ አዘጋጀ።

verses.en: Also cedar trees in abundance: for the Zidonians and they of Tyre brought much cedar wood to David.
verses.fr: et des bois de cèdre sans nombre, car les Sidoniens et les Tyriens avaient amené à David des bois de cèdre en abondance.
verses.am: ሲዶናውያውንና የጢሮስ ሰዎች ብዙ የዝግባ እንጨት ወደ ዳዊት ያመጡ ነበርና ቍጥር ያሌላቸውን የዝግባ እንጨቶች አዘጋጀ።

verses.en: And David said, Solomon my son is young and tender, and the house that is to be builded for the Lord must be exceeding magnifical, of fame and of glory throughout all countries: I will therefore now make preparation for it. So David prepared abundantly before his death.
verses.fr: David disait: Mon fils Salomon est jeune et d''un âge faible, et la maison qui sera bâtie à l''Eternel s''élèvera à un haut degré de renommée et de gloire dans tous les pays; c''est pourquoi je veux faire pour lui des préparatifs. Et David fit beaucoup de préparatifs avant sa mort.
verses.am: ዳዊትም። ልጄ ሰሎሞን ታናሽና ለጋ ብላቴና ነው፥ ለእግዚአብሔርም የሚሠራው ቤት እጅግ ማለፊያና በአገሩ ሁሉ ስሙና ክብሩ እንዲጠራ ይሆን ዘንድ ይገባል፤ ስለዚህ አዘጋጅለታለሁ አለ። ዳዊትም ሳይሞት አስቀድሞ ብዙ አዘጋጀ።

verses.en: Then he called for Solomon his son, and charged him to build an house for the Lord God of Israel.
verses.fr: David appela Salomon, son fils, et lui ordonna de bâtir une maison à l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël.
verses.am: ልጁንም ሰሎሞንን ጠርቶ ለእስራኤል አምላክ ለእግዚአብሔር ስም ቤት ይሠራ ዘንድ አዘዘው።

verses.en: And David said to Solomon, My son, as for me, it was in my mind to build an house unto the name of the Lord my God:
verses.fr: David dit à Salomon: Mon fils, j''avais l''intention de bâtir une maison au nom de l''Eternel, mon Dieu.
verses.am: ዳዊትም ሰሎሞንን እንዲህ አለ። ልጄ ሆይ፥ እኔ ለአምላኬ ለእግዚአብሔር ቤት እሠራ ዘንድ በልቤ አስቤ ነበር።

verses.en: But the word of the Lord came to me, saying, Thou hast shed blood abundantly, and hast made great wars: thou shalt not build an house unto my name, because thou hast shed much blood upon the earth in my sight.
verses.fr: Mais la parole de l''Eternel m''a été ainsi adressée: Tu as versé beaucoup de sang, et tu as fait de grandes guerres; tu ne bâtiras pas une maison à mon nom, car tu as versé devant moi beaucoup de sang sur la terre.
verses.am: ነገር ግን የእግዚአብሔር ቃል እንዲህ ሲል ወደ እኔ መጣ። እጅግ ደም አፍስሰሃል፥ ታላቅም ሰልፍ አድርገሃል፤ በፊቴ በምድር ላይ ብዙ ደም አፍስሰሃልና ለስሜ ቤት አትሠራም።

verses.en: Behold, a son shall be born to thee, who shall be a man of rest; and I will give him rest from all his enemies round about: for his name shall be Solomon, and I will give peace and quietness unto Israel in his days.
verses.fr: Voici, il te naîtra un fils, qui sera un homme de repos, et à qui je donnerai du repos en le délivrant de tous ses ennemis d''alentour; car Salomon sera son nom, et je ferai venir sur Israël la paix et la tranquillité pendant sa vie.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ የዕረፍት ሰው የሚሆን ልጅ ይወለድልሃል፤ በዙሪያው ካሉ ከጠላቶቹ ሁሉ አሳርፈዋለሁ፤ ስሙ ሰሎሞን ይባላልና፥ በዘመኑም ሰላምንና ጸጥታን ለእስራኤል እሰጣለሁ።

verses.en: He shall build an house for my name; and he shall be my son, and I will be his father; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel for ever.
verses.fr: Ce sera lui qui bâtira une maison à mon nom. Il sera pour moi un fils, et je serai pour lui un père; et j''affermirai pour toujours le trône de son royaume en Israël.
verses.am: እርሱ ለስሜ ቤት ይሠራል፥ ልጅም ይሆነኛል፥ እኔም አባት እሆነዋለሁ፤ የመንግሥቱንም ዙፋን በእስራኤል ላይ ለዘላለም አጸናለሁ።

verses.en: Now, my son, the Lord be with thee; and prosper thou, and build the house of the Lord thy God, as he hath said of thee.
verses.fr: Maintenant, mon fils, que l''Eternel soit avec toi, afin que tu prospères et que tu bâtisses la maison de l''Eternel, ton Dieu, comme il l''a déclaré à ton égard!
verses.am: አሁንም፥ ልጄ ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔር ከአንተ ጋር ይሁን፤ ስለ አንተም እንደ ተናገረው ያከናውንልህ፥ የአምላክህንም የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ሥራ።

verses.en: Only the Lord give thee wisdom and understanding, and give thee charge concerning Israel, that thou mayest keep the law of the Lord thy God.
verses.fr: Veuille seulement l''Eternel t''accorder de la sagesse et de l''intelligence, et te faire régner sur Israël dans l''observation de la loi de l''Eternel, ton Dieu!
verses.am: ብቻ የአምላክህን የእግዚአብሔርን ሕግ ትጠብቅ ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር ጥበብንና ማስተዋልን ይስጥህ፥ በእስራኤልም ላይ ያሠልጥንህ።

verses.en: Then shalt thou prosper, if thou takest heed to fulfil the statutes and judgments which the Lord charged Moses with concerning Israel: be strong, and of good courage; dread not, nor be dismayed.
verses.fr: Alors tu prospéreras, si tu as soin de mettre en pratique les lois et les ordonnances que l''Eternel a prescrites à Moïse pour Israël. Fortifie-toi et prends courage, ne crains point et ne t''effraie point.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ስለ እስራኤል ሙሴን ያዘዘውን ሥርዓትና ፍርድ ታደርግ ዘንድ ብትጠነቀቅ በዚያን ጊዜ ይከናወንልሃል፤ አይዞህ፥ በርታ፤ አትፍራ፥ አትደንግጥም።

verses.en: Now, behold, in my trouble I have prepared for the house of the Lord an hundred thousand talents of gold, and a thousand thousand talents of silver; and of brass and iron without weight; for it is in abundance: timber also and stone have I prepared; and thou mayest add thereto.
verses.fr: Voici, par mes efforts, j''ai préparé pour la maison de l''Eternel cent mille talents d''or, un million de talents d''argent, et une quantité d''airain et de fer qu''il n''est pas possible de peser, car il y en a en abondance; j''ai aussi préparé du bois et des pierres, et tu en ajouteras encore.
verses.am: አሁንም፥ እነሆ፥ በድህነቴ ለእግዚአብሔር ቤት መቶ ሺህ መክሊት ወርቅና አንድ ሚሊዮን መክሊት ብር፥ ሚዛንም የሌላቸው ብዙ ናስና ብረት አዘጋጀሁ፤ ደግሞም እንጨትና ድንጋዮች አዘጋጀሁ፥ አንተም ከዚያ በላይ ጨምር።

verses.en: Moreover there are workmen with thee in abundance, hewers and workers of stone and timber, and all manner of cunning men for every manner of work.
verses.fr: Tu as auprès de toi un grand nombre d''ouvriers, des tailleurs de pierres, et des charpentiers, et des hommes habiles dans toute espèce d''ouvrages.
verses.am: በአንተም ዘንድ ብዙ ሠራተኞች፥ ድንጋይና እንጨት ወቃሪዎችና ጠራቢዎች፥ ሥራውንም ሁሉ ለማድረግ ጠቢባን ሰዎች ሁሉ አሉ።

verses.en: Of the gold, the silver, and the brass, and the iron, there is no number. Arise therefore, and be doing, and the Lord be with thee.
verses.fr: L''or, l''argent, l''airain et le fer, sont sans nombre. Lève-toi et agis, et que l''Eternel soit avec toi!
verses.am: የሚሠሩበት ወርቅና ብር ናስና ብረት ቍጥር የለውም፤ ተነሥተህ ሥራ፥ እግዚአብሔርም ከአንተ ጋር ይሁን።

verses.en: David also commanded all the princes of Israel to help Solomon his son, saying,
verses.fr: David ordonna à tous les chefs d''Israël de venir en aide à Salomon, son fils.
verses.am: ዳዊትም ደግሞ ልጁን ሰሎሞንን ያግዙ ዘንድ የእስራኤልን አለቆች ሁሉ እንዲህ ሲል አዘዛቸው።

verses.en: Is not the Lord your God with you? and hath he not given you rest on every side? for he hath given the inhabitants of the land into mine hand; and the land is subdued before the Lord, and before his people.
verses.fr: L''Eternel, votre Dieu, n''est-il pas avec vous, et ne vous a-t-il pas donné du repos de tous côtés? Car il a livré entre mes mains les habitants du pays, et le pays est assujetti devant l''Eternel et devant son peuple.
verses.am: አምላካችሁ እግዚአብሔር ከእናንተ ጋር አይደለምን? በምድርም የሚቀመጡትን በእጄ አሳልፎ ሰጥቶአልና፥ ምድርም በእግዚአብሔርና በሕዝቡ ፊት ተገዝታለችና በዙሪያችሁ ሁሉ ዕረፍትን ሰጥቶአችኋል።

verses.en: Now set your heart and your soul to seek the Lord your God; arise therefore, and build ye the sanctuary of the Lord God, to bring the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and the holy vessels of God, into the house that is to be built to the name of the Lord.
verses.fr: Appliquez maintenant votre coeur et votre âme à chercher l''Eternel, votre Dieu; levez-vous, et bâtissez le sanctuaire de l''Eternel Dieu, afin d''amener l''arche de l''alliance de l''Eternel et les ustensiles consacrés à Dieu dans la maison qui sera bâtie au nom de l''Eternel.
verses.am: አሁንም አምላካችሁን እግዚአብሔርን ትፈልጉ ዘንድ ልባችሁንና ነፍሳችሁን ስጡ፤ ለእግዚአብሔርም ስም ወደሚሠራው ቤት የእግዚአብሔርን የቃል ኪዳኑን ታቦትና የእግዚአብሔርን ንዋየ ቅድሳት ታመጡ ዘንድ ተነሥታችሁ የአምላክን የእግዚአብሔርን መቅደስ ሥሩ።

verses.en: So when David was old and full of days, he made Solomon his son king over Israel.
verses.fr: David, âgé et rassasié de jours, établit Salomon, son fils, roi sur Israël.
verses.am: ዳዊትም በሸመገለ ጊዜ፥ ዕድሜንም በጠገበ ጊዜ ልጁን ሰሎሞንን በእስራኤል ላይ አነገሠው።

verses.en: And he gathered together all the princes of Israel, with the priests and the Levites.
verses.fr: Il assembla tous les chefs d''Israël, les sacrificateurs et les Lévites.
verses.am: የእስራኤልንም አለቆች ሁሉ፥ ካህናቱንም፥ ሌዋውያኑንም ሰበሰበ።

verses.en: Now the Levites were numbered from the age of thirty years and upward: and their number by their polls, man by man, was thirty and eight thousand.
verses.fr: On fit le dénombrement des Lévites, depuis l''âge de trente ans et au-dessus; comptés par tête et par homme, ils se trouvèrent au nombre de trente-huit mille.
verses.am: ሌዋውያንም ከሠላሳ ዓመት ዕድሜ ጀምሮ ወደ ላይ ተቈጠሩ፤ ቍጥራቸው በእያንዳንዱ ነፍስ ወከፍ ሠላሳ ስምንት ሺህ ነበረ።

verses.en: Of which, twenty and four thousand were to set forward the work of the house of the Lord; and six thousand were officers and judges:
verses.fr: Et David dit: Qu''il y en ait vingt-quatre mille pour veiller aux offices de la maison de l''Eternel, six mille comme magistrats et juges,
verses.am: ከእነዚህም ውስጥ የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ሥራ የሚያሠሩት ሀያ አራት ሺህ ነበሩ፤ ስድስቱ ሺህም አለቆችና ፈራጆች ነበሩ።

verses.en: Moreover four thousand were porters; and four thousand praised the Lord with the instruments which I made, said David, to praise therewith.
verses.fr: quatre mille comme portiers, et quatre mille chargés de louer l''Eternel avec les instruments que j''ai faits pour le célébrer.
verses.am: አራቱ ሺህም በረኞች ነበሩ፤ አራቱ ሺህም ለምስጋና በተሠሩት በዜማ ዕቃዎች እግዚአብሔርን ያመሰግኑ ነበር።

verses.en: And David divided them into courses among the sons of Levi, namely, Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.fr: David les divisa en classes d''après les fils de Lévi, Guerschon, Kehath et Merari.
verses.am: ዳዊትም እንደ ሌዊ ልጆች እንደ ጌድሶንና እንደ ቀዓት እነደ ሜራሪም በየሰሞናቸው ከፈላቸው።

verses.en: Of the Gershonites were, Laadan, and Shimei.
verses.fr: Des Guerschonites: Laedan et Schimeï. -
verses.am: ከጌድሶናውያን ለአዳንና ሰሜኢ ነበሩ።

verses.en: The sons of Laadan; the chief was Jehiel, and Zetham, and Joel, three.
verses.fr: Fils de Laedan: le chef Jehiel, Zétham et Joël, trois.
verses.am: የለአዳን ልጆች አለቃው ይሒኤል፥ ዜቶም፥ ኢዮኤል ሦስት ነበሩ።

verses.en: The sons of Shimei; Shelomith, and Haziel, and Haran, three. These were the chief of the fathers of Laadan.
verses.fr: Fils de Schimeï: Schelomith, Haziel et Haran, trois. Ce sont là les chefs des maisons paternelles de la famille de Laedan. -
verses.am: የሰሜኢ ልጆች ሰሎሚት፥ ሐዝኤል፥ ሐራን ሦስት ነበሩ። እነዚህ የለአዳን አባቶች ቤቶች አለቆች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And the sons of Shimei were, Jahath, Zina, and Jeush, and Beriah. These four were the sons of Shimei.
verses.fr: Fils de Schimeï: Jachath, Zina, Jeusch et Beria. Ce sont là les quatre fils de Schimeï.
verses.am: የሰሜኢ ልጆች ኢኢት፥ ዚዛ፥ የዑስ፥ በሪዓ ነበሩ። እነዚህ አራቱ የሰሜኢ ልጆች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And Jahath was the chief, and Zizah the second: but Jeush and Beriah had not many sons; therefore they were in one reckoning, according to their father's house.
verses.fr: Jachath était le chef, et Zina le second; Jeusch et Beria n''eurent pas beaucoup de fils, et ils formèrent une seule maison paternelle dans le dénombrement.
verses.am: አለቃው ኢኢት ነበረ፤ ሁለተኛው ዚዛ ነበረ፤ የዑስና በሪዓ ግን ብዙ ልጆች አልነበሩአቸውም፤ ስለዚህ እንደ አንድ አባት ቤት ሆነው ተቈጠሩ።

verses.en: The sons of Kohath; Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.
verses.fr: Fils de Kehath: Amram, Jitsehar, Hébron et Uziel, quatre. -
verses.am: የቀአት ልጆች እንበረም፥ ይስዓር፥ ኬብሮን፥ ዑዝኤል አራት ነበሩ።

verses.en: The sons of Amram; Aaron and Moses: and Aaron was separated, that he should sanctify the most holy things, he and his sons for ever, to burn incense before the Lord, to minister unto him, and to bless in his name for ever.
verses.fr: Fils d''Amram: Aaron et Moïse. Aaron fut mis à part pour être sanctifié comme très saint, lui et ses fils à perpétuité, pour offrir les parfums devant l''Eternel, pour faire son service, et pour bénir à toujours en son nom.
verses.am: የእንበረም ልጆች አሮንና ሙሴ ነበሩ፤ አሮንም ከሁሉ በላይ የተቀደሰ ይሆን ዘንድ ተለየ፥ እርሱና ልጆቹ፥ ለዘላለም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያጥንና ያገለግል ዘንድ፥ በስሙም ለዘላለም ይባርክ ዘንድ።

verses.en: Now concerning Moses the man of God, his sons were named of the tribe of Levi.
verses.fr: Mais les fils de Moïse, homme de Dieu, furent comptés dans la tribu de Lévi.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ሰው የሙሴ ልጆች በሌዊ ነገድ ተቈጠሩ።

verses.en: The sons of Moses were, Gershom, and Eliezer.
verses.fr: Fils de Moïse: Guerschom et Eliézer.
verses.am: የሙሴ ልጆች ጌርሳምና አልዓዛር ነበሩ።

verses.en: Of the sons of Gershom, Shebuel was the chief.
verses.fr: Fils de Guerschom: Schebuel, le chef.
verses.am: የጌርሳም ልጆች አለቃ ሱባኤል ነበረ።

verses.en: And the sons of Eliezer were, Rehabiah the chief. And Eliezer had none other sons; but the sons of Rehabiah were very many.
verses.fr: Et les fils d''Eliézer furent: Rechabia, le chef; Eliézer n''eut pas d''autre fils, mais les fils de Rechabia furent très nombreux. -
verses.am: የአልዓዛርም ልጆች አለቃ ረዓብያ ነበረ፤ አልዓዛርም ሌሎች ልጆች አልነበሩትም፤ የረዓብያ ልጆች እጅግ ብዙ ነበሩ።

verses.en: Of the sons of Izhar; Shelomith the chief.
verses.fr: Fils de Jitsehar: Schelomith, le chef. -
verses.am: የይስዓር ልጆች አለቃው ሰሎሚት ነበረ።

verses.en: Of the sons of Hebron; Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.
verses.fr: Fils d''Hébron: Jerija, le chef; Amaria, le second; Jachaziel, le troisième; et Jekameam, le quatrième. -
verses.am: የኬብሮን ልጆች አለቃው ይሪያ፥ ሁለተኛው አማርያ፥ ሦስተኛው የሕዚኤል፥ አራተኛው ይቅምዓም ነበሩ።

verses.en: Of the sons of Uzziel; Micah the first and Jesiah the second.
verses.fr: Fils d''Uziel: Michée, le chef; et Jischija, le second.
verses.am: የዑዝኤል ልጆች አለቃው ሚካ፥ ሁለተኛው ይሺያ ነበሩ።

verses.en: The sons of Merari; Mahli, and Mushi. The sons of Mahli; Eleazar, and Kish.
verses.fr: Fils de Merari: Machli et Muschi. -Fils de Machli: Eléazar et Kis.
verses.am: የሜራሪ ልጆች ሞሖሊና ሙሲ ነበሩ። የሞሖሊ ልጆች አልዓዛርና ቂስ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And Eleazar died, and had no sons, but daughters: and their brethren the sons of Kish took them.
verses.fr: Eléazar mourut sans avoir de fils; mais il eut des filles, que prirent pour femmes les fils de Kis, leurs frères. -
verses.am: አልዓዛርም ሴቶች ልጆች ብቻ እንጂ ወንዶች ልጆች ሳይወልድ ሞተ፤ ወንድሞቻቸውም የቂስ ልጆች አገቡአቸው።

verses.en: The sons of Mushi; Mahli, and Eder, and Jeremoth, three.
verses.fr: Fils de Muschi: Machli, Eder et Jerémoth, trois.
verses.am: የሙሲ ልጆች ሞሖሊ፥ ዔደር፥ ኢያሪሙት ሦስት ነበሩ።

verses.en: These were the sons of Levi after the house of their fathers; even the chief of the fathers, as they were counted by number of names by their polls, that did the work for the service of the house of the Lord, from the age of twenty years and upward.
verses.fr: Ce sont là les fils de Lévi, selon leurs maisons paternelles, les chefs des maisons paternelles, d''après le dénombrement qu''on en fit en comptant les noms par tête. Ils étaient employés au service de la maison de l''Eternel, depuis l''âge de vingt ans et au-dessus.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት አገልግሎት በሠሩ ከሀያ ዓመት ዕድሜ ጀምሮ ወደ ላይ በነበሩ በእያንዳንዳቸው በስማቸው በተቆጠሩት ላይ የአባቶች ቤት አለቆች የሆኑት በየአባቶቻቸው ቤት የሌዊ ልጆች እነዚህ ነበሩ።

verses.en: For David said, The Lord God of Israel hath given rest unto his people, that they may dwell in Jerusalem for ever:
verses.fr: Car David dit: L''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël, a donné du repos à son peuple, et il habitera pour toujours à Jérusalem;
verses.am: ዳዊትም። የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ለሕዝቡ ዕረፍት ሰጥቶአል፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም ለዘላለም የቀመጣል።

verses.en: And also unto the Levites; they shall no more carry the tabernacle, nor any vessels of it for the service thereof.
verses.fr: et les Lévites n''auront plus à porter le tabernacle et tous les ustensiles pour son service.
verses.am: ሌዋውያንም ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ ማደሪያውንና የማገልገያውን ዕቃ ሁሉ አይሸከሙም አለ።

verses.en: For by the last words of David the Levites were numbered from twenty years old and above:
verses.fr: Ce fut d''après les derniers ordres de David qu''eut lieu le dénombrement des fils de Lévi depuis l''âge de vingt ans et au-dessus.
verses.am: በመጨረሻውም በዳዊት ትእዛዝ ከሀያ ዓመት ዕድሜ ጀምሮ ከዚያም በላይ ያሉት የሌዊ ልጆች ተቈጠሩ።

verses.en: Because their office was to wait on the sons of Aaron for the service of the house of the Lord, in the courts, and in the chambers, and in the purifying of all holy things, and the work of the service of the house of God;
verses.fr: Placés auprès des fils d''Aaron pour le service de la maison de l''Eternel, ils avaient à prendre soin des parvis et des chambres, de la purification de toutes les choses saintes, des ouvrages concernant le service de la maison de Dieu,
