verses.am: ሥራቸውም የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት በየአደባባዩና በየጓዳው ውስጥ ለማገልገል፥ ቅዱሱንም ዕቃ ሁሉ ለማንጻት፥ የእግዚአብሔርንም ቤት አገልግሎት ለመሥራት ከአሮን ልጆች እጅ በታች ነበረ።

verses.en: Both for the shewbread, and for the fine flour for meat offering, and for the unleavened cakes, and for that which is baked in the pan, and for that which is fried, and for all manner of measure and size;
verses.fr: des pains de proposition, de la fleur de farine pour les offrandes, des galettes sans levain, des gâteaux cuits sur la plaque et des gâteaux frits, de toutes les mesures de capacité et de longueur:
verses.am: ደግሞም ገጸ ኅብስት፥ ስስ ቂጣም ቢሆን፥ በምጣድም ቢጋገር፥ ቢለወስም፥ ለእህል ቍርባን በሆነው በመልካሙ ዱቄት በመስፈሪያና በልክ ሁሉ ያገለግሉ ነበር።

verses.en: And to stand every morning to thank and praise the Lord, and likewise at even:
verses.fr: ils avaient à se présenter chaque matin et chaque soir, afin de louer et de célébrer l''Eternel,
verses.am: ሥራቸውም በየጥዋቱና በየማታው ቆመው እግዚአብሔርን ለማመስገንና ለማክበር፥

verses.en: And to offer all burnt sacrifices unto the Lord in the sabbaths, in the new moons, and on the set feasts, by number, according to the order commanded unto them, continually before the Lord:
verses.fr: et à offrir continuellement devant l''Eternel tous les holocaustes à l''Eternel, aux sabbats, aux nouvelles lunes et aux fêtes, selon le nombre et les usages prescrits.
verses.am: በየሰንበታቱም በየመባቻዎቹም በየበዓላቱም እንደ ሥርዓቱ ቍጥር በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ዘወትር ለእግዚአብሔር የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት ሁሉ ለማቅረብ፥

verses.en: And that they should keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the charge of the holy place, and the charge of the sons of Aaron their brethren, in the service of the house of the Lord.
verses.fr: Ils donnaient leurs soins à la tente d''assignation, au sanctuaire, et aux fils d''Aaron, leurs frères, pour le service de la maison de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ለእግዚአብሔርም ቤት አገልግሎት የመገናኛውን ድንኳን ሥርዓት የመቅደሱንም ሥርዓት የወንድሞቻቸውንም የአሮንን ልጆች ሥርዓት ለመጠበቅ ነበረ።

verses.en: Now these are the divisions of the sons of Aaron. The sons of Aaron; Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.fr: Voici les classes des fils d''Aaron. Fils d''Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eléazar et Ithamar.
verses.am: የአሮንም ልጆች ሰሞን ይህ ነው። የአሮን ልጆች ናዳብ፥ አብዩድ፥ አልዓዛር፥ ኢታምር ነበሩ።

verses.en: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and had no children: therefore Eleazar and Ithamar executed the priest's office.
verses.fr: Nadab et Abihu moururent avant leur père, sans avoir de fils; et Eléazar et Ithamar remplirent les fonctions du sacerdoce.
verses.am: ናዳብና አብዩድ ግን ልጆች ሳይወልዱ ከአባታቸው በፊት ሞቱ፤ አልዓዛርና ኢታምርም ካህናት ሆኑ።

verses.en: And David distributed them, both Zadok of the sons of Eleazar, and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, according to their offices in their service.
verses.fr: David divisa les fils d''Aaron en les classant pour le service qu''ils avaient à faire; Tsadok appartenait aux descendants d''Eléazar, et Achimélec aux descendants d''Ithamar.
verses.am: ዳዊትም ከአልዓዛር ልጆች ከሳዶቅ ጋር፥ ከኢታምርም ልጆች ከአቢሜሌክ ጋር ሆኖ እንደ አገልግሎታቸው ሥርዓት ከፍሎ መደባቸው።

verses.en: And there were more chief men found of the sons of Eleazar than of the sons of Ithamar, and thus were they divided. Among the sons of Eleazar there were sixteen chief men of the house of their fathers, and eight among the sons of Ithamar according to the house of their fathers.
verses.fr: Il se trouva parmi les fils d''Eléazar plus de chefs que parmi les fils d''Ithamar, et on en fit la division; les fils d''Eléazar avaient seize chefs de maisons paternelles, et les fils d''Ithamar huit chefs de maisons paternelles.
verses.am: የአልዓዛርም ልጆች አለቆች ከኢታምርም ልጆች አለቆች በልጠው ተገኙ፤ እንዲህም ተመደቡ፤ ከአልዓዛር ልጆች እንደ አባቶቻቸው ቤቶች አሥራ ስድስት፥ ከኢታምርም ልጆች እንደ አባቶቻቸው ቤቶች ስምንት አለቆች ነበሩ።

verses.en: Thus were they divided by lot, one sort with another; for the governors of the sanctuary, and governors of the house of God, were of the sons of Eleazar, and of the sons of Ithamar.
verses.fr: On les classa par le sort, les uns avec les autres, car les chefs du sanctuaire et les chefs de Dieu étaient des fils d''Eléazar et des fils d''Ithamar.
verses.am: ከአልዓዛርና ከኢታምርም ልጆች መካከል የመቅደሱና የእግዚአብሔር አለቆች ነበሩና እነዚህና እነዚያ እንዲህ በዕጣ ተመደቡ።

verses.en: And Shemaiah the son of Nethaneel the scribe, one of the Levites, wrote them before the king, and the princes, and Zadok the priest, and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and before the chief of the fathers of the priests and Levites: one principal household being taken for Eleazar, and one taken for Ithamar.
verses.fr: Schemaeja, fils de Nethaneel, le secrétaire, de la tribu de Lévi, les inscrivit devant le roi et les princes, devant Tsadok, le sacrificateur, et Achimélec, fils d''Abiathar, et devant les chefs des maisons paternelles des sacrificateurs et des Lévites. On tira au sort une maison paternelle pour Eléazar, et on en tira une autre pour Ithamar.
verses.am: ከሌዋውያንም ወገን የነበረው የናትናኤል ልጅ ጸሐፊው ሸማያ በንጉሡና በአለቆቹ ፊት፥ በካህኑ በሳዶቅና በአብያታርም ልጅ በአቢሜሌክ ፊት፥ በካህናቱና በሌዋውያኑ አባቶች ቤቶች አለቆች ፊት ጻፋቸው፤ አንዱንም የአባት ቤት ለአልዓዛር፥ አንዱንም ለኢታምር ጻፈ።

verses.en: Now the first lot came forth to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,
verses.fr: Le premier sort échut à Jehojarib; le second, à Jedaeja;
verses.am: መጀመሪያውም ዕጣ ለዮአሪብ ወጣ፥ ሁለተኛው ለዮዳኤ፥

verses.en: The third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,
verses.fr: le troisième, à Harim; le quatrième, à Seorim;
verses.am: ሦስተኛው ለካሪም፥

verses.en: The fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin,
verses.fr: le cinquième, à Malkija; le sixième, à Mijamin;
verses.am: አራተኛው ለሥዖሪም፥ አምስተኛው ለመልክያ፥

verses.en: The seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,
verses.fr: le septième, à Hakkots; le huitième, à Abija;
verses.am: ስድስተኛው ለሚያሚን፥ ሰባተኛው ለአቆስ፥

verses.en: The ninth to Jeshuah, the tenth to Shecaniah,
verses.fr: le neuvième, à Josué; le dixième, à Schecania;
verses.am: ስምንተኛው ለአብያ፥ ዘጠኝኛው ለኢያሱ፥

verses.en: The eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,
verses.fr: le onzième, à Eliaschib; le douzième, à Jakim;
verses.am: አሥረኛው ለሴኬንያ፥ አሥራ አንደኛው ለኤልያሴብ፥ አሥራ ሁለተኛው ለያቂም፥

verses.en: The thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,
verses.fr: le treizième, à Huppa; le quatorzième, à Jeschébeab;
verses.am: አሥራ ሦስተኛው ለኦፓ፥ አሥራ አራተኛው ለየሼብአብ፥

verses.en: The fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,
verses.fr: le quinzième, à Bilga; le seizième, à Immer;
verses.am: አሥራ አምስተኛው ለቢልጋ፥ አሥራ ስድስተኛው ለኢሜር፥

verses.en: The seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Aphses,
verses.fr: le dix-septième, à Hézir; le dix-huitième, à Happitsets;
verses.am: አሥራ ሰባተኛው ለኤዚር፥ አሥራ ስምንተኛው ለሃፊጼጽ፥

verses.en: The nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezekel,
verses.fr: le dix-neuvième, à Pethachja; le vingtième, à Ezéchiel;
verses.am: አሥራ ዘጠኝኛው ለፈታያ፥

verses.en: The one and twentieth to Jachin, the two and twentieth to Gamul,
verses.fr: le vingt et unième, à Jakin; le vingt-deuxième, à Gamul;
verses.am: ሀያኛው ለኤዜቄል፥ ሀያ አንደኛው ለያኪን፥ ሀያ ሁለተኛው ለጋሙል፥

verses.en: The three and twentieth to Delaiah, the four and twentieth to Maaziah.
verses.fr: le vingt-troisième, à Delaja; le vingt-quatrième, à Maazia.
verses.am: ሀያ ሦስተኛው ለድላያ፥ ሀያ አራተኛው ለመዓዝያ።

verses.en: These were the orderings of them in their service to come into the house of the Lord, according to their manner, under Aaron their father, as the Lord God of Israel had commanded him.
verses.fr: C''est ainsi qu''ils furent classés pour leur service, afin qu''ils entrassent dans la maison de l''Eternel en se conformant à la règle établie par Aaron, leur père, d''après les ordres que lui avait donnés l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël.
verses.am: የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዳዘዘ፥ አባታቸው አሮን እንደ ሰጣቸው ሥርዓት ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት የሚገቡበት የአገልግሎታቸው ሥርዓት ይህ ነበረ።

verses.en: And the rest of the sons of Levi were these: Of the sons of Amram; Shubael: of the sons of Shubael; Jehdeiah.
verses.fr: Voici les chefs du reste des Lévites. -Des fils d''Amram: Schubaël; des fils de Schubaël: Jechdia;
verses.am: ከቀሩትም የሌዊ ልጆች፤ ከእንበረም ልጆች ሱባኤል፤ ከሱባኤል ልጆች ዬሕድያ፤

verses.en: Concerning Rehabiah: of the sons of Rehabiah, the first was Isshiah.
verses.fr: de Rechabia, des fils de Rechabia: le chef Jischija.
verses.am: ከኬብሮንም ልጆች አለቃው ይሪያ፥ ሁለተኛው አማርያ፥ ሦስተኛው የሕዚኤል፥ አራተኛው ይቀምዓም፤

verses.en: Of the Izharites; Shelomoth: of the sons of Shelomoth; Jahath.
verses.fr: Des Jitseharites: Schelomoth; des fils de Schelomoth: Jachath.
verses.am: ከኬብሮንም ልጆች አለቃው ይሪያ፥ ሁለተኛው አማርያ፥ ሦስተኛው የሕዚኤል፥ አራተኛው ይቀምዓም፤

verses.en: And the sons of Hebron; Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, Jekameam the fourth.
verses.fr: Fils d''Hébron: Jerija, Amaria le second, Jachaziel le troisième, Jekameam le quatrième.
verses.am: የዑዝኤል ልጅ ሚካ፤

verses.en: Of the sons of Uzziel; Michah: of the sons of Michah; Shamir.
verses.fr: Fils d''Uziel: Michée; des fils de Michée: Schamir;
verses.am: የሚካ ልጅ ሻሚር፤ የሚካ ወንድም ይሺያ፤

verses.en: The brother of Michah was Isshiah: of the sons of Isshiah; Zechariah.
verses.fr: frère de Michée: Jischija; des fils de Jischija: Zacharie. -
verses.am: ከይሺያ ልጆች ዘካርያስ፤ የሜራሪ ልጆች ሞሖሊ፥ ሙሲ፤ ከያዝያ ልጅ በኖ፤

verses.en: The sons of Merari were Mahli and Mushi: the sons of Jaaziah; Beno.
verses.fr: Fils de Merari: Machli et Muschi, et les fils de Jaazija, son fils.
verses.am: የሜራሪ ልጆች፤ ከያዝያ በኖ፥ ሾሃም፥ ዘኩር፥ ዔብሪ፤

verses.en: The sons of Merari by Jaaziah; Beno, and Shoham, and Zaccur, and Ibri.
verses.fr: Fils de Merari, de Jaazija, son fils: Schoham, Zaccur et Ibri.
verses.am: ከሞሖሊ አልዓዛር፥ እርሱም ልጆች አልነበሩት፤

verses.en: Of Mahli came Eleazar, who had no sons.
verses.fr: De Machli: Eléazar, qui n''eut point de fils;
verses.am: ከቂስ፤ የቂስ ልጅ ይረሕምኤል፤ የሙሲም ልጆች፤ ሞሖሊ፥ ዔዳር፥ ኢያሪሙት።

verses.en: Concerning Kish: the son of Kish was Jerahmeel.
verses.fr: de Kis, les fils de Kis: Jerachmeel.
verses.am: እነዚህ እንደ አባቶቻቸው ቤቶች የሌዋውያን ልጆች ነበሩ።

verses.en: The sons also of Mushi; Mahli, and Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the sons of the Levites after the house of their fathers.
verses.fr: Fils de Muschi: Machli, Eder et Jerimoth. Ce sont là les fils de Lévi, selon leurs maisons paternelles.
verses.am: እነዚህም ደግሞ በንጉሡ በዳዊትና በሳዶቅ በአቢሜሌክም በሌዋውያንና በካህናት አባቶች ቤቶች አለቆች ፊት፥ ታላቁም እንደ ታናሹ፥ እንደ ወንድሞቻቸው እንደ አሮን ልጆች ዕጣ ተጣጣሉ።

verses.en: These likewise cast lots over against their brethren the sons of Aaron in the presence of David the king, and Zadok, and Ahimelech, and the chief of the fathers of the priests and Levites, even the principal fathers over against their younger brethren.
verses.fr: Eux aussi, comme leurs frères, les fils d''Aaron, ils tirèrent au sort devant le roi David, Tsadok et Achimélec, et les chefs des maisons paternelles des sacrificateurs et des Lévites. Il en fut ainsi pour chaque chef de maison comme pour le moindre de ses frères.
verses.am: ፤ እነዚህም ደግሞ በንጉሡ በዳዊትና በሳዶቅ በአቢሜሌክም በሌዋውያንና በካህናት አባቶች ቤቶች አለቆች ፊት፥ ታላቁም እንደ ታናሹ፥ እንደ ወንድሞቻቸው እንደ አሮን ልጆች ዕጣ ተጣጣሉ።

verses.en: Moreover David and the captains of the host separated to the service of the sons of Asaph, and of Heman, and of Jeduthun, who should prophesy with harps, with psalteries, and with cymbals: and the number of the workmen according to their service was:
verses.fr: David et les chefs de l''armée mirent à part pour le service ceux des fils d''Asaph, d''Héman et de Jeduthun qui prophétisaient en s''accompagnant de la harpe, du luth et des cymbales. Et voici le nombre de ceux qui avaient des fonctions à remplir.
verses.am: ዳዊትና የሠራዊቱ አለቆችም ከአሳፍና ከኤማን ከኤዶታም ልጆች በመሰንቆና በበገና በጸናጽልም ትንቢት የሚናገሩትን ሰዎች ለማገልገል ለዩ፤ በአገልግሎታቸውም ሥራ የሠሩ ሰዎች ቍጥር ይህ ነበረ።

verses.en: Of the sons of Asaph; Zaccur, and Joseph, and Nethaniah, and Asarelah, the sons of Asaph under the hands of Asaph, which prophesied according to the order of the king.
verses.fr: Des fils d''Asaph: Zaccur, Joseph, Nethania et Aschareéla, fils d''Asaph, sous la direction d''Asaph qui prophétisait suivant les ordres du roi.
verses.am: ከአሳፍ ልጆች፤ ዘኩር፥ ዮሴፍ፥ ነታንያ፥ አሸርኤላ፤ እነዚህ የአሳፍ ልጆች በንጉሡ ትእዛዝ ትንቢት ከተናገረው ከአሳፍ እጅ በታች ነበሩ።

verses.en: Of Jeduthun: the sons of Jeduthun; Gedaliah, and Zeri, and Jeshaiah, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six, under the hands of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied with a harp, to give thanks and to praise the Lord.
verses.fr: De Jeduthun, les fils de Jeduthun: Guedalia, Tseri, Esaïe, Haschabia, Matthithia et Schimeï, six, sous la direction de leur père Jeduthun qui prophétisait avec la harpe pour louer et célébrer l''Eternel.
verses.am: ከኤዶታም የኤዶታም ልጆች፤ ጎዶልያስ፥ ጽሪ፥ የሻያ፥ ሰሜኢ፥ ሐሸብያ፥ መቲትያ፥ እነዚህ ስድስቱ ለእግዚአብሔር ምስጋናና ክብር በመሰንቆ ትንቢት ከተናገረው ከአባታቸው ከኤዶታም እጅ በታች ነበሩ።

verses.en: Of Heman: the sons of Heman: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, and Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, and Romamtiezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, and Mahazioth:
verses.fr: D''Héman, les fils d''Héman: Bukkija, Matthania, Uziel, Schebuel, Jerimoth, Hanania, Hanani, Eliatha, Guiddalthi, Romamthi-Ezer, Joschbekascha, Mallothi, Hothir, Machazioth,
verses.am: ከኤማን የኤማን ልጆች፤ ቡቅያ፥ መታንያ፥ ዓዛርዔል፥ ሱባኤ፥ ኢያሪሙት፥ ሐናንያ፥ ሐናኒ፥ ኤልያታ፥ ጊዶልቲ፥ ሮማንቲዔዘር፥ ዮሽብቃሻ፥ መሎቲ፥ ሆቲር፥ መሐዝዮት፤

verses.en: All these were the sons of Heman the king's seer in the words of God, to lift up the horn. And God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.
verses.fr: tous fils d''Héman, qui était voyant du roi pour révéler les paroles de Dieu et pour exalter sa puissance; Dieu avait donné à Héman quatorze fils et trois filles.
verses.am: እነዚህ ሁሉ ቀንደ መለከቱን ከፍ ያደርጉ ዘንድ በእግዚአብሔር ቃል የንጉሡ ባለ ራእይ የሆነው የኤማን ልጆች ነበሩ። እግዚአብሔርም ለኤማን አሥራ አራት ወንዶች ልጆችንና ሦስት ሴቶች ልጆችን ሰጠው።

verses.en: All these were under the hands of their father for song in the house of the Lord, with cymbals, psalteries, and harps, for the service of the house of God, according to the king's order to Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman.
verses.fr: Tous ceux-là étaient sous la direction de leurs pères, pour le chant de la maison de l''Eternel, et avaient des cymbales, des luths et des harpes pour le service de la maison de Dieu. Asaph, Jeduthun et Héman recevaient les ordres du roi.
verses.am: እነዚህ ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት በጸናጽልና በበገና በመሰንቆም ይዘምሩ ዘንድ፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት ያገለግሉ ዘንድ ከአባታቸው እጅ በታች ነበሩ፤ አሳፍም ኤዶታምም ኤማንም ከንጉሡ ትእዛዝ በታች ነበሩ።

verses.en: So the number of them, with their brethren that were instructed in the songs of the Lord, even all that were cunning, was two hundred fourscore and eight.
verses.fr: Ils étaient au nombre de deux cent quatre-vingt-huit, y compris leurs frères exercés au chant de l''Eternel, tous ceux qui étaient habiles.
verses.am: የብልሃተኞቹም ቍጥር እግዚአብሔርን ለማመስገን ከሚያውቁ ከወንድሞቻቸው ጋር ሁለት መቶ ሰማንያ ስምንት ነበረ።

verses.en: And they cast lots, ward against ward, as well the small as the great, the teacher as the scholar.
verses.fr: Ils tirèrent au sort pour leurs fonctions, petits et grands, maîtres et disciples.
verses.am: ሁሉም ተካክለው፥ ታናሹ እንደ ታላቁ፥ አስተማሪውም እንደ ተማሪው፥ ለሰሞናቸው ዕጣ ተጣጣሉ።

verses.en: Now the first lot came forth for Asaph to Joseph: the second to Gedaliah, who with his brethren and sons were twelve:
verses.fr: Le premier sort échut, pour Asaph, à Joseph; le second, à Guedalia, lui, ses frères et ses fils, douze;
verses.am: የፊተኛው ዕጣ ከአሳፍ ወገን ለነበረው ለዮሴፍ ወጣ፤ ሁለተኛው ለጎዶልያስ ወጣ፤ እርሱ ወንድሞቹም ልጆቹም አሥራ ሁለት ነበሩ፤

verses.en: The third to Zaccur, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.fr: le troisième, à Zaccur, ses fils et ses frères, douze;
verses.am: ሦስተኛው ለዘኩር ለልጆቹም ለወንድሞቹም ለአሥራ ሁለቱ፤

verses.en: The fourth to Izri, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.fr: le quatrième, à Jitseri, ses fils et ses frères, douze;
verses.am: አራተኛው ለይጽሪ ለልጆቹም ለወንድሞቹም ለአሥራ ሁለቱ፤

verses.en: The fifth to Nethaniah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.fr: le cinquième, à Nethania, ses fils et ses frères, douze;
verses.am: አምስተኛው ለነታንያ ለልጆቹም ለወንድሞቹም ለአሥራ ሁለቱ፤

verses.en: The sixth to Bukkiah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.fr: le sixième, à Bukkija, ses fils et ses frères, douze;
verses.am: ስድስተኛው ለቡቅያ ለልጆቹም ለወንድሞቹም ለአሥራ ሁለቱ፤

verses.en: The seventh to Jesharelah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.fr: le septième, à Jesareéla, ses fils et ses frères, douze;
verses.am: ሰባተኛው ለይሽርኤል ለልጆቹም ለወንድሞቹም ለአሥራ ሁለቱ፤

verses.en: The eighth to Jeshaiah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.fr: le huitième, à Esaïe, ses fils et ses frères, douze;
verses.am: ስምንተኛው ለየሻያ ለልጆቹም ለወንድሞቹም ለአሥራ ሁለቱ፤

verses.en: The ninth to Mattaniah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.fr: le neuvième, à Matthania, ses fils et ses frères, douze;
verses.am: ዘጠኝኛው ለመታንያ ለልጆቹም ለወንድሞቹም ለአሥራ ሁለቱ፤

verses.en: The tenth to Shimei, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.fr: le dixième, à Schimeï, ses fils et ses frères, douze;
verses.am: አሥረኛው ለሰሜኢ ለልጆቹም ለወንድሞቹም ለአሥራ ሁለቱ፤

verses.en: The eleventh to Azareel, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.fr: le onzième, à Azareel, ses fils et ses frères, douze;
verses.am: አሥራ አንደኛው ለዓዛርኤል ለልጆቹም ለወንድሞቹም ለአሥራ ሁለቱ፤

verses.en: The twelfth to Hashabiah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.fr: le douzième, à Haschabia, ses fils et ses frères, douze;
verses.am: አሥራ ሁለተኛው ለሐሸብያ ለልጆቹም ለወንድሞቹም ለአሥራ ሁለቱ፤

verses.en: The thirteenth to Shubael, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.fr: le treizième, à Schubaël, ses fils et ses frères, douze;
verses.am: አሥራ ሦስተኛው ለሱባኤል ለልጆቹም ለወንድሞቹም ለአሥራ ሁለቱ፤

verses.en: The fourteenth to Mattithiah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.fr: le quatorzième, à Matthithia, ses fils et ses frères, douze;
verses.am: አሥራ አራተኛው ለመቲትያ ለልጆቹም ለወንድሞቹም ለአሥራ ሁለቱ፤

verses.en: The fifteenth to Jeremoth, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.fr: le quinzième, à Jerémoth, ses fils et ses frères, douze;
verses.am: አሥራ አምስተኛው ለኢያሪሙት ለልጆቹም ለወንድሞቹም ለአሥራ ሁለቱ፤

verses.en: The sixteenth to Hananiah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.fr: le seizième, à Hanania, ses fils et ses frères, douze;
verses.am: አሥራ ስድስተኛው ለሐናንያ ለልጆቹም ለወንድሞቹም ለአሥራ ሁለቱ፤

verses.en: The seventeenth to Joshbekashah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.fr: le dix-septième, à Joschbekascha, ses fils et ses frères, douze;
verses.am: አሥራ ሰባተኛው ለዮሽብቃሻ ለልጆቹም ለወንድሞቹም ለአሥራ ሁለቱ፤

verses.en: The eighteenth to Hanani, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.fr: le dix-huitième, à Hanani, ses fils et ses frères, douze;
verses.am: አሥራ ስምንተኛው ለሐናኒ ለልጆቹም ለወንድሞቹም ለአሥራ ሁለቱ፤

verses.en: The nineteenth to Mallothi, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.fr: le dix-neuvième, à Mallothi, ses fils et ses frères, douze;
verses.am: አሥራ ዘጠኝኛው ለመሎቲ ለልጆቹም ለወንድሞቹም ለአሥራ ሁለቱ፤

verses.en: The twentieth to Eliathah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.fr: le vingtième, à Elijatha, ses fils et ses frères, douze;
verses.am: ሀያኛው ለኤልያታ ለልጆቹም ለወንድሞቹም ለአሥራ ሁለቱ፤

verses.en: The one and twentieth to Hothir, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.fr: le vingt et unième, à Hothir, ses fils et ses frères, douze;
verses.am: ሀያ አንደኛው ለሆቲር ለልጆቹም ለወንድሞቹም ለአሥራ ሁለቱ፤

verses.en: The two and twentieth to Giddalti, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.fr: le vingt-deuxième, à Guiddalthi, ses fils et ses frères, douze;
verses.am: ሀያ ሁለተኛው ለጊዶልቲ ለልጆቹም ለወንድሞቹም ለአሥራ ሁለቱ፤

verses.en: The three and twentieth to Mahazioth, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.fr: le vingt-troisième, à Machazioth, ses fils et ses frères, douze;
verses.am: ሀያ ሦስተኛው ለመሐዚዮት ለልጆቹም ለወንድሞቹም ለአሥራ ሁለቱ፤

verses.en: The four and twentieth to Romamtiezer, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve.
verses.fr: le vingt-quatrième, à Romamthi-Ezer, ses fils et ses frères, douze.
verses.am: ሀያ አራተኛው ለሮማንቲዔዘር ለልጆቹም ለወንድሞቹም ለአሥራ ሁለቱ ወጣ።

verses.en: Concerning the divisions of the porters: Of the Korhites was Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.
verses.fr: Voici les classes des portiers. Des Koréites: Meschélémia, fils de Koré, d''entre les fils d''Asaph.
verses.am: በረኞችም እንደዚህ ተመደቡ፤ ከቆሬያውያን ከአሳፍ ልጆች የቆሬ ልጅ ሜሱላም።

verses.en: And the sons of Meshelemiah were, Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,
verses.fr: Fils de Meschélémia: Zacharie, le premier-né, Jediaël le second, Zebadia le troisième, Jathniel le quatrième,
verses.am: ሜሱላም ልጆች ነበሩት፤ በኵሩ ዘካርያስ፥ ሁለተኛው ይዲኤል፥ ሦስተኛው ዮዛባት፥

verses.en: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, Elioenai the seventh.
verses.fr: Elam le cinquième, Jochanan le sixième, Eljoénaï le septième.
verses.am: አራተኛው የትኒኤል፥ አምስተኛው ኤላም፥ ስድስተኛው ይሆሐናን፥ ሰባተኛው ኤሊሆዔናይ።

verses.en: Moreover the sons of Obededom were, Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, and Sacar the fourth, and Nethaneel the fifth.
verses.fr: Fils d''Obed-Edom: Schemaeja, le premier-né, Jozabad le second, Joach le troisième, Sacar le quatrième, Nethaneel le cinquième,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ባርኮታልና ዖቤድኤዶም ልጆች ነበሩት፤ በኵሩ ሸማያ፥ ሁለተኛው ዮዛባት፥ ሦስተኛው ኢዮአስ፥ አራተኛው ሣካር፥ አምስተኛው ናትናኤል፥

verses.en: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, Peulthai the eighth: for God blessed him.
verses.fr: Ammiel le sixième, Issacar le septième, Peulthaï le huitième; car Dieu l''avait béni.
verses.am: ስድስተኛው ዓሚኤል፥ ሰባተኛው ይሳኮር፥ ስምንተኛው ፒላቲ።

verses.en: Also unto Shemaiah his son were sons born, that ruled throughout the house of their father: for they were mighty men of valour.
verses.fr: A Schemaeja, son fils, naquirent des fils qui dominèrent dans la maison de leur père, car ils étaient de vaillants hommes;
verses.am: ለልጁም ለሸማያ ደግሞ ልጆች ተወለዱለት፤ ጽኑዓንም ኃያላን ነበሩና በአባታቸው ቤት ሠለጠኑ።

verses.en: The sons of Shemaiah; Othni, and Rephael, and Obed, Elzabad, whose brethren were strong men, Elihu, and Semachiah.
verses.fr: fils de Schemaeja: Othni, Rephaël, Obed, Elzabad et ses frères, hommes vaillants, Elihu et Semaeja.
verses.am: ለሸማያ ልጆች ዖትኒ፥ ራፋኤል፥ ዖቤድ፥ ወንድሞቹም ኃያላን የነበሩ ኤልዛባድ፥ ኤልሁ፥ ሰማክያ።

verses.en: All these of the sons of Obededom: they and their sons and their brethren, able men for strength for the service, were threescore and two of Obededom.
verses.fr: Tous ceux-là étaient des fils d''Obed-Edom; eux, leurs fils et leurs frères, étaient des hommes pleins de vigueur et de force pour le service, soixante deux d''Obed-Edom.
verses.am: እነዚህ ሁሉ የዖቤድኤዶም ልጆች ነበሩ፤ እነርሱም ልጆቻቸውም ወንድሞቻቸውም ለማገልገል ኃያላን የነበሩ የዖቤድኤዶም ልጆች ስድሳ ሁለት ነበሩ።

verses.en: And Meshelemiah had sons and brethren, strong men, eighteen.
verses.fr: Les fils et les frères de Meschélémia, hommes vaillants, étaient au nombre de dix-huit. -
verses.am: ለሜሱላም ኃያላን የነበሩ አሥራ ስምንት ልጆችና ወንድሞች ነበሩት።

verses.en: Also Hosah, of the children of Merari, had sons; Simri the chief, (for though he was not the firstborn, yet his father made him the chief;)
verses.fr: Des fils de Merari: Hosa, qui avait pour fils: Schimri, le chef, établi chef par son père, quoiqu''il ne fût pas le premier-né,
verses.am: ከሜራሪም ልጆች ለነበረው ለሖሳ ልጆች ነበሩት፤ አለቃውም ሽምሪ ነበረ፤ በኵር አልነበረም፥ አባቱ ግን አለቃ አደረገው፤

verses.en: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, Zechariah the fourth: all the sons and brethren of Hosah were thirteen.
verses.fr: Hilkija le second, Thebalia le troisième, Zacharie le quatrième. Tous les fils et les frères de Hosa étaient au nombre de treize.
verses.am: ሁለተኛውም ኬልቅያስ፥ ሦስተኛው ጥበልያ፥ አራተኛው ዘካርያስ ነበረ፤ የሖሳ ልጆችና ወንድሞች ሁሉ አሥራ ሦስት ነበሩ።

verses.en: Among these were the divisions of the porters, even among the chief men, having wards one against another, to minister in the house of the Lord.
verses.fr: A ces classes de portiers, aux chefs de ces hommes et à leurs frères, fut remise la garde pour le service de la maison de l''Eternel.
verses.am: እንደ ወንድሞቻቸው ሆነው በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ያገለግሉ ዘንድ የበረኞች የአለቆች ሰሞነኞች እነዚህ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And they cast lots, as well the small as the great, according to the house of their fathers, for every gate.
verses.fr: Ils tirèrent au sort pour chaque porte, petits et grands, selon leurs maisons paternelles.
verses.am: በበሩም ሁሉ ያገለግሉ ዘንድ በየአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች ታናሹና ታላቁ ተካክለው ዕጣ ተጣጣሉ።

verses.en: And the lot eastward fell to Shelemiah. Then for Zechariah his son, a wise counsellor, they cast lots; and his lot came out northward.
verses.fr: Le sort échut à Schélémia pour le côté de l''orient. On tira au sort pour Zacharie, son fils, qui était un sage conseiller, et le côté du septentrion lui échut par le sort.
verses.am: በምሥራቅም በኩል ዕጣ ለሰሌምያ ወደቀ። ለልጁም ብልህ መካር ለሆነው ለዘካርያስ ዕጣ ጣሉ፤ ዕጣውም በሰሜን በኩል ወጣ።

verses.en: To Obededom southward; and to his sons the house of Asuppim.
verses.fr: Le côté du midi échut à Obed-Edom, et la maison des magasins à ses fils.
verses.am: ለዖቤድኤዶም በደቡብ በኩል፥ ለልጆቹም ለዕቃ ቤቱ ዕጣ ወጣ።

verses.en: To Shuppim and Hosah the lot came forth westward, with the gate Shallecheth, by the causeway of the going up, ward against ward.
verses.fr: Le côté de l''occident échut à Schuppim et à Hosa, avec la porte Schalléketh, sur le chemin montant: une garde était vis-à-vis de l''autre.
verses.am: ለሰፊንና ለሖሳ በምዕራብ በኩል፥ በዐቀበቱም መንገድ ባለው በሸሌኬት በር በኩል ጥበቃ ከጥበቃ ላይ ዕጣ ወጣ።

verses.en: Eastward were six Levites, northward four a day, southward four a day, and toward Asuppim two and two.
verses.fr: Il y avait à l''orient six Lévites, au nord quatre par jour, au midi quatre par jour, et quatre aux magasins en deux places différentes;
verses.am: በምሥራቅ በኩል ስድስት ሌዋውያን ነበሩ፤ በሰሜን በኩል ለየዕለቱ አራት፥ በደቡብ በኩል ለየዕለቱ አራት፥ ለዕቃ ቤቱም ሁለት ሁለት ነበሩ።

verses.en: At Parbar westward, four at the causeway, and two at Parbar.
verses.fr: du côté du faubourg, à l''occident, quatre vers le chemin, deux vers le faubourg.
verses.am: በምዕራብ በኩል በፈርባር መንገድ ላይ አራት፥ በፈርባርም አጠገብ ሁለት ነበሩ።

verses.en: These are the divisions of the porters among the sons of Kore, and among the sons of Merari.
verses.fr: Ce sont là les classes des portiers, d''entre les fils des Koréites et d''entre les fils de Merari.
verses.am: ከቆሬና ከሜራሪ ልጆች የነበሩ የበረኞች ሰሞን ይህ ነበረ።

verses.en: And of the Levites, Ahijah was over the treasures of the house of God, and over the treasures of the dedicated things.
verses.fr: L''un des Lévites, Achija, avait l''intendance des trésors de la maison de Dieu et des trésors des choses saintes.
verses.am: ከሌዋውያን አኪያ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት በሚሆኑ ቤተ መዛግብትና በንዋየ ቅድሳቱ ቤተ መዛግብት ላይ ተሾሞ ነበር።

verses.en: As concerning the sons of Laadan; the sons of the Gershonite Laadan, chief fathers, even of Laadan the Gershonite, were Jehieli.
verses.fr: Parmi les fils de Laedan, les fils des Guerschonites issus de Laedan, chefs des maisons paternelles de Laedan le Guerschonite, c''étaient Jehiéli,
verses.am: የለአዳን ልጆች፤ ለለአዳን የሆኑ የጌድሶናውያን ልጆች፥ ለጌድሶናዊ ለለአዳን የሆኑ የአባቶች ቤቶች አለቆች ይሒኤሊ፤

verses.en: The sons of Jehieli; Zetham, and Joel his brother, which were over the treasures of the house of the Lord.
verses.fr: et les fils de Jehiéli, Zétham et Joël, son frère, qui gardaient les trésors de la maison de l''Eternel.
verses.am: የይሒኤሊ ልጆች፤ በእግዚአሔር ቤት በሚሆኑ ቤተ መዛግብት ላይ የነበሩ ዜቶም፥ ወንድሙም ኢዩኤል።

verses.en: Of the Amramites, and the Izharites, the Hebronites, and the Uzzielites:
verses.fr: Parmi les Amramites, les Jitseharites, les Hébronites et les Uziélites,
verses.am: ከእንበረማውያን፥ ከይስዓራውያን፥ ከኬብሮናውያን፥ ከዑዝኤላውያን፤

verses.en: And Shebuel the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, was ruler of the treasures.
verses.fr: c''était Schebuel, fils de Guerschom, fils de Moïse, qui était intendant des trésors.
verses.am: የሙሴ ልጅ የጌርሳም ልጅ ሱባኤል በቤተ መዛግብት ላይ ተሾሞ ነበር።

verses.en: And his brethren by Eliezer; Rehabiah his son, and Jeshaiah his son, and Joram his son, and Zichri his son, and Shelomith his son.
verses.fr: Parmi ses frères issus d''Eliézer, dont le fils fut Rechabia, dont le fils fut Esaïe, dont le fils fut Joram, dont le fils fut Zicri, dont le fils fut Schelomith,
verses.am: ወንድሞቹም፤ ከአልዓዛር ልጁ ረዓብያ፥ ልጁም የሻያ፥ ልጁም ኢዮራም፥ ልጁም ዝክሪ፥ ልጁም ሰሎሚት መጡ።

verses.en: Which Shelomith and his brethren were over all the treasures of the dedicated things, which David the king, and the chief fathers, the captains over thousands and hundreds, and the captains of the host, had dedicated.
verses.fr: c''étaient Schelomith et ses frères qui gardaient tous les trésors des choses saintes qu''avaient consacrées le roi David, les chefs des maisons paternelles, les chefs de milliers et de centaines, et les chefs de l''armée:
verses.am: ይህ ሰሎሚትና ወንድሞቹ ንጉሡ ዳዊትና የአባቶች ቤቶች አለቆች፥ ሻለቆችና የመቶ አለቆች የሠራዊቱም አለቆች፥ በቀደሱት በንዋየ ቅድሳቱ ቤተ መዛግብት ሁሉ ላይ ተሾመው ነበር።

verses.en: Out of the spoils won in battles did they dedicate to maintain the house of the Lord.
verses.fr: c''était sur le butin pris à la guerre qu''ils les avaient consacrées pour l''entretien de la maison de l''Eternel.
verses.am: በሰልፍም ከተገኘው ምርኮ የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ለማበጀት ቀደሱ።

verses.en: And all that Samuel the seer, and Saul the son of Kish, and Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah, had dedicated; and whosoever had dedicated any thing, it was under the hand of Shelomith, and of his brethren.
verses.fr: Tout ce qui avait été consacré par Samuel, le voyant, par Saül, fils de Kis, par Abner, fils de Ner, par Joab, fils de Tseruja, toutes les choses consacrées étaient sous la garde de Schelomith et de ses frères.
verses.am: ባለ ራእዩም ሳሙኤል፥ የቂስም ልጅ ሳኦል፥ የኔርም ልጅ አበኔር፥ የጽሩያም ልጅ ኢዮአብ የቀደሱት ንዋየ ቅድሳት ሁሉ ከሰሎሚትና ከወንድሞቹ እጅ በታች ነበረ።

verses.en: Of the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons were for the outward business over Israel, for officers and judges.
verses.fr: Parmi les Jitseharites, Kenania et ses frères étaient employés pour les affaires extérieures, comme magistrats et juges en Israël.
verses.am: ከይስዓራውያን ከናንያና ልጆቹ ሹማምትና ፈራጆች ይሆኑ ዘንድ በውጭው ሥራ በእስራኤል ላይ ተሾመው ነበር።

verses.en: And of the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his brethren, men of valour, a thousand and seven hundred, were officers among them of Israel on this side Jordan westward in all the business of the Lord, and in the service of the king.
verses.fr: Parmi les Hébronites, Haschabia et ses frères, hommes vaillants, au nombre de mille sept cents, avaient la surveillance d''Israël, de l''autre côté du Jourdain, à l''occident, pour toutes les affaires de l''Eternel et pour le service du roi.
verses.am: ከኬብሮናውያን ሐሸብያና ወንድሞቹ፥ ጽኑዓን የነበሩት ሺህ ሰባት መቶ ሰዎች፥ ለእግዚአብሔር ሥራ ሁሉ ለንጉሡም አገልግሎት በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ በምዕራብ በኩል ባለው በእስራኤል ላይ ተሾመው ነበር።

verses.en: Among the Hebronites was Jerijah the chief, even among the Hebronites, according to the generations of his fathers. In the fortieth year of the reign of David they were sought for, and there were found among them mighty men of valour at Jazer of Gilead.
verses.fr: En ce qui concerne les Hébronites, dont Jerija était le chef, on fit, la quarantième année du règne de David, des recherches à leur égard d''après leurs généalogies et leurs maisons paternelles, et l''on trouva parmi eux de vaillants hommes à Jaezer en Galaad.
verses.am: ከኬብሮናውያንም እንደ አባቶች ቤቶች ትውልዶች የኬብሮናውያን አለቃ ይርያ ነበረ። ዳዊት በነገሠ በአርባኛው ዓመት ይፈልጉአቸው ነበር፤ በእነርሱም መካከል በገለዓድ ኢያዜር ጽኑዓን ኃያላን ሰዎች ተገኙ፤

verses.en: And his brethren, men of valour, were two thousand and seven hundred chief fathers, whom king David made rulers over the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh, for every matter pertaining to God, and affairs of the king.
verses.fr: Les frères de Jerija, hommes vaillants, étaient au nombre de deux mille sept cents chefs de maisons paternelles. Le roi David les établit sur les Rubénites, sur les Gadites et sur la demi-tribu de Manassé pour toutes les affaires de Dieu et pour les affaires du roi.
verses.am: ወንድሞቹም ጽኑዓን የነበሩት የአባቶች ቤቶች አለቆች ሁለት ሺህ ሰባት መቶ ነበሩ። ንጉሡም ዳዊት ለእግዚአብሔር ጉዳይ ሁሉና ለንጉሡ ጉዳይ በሮቤላውያንና በጋዳውያን በምናሴም ነገድ እኵሌታ ላይ ሹሞች አደረጋቸው።

verses.en: Now the children of Israel after their number, to wit, the chief fathers and captains of thousands and hundreds, and their officers that served the king in any matter of the courses, which came in and went out month by month throughout all the months of the year, of every course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.fr: Enfants d''Israël selon leur nombre, chefs de maisons paternelles, chefs de milliers et de centaines, et officiers au service du roi pour tout ce qui concernait les divisions, leur arrivée et leur départ, mois par mois, pendant tous les mois de l''année, chaque division étant de vingt-quatre mille hommes.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች የአባቶች ቤቶች አለቆችና የሺህ አለቆች የመቶ አለቆችም በክፍሎች ነገር ሁሉ ንጉሡን ያገለገሉትም ሹማምት እንደ ቍጥራቸው እነዚህ ነበሩ። እነዚህም ክፍሎች እያንዳንዳቸው ሀያ አራት ሺህ ሆነው በዓመት ወራት ሁሉ በየወሩ ይገቡና ይወጡ ነበር።

verses.en: Over the first course for the first month was Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.fr: A la tête de la première division, pour le premier mois, était Jaschobeam, fils de Zabdiel; et il avait une division de vingt-quatre mille hommes.
verses.am: ለመጀመሪያው ወር በአንደኛው ክፍል ላይ የዘብድኤል ልጅ ያሾብዓም ነበረ፤ በእርሱም ክፍል ሀያ አራት ሺህ ጭፍራ ነበረ።

verses.en: Of the children of Perez was the chief of all the captains of the host for the first month.
verses.fr: Il était des fils de Pérets, et il commandait tous les chefs des troupes du premier mois.
verses.am: እርሱ ከፋሬስ ልጆች ነበረ፤ ለመጀመሪያው ወር በጭፍራ አለቆች ሁሉ ላይ ተሾሞ ነበር።

verses.en: And over the course of the second month was Dodai an Ahohite, and of his course was Mikloth also the ruler: in his course likewise were twenty and four thousand.
verses.fr: A la tête de la division du second mois était Dodaï, l''Achochite; Mikloth était l''un des chefs de sa division; et il avait une division de vingt-quatre mille hommes.
verses.am: በሁለተኛውም ወር ክፍል ላይ አሆሃዊው ዱዲ ነበረ፤ በእርሱም ክፍል ሀያ አራት ሺህ ጭፍራ ነበረ።

verses.en: The third captain of the host for the third month was Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, a chief priest: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.fr: Le chef de la troisième division, pour le troisième mois, était Benaja, fils du sacrificateur Jehojada, chef; et il avait une division de vingt-quatre mille hommes.
verses.am: ለሦስተኛው ወር ሦስተኛው የጭፍራ አለቃ የካህኑ የዮዳሄ ልጅ በናያስ ነበረ፤ በእርሱም ክፍል ሀያ አራት ሺህ ጭፍራ ነበረ።

verses.en: This is that Benaiah, who was mighty among the thirty, and above the thirty: and in his course was Ammizabad his son.
verses.fr: Ce Benaja était un héros parmi les trente et à la tête des trente; et Ammizadab, son fils, était l''un des chefs de sa division.
verses.am: ይህ በናያስ በሠላሳው መካከል ኃያል ሆኖ በሠላሳው ላይ ነበረ፤ በእርሱም ክፍል ልጁ ዓሚዛባድ ነበረ።

verses.en: The fourth captain for the fourth month was Asahel the brother of Joab, and Zebadiah his son after him: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.fr: Le quatrième, pour le quatrième mois, était Asaël, frère de Joab, et, après lui, Zebadia, son fils; et il avait une division de vingt-quatre mille hommes.
verses.am: ለአራተኛው ወር አራተኛው አለቃ የኢዮአብ ወንድም አሣሄል፥ ከእርሱም በኋላ ልጁ ዝባድያ ነበረ፤ በእርሱም ክፍል ሀያ አራት ሺህ ጭፍራ ነበር።

verses.en: The fifth captain for the fifth month was Shamhuth the Izrahite: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.fr: Le cinquième, pour le cinquième mois, était le chef Schamehuth, le Jizrachite; et il avait une division de vingt-quatre mille hommes.
verses.am: ለአምስተኛው ወር አምስተኛው አለቃ ይዝራዊው ሸምሁት ነበረ፤ በእርሱም ክፍል ሀያ አራት ሺህ ጭፍራ ነበረ።

verses.en: The sixth captain for the sixth month was Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.fr: Le sixième, pour le sixième mois, était Ira, fils d''Ikkesch, le Tekoïte; et il avait une division de vingt-quatre mille hommes.
verses.am: ለስድስተኛው ወር ስድስተኛው አለቃ የቴቁሐዊው የዒስካ ልጅ ዒራስ ነበረ፤ በእርሱም ክፍል ሀያ አራት ሺህ ጭፍራ ነበረ።

verses.en: The seventh captain for the seventh month was Helez the Pelonite, of the children of Ephraim: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.fr: Le septième, pour le septième mois, était Hélets, le Pelonite, des fils d''Ephraïm; et il avait une division de vingt-quatre mille hommes.
verses.am: ለሰባተኛው ወር ሰባተኛው አለቃ ከኤፍሬም ልጆች የሆነ ፍሎናዊው ሴሌስ ነበረ፤ በእርሱም ክፍል ሀያ አራት ሺህ ጭፍራ ነበረ።

verses.en: The eighth captain for the eighth month was Sibbecai the Hushathite, of the Zarhites: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.fr: Le huitième, pour le huitième mois, était Sibbecaï, le Huschatite, de la famille des Zérachites; et il avait une division de vingt-quatre mille hommes.
verses.am: ለስምንተኛው ወር ስምንተኛው አለቃ ከዛራውያን የነበረው ኩሳታዊው ሲቦካይ ነበረ፤ በእርሱም ክፍል ሀያ አራት ሺህ ጭፍራ ነበረ።

verses.en: The ninth captain for the ninth month was Abiezer the Anetothite, of the Benjamites: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.fr: Le neuvième, pour le neuvième mois, était Abiézer, d''Anathoth, des Benjamites; et il avait une division de vingt-quatre mille hommes.
verses.am: ለዘጠኝኛው ወር ዘጠኝኛው አለቃ ከብንያማውያን የነበረው ዓናቶታዊው አቢዔዜር ነበረ፤ በእርሱም ክፍል ሀያ አራት ሺህ ጭፍራ ነበረ።

verses.en: The tenth captain for the tenth month was Maharai the Netophathite, of the Zarhites: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.fr: Le dixième, pour le dixième mois, était Maharaï, de Nethopha, de la famille des Zérachites; et il avait une division de vingt-quatre mille hommes.
verses.am: ለአሥረኛው ወር አሥረኛው አለቃ ከዛራውያን የነበረው ነጦፋዊው ኖኤሬ ነበረ፤ በእርሱም ክፍል ሀያ አራት ሺህ ጭፍራ ነበረ።

verses.en: The eleventh captain for the eleventh month was Benaiah the Pirathonite, of the children of Ephraim: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.fr: Le onzième, pour le onzième mois, était Benaja, de Pirathon, des fils d''Ephraïm; et il avait une division de vingt-quatre mille hommes.
verses.am: ለአሥራ አንደኛው ወር አሥራ አንደኛው አለቃ ከኤፍሬም ልጆች የነበረው ጲርዓቶናዊው በናያስ ነበረ፤ በእርሱም ክፍል ሀያ አራት ሺህ ጭፍራ ነበረ።

verses.en: The twelfth captain for the twelfth month was Heldai the Netophathite, of Othniel: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.fr: Le douzième, pour le douzième mois, était Heldaï, de Nethopha, de la famille d''Othniel; et il avait une division de vingt-quatre mille hommes.
verses.am: ለአሥራ ሁለተኛው ወር አሥራ ሁለተኛው አለቃ ከጎቶንያል ወገን የነበረው ነጦፋዊው ሔልዳይ ነበረ፤ በእርሱም ክፍል ሀያ አራት ሺህ ጭፍራ ነበረ።

verses.en: Furthermore over the tribes of Israel: the ruler of the Reubenites was Eliezer the son of Zichri: of the Simeonites, Shephatiah the son of Maachah:
verses.fr: Voici les chefs des tribus d''Israël. Chef des Rubénites: Eliézer, fils de Zicri; des Siméonites: Schephathia, fils de Maaca;
verses.am: በእስራኤልም ነገዶች ላይ እነዚህ ነበሩ በሮቤላውያን ላይ የዝክሪ ልጅ አልዓዛር አለቃ ነበረ፤ በስምዖናውያን የመዓካ ልጅ ሰፋጥያስ፤

verses.en: Of the Levites, Hashabiah the son of Kemuel: of the Aaronites, Zadok:
verses.fr: des Lévites: Haschabia, fils de Kemuel; de la famille d''Aaron: Tsadok;
verses.am: በሌዊ ላይ የቀሙኤል ልጅ ሐሸቢያ፤

verses.en: Of Judah, Elihu, one of the brethren of David: of Issachar, Omri the son of Michael:
verses.fr: de Juda: Elihu, des frères de David; d''Issacar: Omri, fils de Micaël;
verses.am: በአሮን ላይ ሳዶቅ፤ በይሁዳ ላይ ከዳዊት ወንድሞች ኤሊሁ፤ በይሳኮር ላይ የሚካኤል ልጅ ዖምሪ፤

verses.en: Of Zebulun, Ishmaiah the son of Obadiah: of Naphtali, Jerimoth the son of Azriel:
verses.fr: de Zabulon: Jischemaeja, fils d''Abdias; de Nephthali: Jerimoth, fils d''Azriel;
verses.am: በዛብሎን ላይ የአብድዩ ልጅ ይሽማያ፤ በንፍታሌም ላይ የዓዝሪኤል ልጅ ኢያሪሙት፤

verses.en: Of the children of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Azaziah: of the half tribe of Manasseh, Joel the son of Pedaiah:
verses.fr: des fils d''Ephraïm: Hosée, fils d''Azazia; de la demi-tribu de Manassé: Joël, fils de Pedaja;
verses.am: በኤፍሬም ልጆች ላይ የዓዛዝያ ልጅ ሆሴዕ፤ በምናሴ ነገድ እኵሌታ ላይ የፈዳያ ልጅ ኢዩኤል፤

verses.en: Of the half tribe of Manasseh in Gilead, Iddo the son of Zechariah: of Benjamin, Jaasiel the son of Abner:
verses.fr: de la demi-tribu de Manassé en Galaad: Jiddo, fils de Zacharie; de Benjamin: Jaasiel, fils d''Abner;
verses.am: በገለዓድ ባለው በምናሴ ነገድ እኵሌታ ላይ የዘካርያስ ልጅ አዶ፤ በብንያም ላይ የአበኔር ልጅ የዕሢኤል፤

verses.en: Of Dan, Azareel the son of Jeroham. These were the princes of the tribes of Israel.
verses.fr: de Dan: Azareel, fils de Jerocham. Ce sont là les chefs des tribus d''Israël.
verses.am: በዳን ላይ የይሮሐም ልጅ ዓዛርኤል፤ እነዚህ የእስራኤል ልጆች ነገዶች አለቆች ነበሩ።

verses.en: But David took not the number of them from twenty years old and under: because the Lord had said he would increase Israel like to the stars of the heavens.
verses.fr: David ne fit point le dénombrement de ceux d''Israël qui étaient âgés de vingt ans et au-dessous, car l''Eternel avait promis de multiplier Israël comme les étoiles du ciel.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ግን እስራኤልን እንደ ሰማይ ከዋክብት ያበዛ ዘንድ ተናግሮ ነበርና ዳዊት ከሀያ ዓመት በታች የነበሩትን አልቈጠረም።

verses.en: Joab the son of Zeruiah began to number, but he finished not, because there fell wrath for it against Israel; neither was the number put in the account of the chronicles of king David.
verses.fr: Joab, fils de Tseruja, avait commencé le dénombrement, mais il ne l''acheva pas, l''Eternel s''étant irrité contre Israël à cause de ce dénombrement, qui ne fut point porté parmi ceux des Chroniques du roi David.
verses.am: የጽሩያ ልጅ ኢዮአብ መቍጠር ጀመረ፥ ነገር ግን አልፈጸመም፤ ስለዚህም በእስራኤል ላይ ቍጣ ሆነ፥ ቍጥራቸውም በንጉሡ በዳዊት መዝገብ አልተጻፈም።

verses.en: And over the king's treasures was Azmaveth the son of Adiel: and over the storehouses in the fields, in the cities, and in the villages, and in the castles, was Jehonathan the son of Uzziah:
verses.fr: Azmaveth, fils d''Adiel, était préposé sur les trésors du roi; Jonathan, fils d''Ozias, sur les provisions dans les champs, les villes, les villages et les tours;
verses.am: በንጉሡም ቤተ መዛግብት ላይ የዓዲኤል ልጅ ዓዝሞት ሹም ነበረ፤ በሜዳውም በከተሞችም በመንደሮችም በግንቦችም ቤተ መዛግብት ላይ የዖዝያ ልጅ ዮናታን ሹም ነበረ፤

verses.en: And over them that did the work of the field for tillage of the ground was Ezri the son of Chelub:
verses.fr: Ezri, fils de Kelub, sur les ouvriers de la campagne qui cultivaient la terre;
verses.am: መሬቱን የሚያበጃጁትና እርሻውን በሚያርሱት ላይ የክሉብ ልጅ ዔዝሪ ሹም ነበረ፤

verses.en: And over the vineyards was Shimei the Ramathite: over the increase of the vineyards for the wine cellars was Zabdi the Shiphmite:
verses.fr: Schimeï, de Rama, sur les vignes; Zabdi, de Schepham, sur les provisions de vin dans les vignes;
verses.am: በወይንም ቦታዎች ላይ ራማታዊው ሰሜኢ ሹም ነበረ፤ ለወይንም ጠጅ ዕቃ ቤት በሚሆነው በወይኑ ሰብል ላይ ሸፋማዊው ዘብዲ ሹም ነበረ፤

verses.en: And over the olive trees and the sycomore trees that were in the low plains was Baalhanan the Gederite: and over the cellars of oil was Joash:
verses.fr: Baal-Hanan, de Guéder, sur les oliviers et les sycomores dans la plaine; Joasch, sur les provisions d''huile;
verses.am: በቈላውም ውስጥ ባሉት በወይራውና በሾላው ዛፎች ላይ ጌድራዊው በአልሐናን ሹም ነበረ፤ በዘይቱም ቤቶች ላይ ኢዮአስ ሹም ነበረ፤

verses.en: And over the herds that fed in Sharon was Shitrai the Sharonite: and over the herds that were in the valleys was Shaphat the son of Adlai:
verses.fr: Schithraï, de Saron, sur les boeufs qui paissaient en Saron; Schaphath, fils d''Adlaï, sur les boeufs dans les vallées;
verses.am: በሳሮንም በሚሰማሩ ከብቶች ላይ ሳሮናዊው ሰጥራይ ሹም ነበረ፤ በሸለቆቹም ውስጥ በነበሩት ከብቶች ላይ የዓድላይ ልጅ ሻፍጥ ሹም ነበረ፤

verses.en: Over the camels also was Obil the Ishmaelite: and over the asses was Jehdeiah the Meronothite:
verses.fr: Obil, l''Ismaélite, sur les chameaux; Jechdia, de Méronoth, sur les ânesses;
verses.am: በግመሎችም ላይ እስማኤላዊው ኡቢያስ ሹም ነበረ፤ በአህዮቹም ላይ ሜሮኖታዊው ይሕድያ ሹም ነበረ፤

verses.en: And over the flocks was Jaziz the Hagerite. All these were the rulers of the substance which was king David's.
verses.fr: Jaziz, l''Hagarénien, sur les brebis. Tous ceux-là étaient intendants des biens du roi David.
verses.am: በመንጎቹም ላይ አጋራዊው ያዚዝ ሹም ነበረ። እነዚህ ሁሉ በንጉሡ በዳዊት ሀብት ላይ ሹሞች ነበሩ።

verses.en: Also Jonathan David's uncle was a counsellor, a wise man, and a scribe: and Jehiel the son of Hachmoni was with the king's sons:
verses.fr: Jonathan, oncle de David, était conseiller, homme de sens et de savoir; Jehiel, fils de Hacmoni, était auprès des fils du roi;
verses.am: አስተዋይና ጸሐፊ የነበረው የዳዊት አጎት ዮናታን አማካሪ ነበረ፤ የሐክሞኒም ልጅ ይሒኤል ከንጉሡ ልጆች ጋር ነበረ፤

verses.en: And Ahithophel was the king's counsellor: and Hushai the Archite was the king's companion:
verses.fr: Achitophel était conseiller du roi; Huschaï, l''Arkien, était ami du roi;
verses.am: አኪጦፌልም የንጉሡ አማካሪ ነበረ፤ አርካዊውም ኩሲ የንጉሡ ወዳጅ ነበረ፤

verses.en: And after Ahithophel was Jehoiada the son of Benaiah, and Abiathar: and the general of the king's army was Joab.
verses.fr: après Achitophel, Jehojada, fils de Benaja, et Abiathar, furent conseillers; Joab était chef de l''armée du roi.
verses.am: ከአኪጦፌልም ቀጥሎ የበናያስ ልጅ ዮዳሄና አብያታር ነበሩ፤ ኢዮአብም የንጉሡ ሠራዊት አለቃ ነበረ።

verses.en: And David assembled all the princes of Israel, the princes of the tribes, and the captains of the companies that ministered to the king by course, and the captains over the thousands, and captains over the hundreds, and the stewards over all the substance and possession of the king, and of his sons, with the officers, and with the mighty men, and with all the valiant men, unto Jerusalem.
verses.fr: David convoqua à Jérusalem tous les chefs d''Israël, les chefs des tribus, les chefs des divisions au service du roi, les chefs de milliers et les chefs de centaines, ceux qui étaient en charge sur tous les biens et les troupeaux du roi et auprès de ses fils, les eunuques, les héros et tous les hommes vaillants.
verses.am: ዳዊትም የእስራኤልን አለቆች ሁሉ፥ የነገዶቹንም አለቆች፥ ንጉሡንም በክፍል የሚያገለግሉትን የጭፍሮች አለቆች፥ ሻለቆቹንም፥ የመቶ አለቆችንም፥ በንጉሥና በልጆች ሀብትና ግዛት ላይ የተሾሙትን፥ ጃንደረቦችንም፥ ጽኑዓን ኃይላኑንም ሁሉ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ሰበሰበ።

verses.en: Then David the king stood up upon his feet, and said, Hear me, my brethren, and my people: As for me, I had in mine heart to build an house of rest for the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and for the footstool of our God, and had made ready for the building:
verses.fr: Le roi David se leva sur ses pieds, et dit: Ecoutez-moi, mes frères et mon peuple! J''avais l''intention de bâtir une maison de repos pour l''arche de l''alliance de l''Eternel et pour le marchepied de notre Dieu, et je me préparais à bâtir.
verses.am: ንጉሡም ዳዊት በእግሩ ቆሞ እንዲህ አለ። ወንድሞቼና ሕዝቤ ሆይ፥ ስሙኝ፤ ለእግዚአብሔር ለቃል ኪዳኑ ታቦትና ለአምላካችን እግር ማረፊያ የዕረፍት ቤት ለመሥራት እኔ በልቤ አስቤአለሁ፤ ለሥራም የሚያስፈልገውን አዘጋጅቻለሁ፤

verses.en: But God said unto me, Thou shalt not build an house for my name, because thou hast been a man of war, and hast shed blood.
verses.fr: Mais Dieu m''a dit: Tu ne bâtiras pas une maison à mon nom, car tu es un homme de guerre et tu as versé du sang.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ግን። የሰልፍ ሰው ነህና፥ ደምም አፍስሰሃልና ለስሜ ቤት አትሠራም ብሎኛል።

verses.en: Howbeit the Lord God of Israel chose me before all the house of my father to be king over Israel for ever: for he hath chosen Judah to be the ruler; and of the house of Judah, the house of my father; and among the sons of my father he liked me to make me king over all Israel:
verses.fr: L''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël, m''a choisi dans toute la maison de mon père, pour que je fusse roi d''Israël à toujours; car il a choisi Juda pour chef, il a choisi la maison de mon père dans la maison de Juda, et parmi les fils de mon père c''est moi qu''il a voulu faire régner sur tout Israël.
verses.am: ነገር ግን የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር በእስራኤል ላይ የዘላለም ንጉሥ እሆን ዘንድ ከአባቴ ቤት ሁሉ መርጦኛል፤ ይሁዳም አለቃ ይሆን ዘንድ መርጦታል፤ ከይሁዳም ቤት የአባቴን ቤት መርጦአል፤ ከአባቴም ልጆች መካከል በእስራኤል ሁሉ ላይ ያነግሠኝ ዘንድ ሊመርጠኝ ወደደ።

verses.en: And of all my sons, (for the Lord hath given me many sons,) he hath chosen Solomon my son to sit upon the throne of the kingdom of the Lord over Israel.
verses.fr: Entre tous mes fils-car l''Eternel m''a donné beaucoup de fils-il a choisi mon fils Salomon pour le faire asseoir sur le trône du royaume de l''Eternel, sur Israël.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ብዙ ልጆች ሰጥቶኛልና ከልጆቼ ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት ዙፋን ላይ ተቀምጦ በእስራኤል ላይ ይነግሥ ዘንድ ልጄን ሰሎሞንን መርጦታል።

verses.en: And he said unto me, Solomon thy son, he shall build my house and my courts: for I have chosen him to be my son, and I will be his father.
verses.fr: Il m''a dit: Salomon, ton fils, bâtira ma maison et mes parvis; car je l''ai choisi pour mon fils, et je serai pour lui un père.
verses.am: እርሱም። ልጅ ይሆነኝ ዘንድ መርጬዋለሁና፥ እኔም አባት እሆነዋለሁና ልጅህ ሰሎሞን ቤቴንና አደባባዮቼን ይሠራል።

verses.en: Moreover I will establish his kingdom for ever, if he be constant to do my commandments and my judgments, as at this day.
verses.fr: J''affermirai pour toujours son royaume, s''il reste attaché comme aujourd''hui à la pratique de mes commandements et de mes ordonnances.
verses.am: ትእዛዜንና ፈርዴንም በማድረግ እንደ ዛሬው ቢጸና መንግሥቱን ለዘላለም አጸናዋለሁ አለኝ።

verses.en: Now therefore in the sight of all Israel the congregation of the Lord, and in the audience of our God, keep and seek for all the commandments of the Lord your God: that ye may possess this good land, and leave it for an inheritance for your children after you for ever.
verses.fr: Maintenant, aux yeux de tout Israël, de l''assemblée de l''Eternel, et en présence de notre Dieu qui vous entend, observez et prenez à coeur tous les commandements de l''Eternel, votre Dieu, afin que vous possédiez ce bon pays et que vous le laissiez en héritage à vos fils après vous à perpétuité.
verses.am: አሁንም የእግዚአብሔር ጉባኤ እስራኤል ሁሉ እያዩ፥ አምላካችንም እየሰማ፥ ይህችን መልካሚቱን ምድር ትወርሱ ዘንድ፥ ለልጆቻችሁም ለዘላለም ታወርሱአት ዘንድ የአምላካችሁን የእግዚአብሔርን ትእዛዝ ሁሉ ጠብቁ፥ ፈልጉም።

verses.en: And thou, Solomon my son, know thou the God of thy father, and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind: for the Lord searcheth all hearts, and understandeth all the imaginations of the thoughts: if thou seek him, he will be found of thee; but if thou forsake him, he will cast thee off for ever.
verses.fr: Et toi, Salomon, mon fils, connais le Dieu de ton père, et sers-le d''un coeur dévoué et d''une âme bien disposée, car l''Eternel sonde tous les coeurs et pénètre tous les desseins et toutes les pensées. Si tu le cherches, il se laissera trouver par toi; mais si tu l''abandonnes, il te rejettera pour toujours.
verses.am: አንተም፥ ልጄ ሰሎሞን ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔር ልብን ሁሉ ይመረምራልና፥ የነፍስንም አሳብ ሁሉ ያውቃልና፥ የአባትህን አምላክ እወቅ፤ በፍጹም ልብና በነፍስህ ፈቃድም አምልከው፤ ብትፈልገው ታገኘዋለህ፤ ብትተወው ግን ለዘላለም ይጥልሃል።

verses.en: Take heed now; for the Lord hath chosen thee to build an house for the sanctuary: be strong, and do it.
verses.fr: Considère maintenant que l''Eternel t''a choisi, afin que tu bâtisses une maison qui serve de sanctuaire. Fortifie-toi et agis.
verses.am: አሁንም፥ እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔር ለመቅደስ የሚሆን ቤትን ትሠራ ዘንድ መርጦሃልና ጠንክረህ ፈጽመው።

verses.en: Then David gave to Solomon his son the pattern of the porch, and of the houses thereof, and of the treasuries thereof, and of the upper chambers thereof, and of the inner parlours thereof, and of the place of the mercy seat,
verses.fr: David donna à Salomon, son fils, le modèle du portique et des bâtiments, des chambres du trésor, des chambres hautes, des chambres intérieures, et de la chambre du propitiatoire.
verses.am: ዳዊትም ለመቅደሱ ወለል፥ ለቤቱም፥ ለቤተ መዛግብቱም፥ ለደርቡና ለውስጡም ጓዳዎች፥ ለስርየቱም መክደኛ መቀመጫ ምሳሌውን ለልጁ ለሰሎሞን ሰጠው።

verses.en: And the pattern of all that he had by the spirit, of the courts of the house of the Lord, and of all the chambers round about, of the treasuries of the house of God, and of the treasuries of the dedicated things:
verses.fr: Il lui donna le plan de tout ce qu''il avait dans l''esprit touchant les parvis de la maison de l''Eternel, et toutes les chambres à l''entour pour les trésors de la maison de Dieu et les trésors du sanctuaire,
verses.am: ደግሞም ለእግዚአብሔር ቤት አደባባዮችና በዙርያው ለሚሆኑ ጓዳዎች፥ ለእግዚአብሔርም ቤት ለሚሆኑ ቤተ መዛግብት፥ ለንዋየ ቅድሳቱም ለሚሆኑ ቤተ መዛግብት በመንፈሱ ላሰበው ሁሉ ምሳሌን ሰጠው።

verses.en: Also for the courses of the priests and the Levites, and for all the work of the service of the house of the Lord, and for all the vessels of service in the house of the Lord.
verses.fr: et touchant les classes des sacrificateurs et des Lévites, tout ce qui concernait le service de la maison de l''Eternel, et tous les ustensiles pour le service de la maison de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ለወርቁም መቅረዞችና ለቀንዲሎችም ወርቁን በየመቅረዙና በየቀንዲሉ በሚዛን ሰጠው፤ ለብሩን መቅረዞች እንደ መቅረዙ ሁሉ ሥራ ሁሉ ብሩን በየመቅረዙና በየቀንዲሉ በሚዛን ሰጠው፤

verses.en: He gave of gold by weight for things of gold, for all instruments of all manner of service; silver also for all instruments of silver by weight, for all instruments of every kind of service:
verses.fr: Il lui donna le modèle des ustensiles d''or, avec le poids de ce qui devait être d''or, pour tous les ustensiles de chaque service; et le modèle de tous les ustensiles d''argent, avec le poids, pour tous les ustensiles de chaque service.
verses.am: ለወርቁም መቅረዞችና ለቀንዲሎችም ወርቁን በየመቅረዙና በየቀንዲሉ በሚዛን ሰጠው፤ ለብሩን መቅረዞች እንደ መቅረዙ ሁሉ ሥራ ሁሉ ብሩን በየመቅረዙና በየቀንዲሉ በሚዛን ሰጠው፤

verses.en: Even the weight for the candlesticks of gold, and for their lamps of gold, by weight for every candlestick, and for the lamps thereof: and for the candlesticks of silver by weight, both for the candlestick, and also for the lamps thereof, according to the use of every candlestick.
verses.fr: Il donna le poids des chandeliers d''or et de leurs lampes d''or, avec le poids de chaque chandelier et de ses lampes; et le poids des chandeliers d''argent, avec le poids de chaque chandelier et de ses lampes, selon l''usage de chaque chandelier.
verses.am: ለገጹ ኅብስት ገበታዎች ወርቁን በሚዛን ለገበታዎቹ ሁሉ፥ ብሩንም ለብሩ ገበታዎች ሰጠው፤

verses.en: And by weight he gave gold for the tables of shewbread, for every table; and likewise silver for the tables of silver:
verses.fr: Il lui donna l''or au poids pour les tables des pains de proposition, pour chaque table; et de l''argent pour les tables d''argent.
verses.am: ለሜንጦቹና ለድስቶቹ ለመቅጃዎቹም ጥሩውን ወርቅ፥ ለወርቁም ጽዋዎች ወርቁን በየጽዋው ሁሉ በሚዛን፥ ለብሩም ጽዋዎች ብሩን በየጽዋው ሁሉ በሚዛን ሰጠው፤

verses.en: Also pure gold for the fleshhooks, and the bowls, and the cups: and for the golden basons he gave gold by weight for every bason; and likewise silver by weight for every bason of silver:
verses.fr: Il lui donna le modèle des fourchettes, des bassins et des calices d''or pur; le modèle des coupes d''or, avec le poids de chaque coupe, et des coupes d''argent, avec le poids de chaque coupe;
verses.am: ለዕጣኑም መሠዊዋ ጥሩውን ወርቅ በሚዛን፥ ክንፎቻቸውንም ዘርግተው የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ኪዳን ታቦት የሸፈኑትን የኪሩቤልን የወርቅ ሰረገላ ምሳሌ ሰጠው።

verses.en: And for the altar of incense refined gold by weight; and gold for the pattern of the chariot of the cherubims, that spread out their wings, and covered the ark of the covenant of the Lord.
verses.fr: et le modèle de l''autel des parfums en or épuré, avec le poids. Il lui donna encore le modèle du char, des chérubins d''or qui étendent leurs ailes et couvrent l''arche de l''alliance de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ዳዊትም። የሥራውን ሁሉ ምሳሌ አውቅ ዘንድ ይህ ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር እጅ ተጽፎ መጣልኝ አለ።

verses.en: All this, said David, the Lord made me understand in writing by his hand upon me, even all the works of this pattern.
verses.fr: C''est par un écrit de sa main, dit David, que l''Eternel m''a donné l''intelligence de tout cela, de tous les ouvrages de ce modèle.
verses.am: ዳዊትም ልጁን ሰሎሞንን። ጠንክር፥ አይዞህ፥ አድርገውም፤ አምላኬ እግዚአብሔር አምላክ ከአንተ ጋር ነውና አትፍራ፥ አትደንግጥም፤ ለእግዚአብሔርም ቤት አገልግሎት የሚሆነው ሥራ ሁሉ እስኪፈጸም ድረስ እርሱ አይተውህም፥ አይጥልህምም።

verses.en: And David said to Solomon his son, Be strong and of good courage, and do it: fear not, nor be dismayed: for the Lord God, even my God, will be with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee, until thou hast finished all the work for the service of the house of the Lord.
verses.fr: David dit à Salomon, son fils: Fortifie-toi, prends courage et agis; ne crains point, et ne t''effraie point. Car l''Eternel Dieu, mon Dieu, sera avec toi; il ne te délaissera point, il ne t''abandonnera point, jusqu''à ce que tout l''ouvrage pour le service de la maison de l''Eternel soit achevé.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ ለእግዚአብሔር ቤት አገልግሎት ሁሉ የሚሆኑ የካህናትና የሌዋውያን ክፍሎች በዚህ አሉ፤ ለሁሉም ዓይነት አገልግሎትና ሥር በብልሃትና በነፍሱ ፈቃድ የሚሠራ ሁሉ ከአንተ ጋር ይሆናል፤ አለቆችና ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ፈጽመው ይታዘዙሃል አለው።

verses.en: And, behold, the courses of the priests and the Levites, even they shall be with thee for all the service of the house of God: and there shall be with thee for all manner of workmanship every willing skilful man, for any manner of service: also the princes and all the people will be wholly at thy commandment.
verses.fr: Voici les classes des sacrificateurs et des Lévites pour tout le service de la maison de Dieu; et voici près de toi, pour toute l''oeuvre, tous les hommes bien disposés et habiles dans toute espèce d''ouvrages, et les chefs et tout le peuple dociles à tous tes ordres.
verses.am: ፤ እነሆም፥ ለእግዚአብሔር ቤት አገልግሎት ሁሉ የሚሆኑ የካህናትና የሌዋውያን ክፍሎች በዚህ አሉ፤ ለሁሉም ዓይነት አገልግሎትና ሥር በብልሃትና በነፍሱ ፈቃድ የሚሠራ ሁሉ ከአንተ ጋር ይሆናል፤ አለቆችና ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ፈጽመው ይታዘዙሃል አለው።

verses.en: Furthermore David the king said unto all the congregation, Solomon my son, whom alone God hath chosen, is yet young and tender, and the work is great: for the palace is not for man, but for the Lord God.
verses.fr: Le roi David dit à toute l''assemblée: Mon fils Salomon, le seul que Dieu ait choisi, est jeune et d''un âge faible, et l''ouvrage est considérable, car ce palais n''est pas pour un homme, mais il est pour l''Eternel Dieu.
verses.am: ንጉሡም ዳዊት ለጉባኤው ሁሉ እንዲህ አለ። እግዚአብሔር ብቻውን የመረጠው ልጄ ሰሎሞን ገና ብላቴና ለጋ ነው፤ ሕንፃው ግን ለእግዚአብሔር ለአምላክ ነው እንጂ ለሰው አይደለምና ሥራው ታላቅ ነው።

verses.en: Now I have prepared with all my might for the house of my God the gold for things to be made of gold, and the silver for things of silver, and the brass for things of brass, the iron for things of iron, and wood for things of wood; onyx stones, and stones to be set, glistering stones, and of divers colours, and all manner of precious stones, and marble stones in abundance.
verses.fr: J''ai mis toutes mes forces à préparer pour la maison de mon Dieu de l''or pour ce qui doit être d''or, de l''argent pour ce qui doit être d''argent, de l''airain pour ce qui doit être d''airain, du fer pour ce qui doit être de fer, et du bois pour ce qui doit être de bois, des pierres d''onyx et des pierres à enchâsser, des pierres brillantes et de diverses couleurs, toutes sortes de pierres précieuses, et du marbre blanc en quantité.
verses.am: እኔም እንደ ጕልበቴ ሁሉ ለአምላኬ ቤት ለወርቁ ዕቃ ወርቁን፥ ለብሩም ዕቃ ብሩን፥ ለናሱም ዕቃ ናሱን፥ ለብረቱም ዕቃ ብረቱን፥ ለእንጨቱም ዕቃ እንጨቱን፥ ደግሞም መረግድንና በፈርጥ የሚገባ ድንጋይን፥ የሚለጠፍ ድንጋይን፥ ልዩ ልዩ መልክ ያለውንም ድንጋይ፥ የከበረውንም ድንጋይ ከየዓይነቱ፥ ብዙም እብነ በረድ አዘጋጅቻለሁ።

verses.en: Moreover, because I have set my affection to the house of my God, I have of mine own proper good, of gold and silver, which I have given to the house of my God, over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house.
verses.fr: De plus, dans mon attachement pour la maison de mon Dieu, je donne à la maison de mon Dieu l''or et l''argent que je possède en propre, outre tout ce que j''ai préparé pour la maison du sanctuaire:
verses.am: ከዚህም በላይ ደግሞ የአምላኬን ቤት ስለወደድሁ፥ ለመቅደሱ ካዘጋጀሁት ሁሉ ሌላ የግል ገንዘቤ የሚሆን ወርቅና ብር አለኝና ለአምላኬ ቤት ሰጥቼዋለሁ።

verses.en: Even three thousand talents of gold, of the gold of Ophir, and seven thousand talents of refined silver, to overlay the walls of the houses withal:
verses.fr: trois mille talents d''or, d''or d''Ophir, et sept mille talents d''argent épuré, pour en revêtir les parois des bâtiments,
verses.am: የቤቶቹ ግንብ ይለበጡበት ዘንድ ከኦፊር ወርቅ ሦስት ሺህ መክሊት ወርቅ፥ ሰባት ሺህም መክሊት ጥሩ ብር፥

verses.en: The gold for things of gold, and the silver for things of silver, and for all manner of work to be made by the hands of artificers. And who then is willing to consecrate his service this day unto the Lord?
verses.fr: l''or pour ce qui doit être d''or, et l''argent pour ce qui doit être d''argent, et pour tous les travaux qu''exécuteront les ouvriers. Qui veut encore présenter volontairement aujourd''hui ses offrandes à l''Eternel?
verses.am: በሠራተኞች እጅ ለሚሠራው ሥራ ሁሉ ለወርቁ ዕቃ ወርቁን፥ ለብሩም ዕቃ ብሩን ሰጥቻለሁ። ዛሬ በፈቃዱ ራሱን ለእግዚአብሔር የሚቀድስ ማነው?

verses.en: Then the chief of the fathers and princes of the tribes of Israel and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, with the rulers of the king's work, offered willingly,
verses.fr: Les chefs des maisons paternelles, les chefs des tribus d''Israël, les chefs de milliers et de centaines, et les intendants du roi firent volontairement des offrandes.
verses.am: የአባቶችም ቤቶች አለቆች፥ የእስራኤልም ነገዶች አለቆች፥ ሻለቆችም፥ የመቶ አለቆችም፥ በንጉሡም ሥራ ላይ የተሾሙት በፈቃዳቸው አቀረቡ።

verses.en: And gave for the service of the house of God of gold five thousand talents and ten thousand drams, and of silver ten thousand talents, and of brass eighteen thousand talents, and one hundred thousand talents of iron.
verses.fr: Ils donnèrent pour le service de la maison de Dieu cinq mille talents d''or, dix mille dariques, dix mille talents d''argent, dix-huit mille talents d''airain, et cent mille talents de fer.
verses.am: ለእግዚአብሔርም ቤት አገልግሎት አምስት ሺህ መክሊት ወርቅና አሥር ሺህ ዳሪክ፥ አሥር ሺህም መክሊት ብር፥ አሥራ ስምንት ሺህም መክሊት ናስ፥ መቶ ሺህም መክሊት ብረት ሰጡ።

verses.en: And they with whom precious stones were found gave them to the treasure of the house of the Lord, by the hand of Jehiel the Gershonite.
verses.fr: Ceux qui possédaient des pierres les livrèrent pour le trésor de la maison de l''Eternel entre les mains de Jehiel, le Guerschonite.
verses.am: ዕንቍም ያለው ሰው ሁሉ ለእግዚአብሔር ቤት ለሆነው ቤተ መዛግብት በጌድሶናዊው በይሒኤል እጅ ሰጠ።

verses.en: Then the people rejoiced, for that they offered willingly, because with perfect heart they offered willingly to the Lord: and David the king also rejoiced with great joy.
verses.fr: Le peuple se réjouit de leurs offrandes volontaires, car c''était avec un coeur bien disposé qu''ils les faisaient à l''Eternel; et le roi David en eut aussi une grande joie.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ፈቅደው ሰጥተዋልና፥ በፍጹም ልባቸውም ለእግዚአብሔር በፈቃዳቸው አቅርበዋልና ደስ አላቸው፤ ንጉሡም ዳዊት ደግሞ ታላቅ ደስታ ደስ አለው።

verses.en: Wherefore David blessed the Lord before all the congregation: and David said, Blessed be thou, Lord God of Israel our father, for ever and ever.
verses.fr: David bénit l''Eternel en présence de toute l''assemblée. Il dit: Béni sois-tu, d''éternité en éternité, Eternel, Dieu de notre père Israël.
verses.am: ዳዊትም በጉባኤው ሁሉ ፊት እግዚአብሔርን ባረከ፤ ዳዊትም አለ። አቤቱ፥ የአባታችን የእስራኤል አምላክ ሆይ፥ ከዘላለም እስከ ዘላለም ተባረክ።

verses.en: Thine, O Lord is the greatness, and the power, and the glory, and the victory, and the majesty: for all that is in the heaven and in the earth is thine; thine is the kingdom, O Lord, and thou art exalted as head above all.
verses.fr: A toi, Eternel, la grandeur, la force et la magnificence, l''éternité et la gloire, car tout ce qui est au ciel et sur la terre t''appartient; à toi, Eternel, le règne, car tu t''élèves souverainement au-dessus de tout!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ በሰማይና በምድር ያለው ሁሉ የአንተ ነውና ታላቅነትና ኃይል፥ ክብርም፥ ድልና ግርማ ለአንተ ነው፤ አቤቱ፥ መንግሥት የአንተ ነው፥ አንተም በሁሉ ላይ ከፍ ከፍ ያልህ ራስ ነህ።

verses.en: Both riches and honour come of thee, and thou reignest over all; and in thine hand is power and might; and in thine hand it is to make great, and to give strength unto all.
verses.fr: C''est de toi que viennent la richesse et la gloire, c''est toi qui domines sur tout, c''est dans ta main que sont la force et la puissance, et c''est ta main qui a le pouvoir d''agrandir et d''affermir toutes choses.
verses.am: ባለጠግነትና ክብር ከአንተ ዘንድ ነው፥ አንተም ሁሉን ትገዛለህ፤ ኃይልና ብርታት በእጅህ ነው፤ ታላቅ ለማድረግ፥ ለሁሉም ኃይልን ለመስጠት በእጅህ ነው።

verses.en: Now therefore, our God, we thank thee, and praise thy glorious name.
verses.fr: Maintenant, ô notre Dieu, nous te louons, et nous célébrons ton nom glorieux.
verses.am: አሁንም እንግዲህ፥ አምላካችን ሆይ፥ እንገዛልሃለን፥ ለክቡር ስምህም ምስጋና እናቀርባለን።

verses.en: But who am I, and what is my people, that we should be able to offer so willingly after this sort? for all things come of thee, and of thine own have we given thee.
verses.fr: Car qui suis-je et qui est mon peuple, pour que nous puissions te faire volontairement ces offrandes? Tout vient de toi, et nous recevons de ta main ce que nous t''offrons.
verses.am: ሁሉ ከአንተ ዘንድ ነውና፥ ከእጅህም የተቀበልነውን ሰጥተንሃልና ይህን ያህል ችለን ልናቀርብልህ እኔ ማን ነኝ? ሕዝቤስ ማን ነው?

verses.en: For we are strangers before thee, and sojourners, as were all our fathers: our days on the earth are as a shadow, and there is none abiding.
verses.fr: Nous sommes devant toi des étrangers et des habitants, comme tous nos pères; nos jours sur la terre sont comme l''ombre, et il n''y a point d''espérance.
verses.am: አባቶቻችንም ሁሉ እንደነበሩ እኛ በፊትህ ስደተኞችና መጻተኞች ነን፤ ዘመናችንም በምድር ላይ እንደ ጥላ ናት፥ አትጸናም።

verses.en: O Lord our God, all this store that we have prepared to build thee an house for thine holy name cometh of thine hand, and is all thine own.
verses.fr: Eternel, notre Dieu, c''est de ta main que viennent toutes ces richesses que nous avons préparées pour te bâtir une maison, à toi, à ton saint nom, et c''est à toi que tout appartient.
verses.am: አቤቱ አምላካችን ሆይ፥ ለቅዱስ ስምህ ቤት እንሠራ ዘንድ ይህ ያዘጋጀነው ባለጠግነት ሁሉ ከእጅህ የመጣ ነው፥ ሁሉም የአንተ ነው።

verses.en: I know also, my God, that thou triest the heart, and hast pleasure in uprightness. As for me, in the uprightness of mine heart I have willingly offered all these things: and now have I seen with joy thy people, which are present here, to offer willingly unto thee.
verses.fr: Je sais, ô mon Dieu, que tu sondes le coeur, et que tu aimes la droiture; aussi je t''ai fait toutes ces offrandes volontaires dans la droiture de mon coeur, et j''ai vu maintenant avec joie ton peuple qui se trouve ici t''offrir volontairement ses dons.
verses.am: አምላኬ ሆይ፥ ልብን እንድትመረምር፥ ቅንነትንም እንድትወድድ አውቃለሁ፤ እኔም በልቤ ቅንነትና በፈቃዴ ይህን ሁሉ አቅርቤአለሁ፤ አሁንም በዚህ ያለው ሕዝብህ በፈቃዱ እንዳቀረበልህ በደስታ አይቻለሁ።

verses.en: O Lord God of Abraham, Isaac, and of Israel, our fathers, keep this for ever in the imagination of the thoughts of the heart of thy people, and prepare their heart unto thee:
verses.fr: Eternel, Dieu d''Abraham, d''Isaac et d''Israël, nos pères, maintiens à toujours dans le coeur de ton peuple ces dispositions et ces pensées, et affermis son coeur en toi.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ የአባቶቻችን የአብርሃምና የይስሐቅ የእስራኤልም አምላክ ሆይ፥ ይህን አሳብ በሕዝብህ ልብ ለዘላለም ጠብቅ፥ ልባቸውንም ወደ አንተ አቅና።

verses.en: And give unto Solomon my son a perfect heart, to keep thy commandments, thy testimonies, and thy statutes, and to do all these things, and to build the palace, for the which I have made provision.
verses.fr: Donne à mon fils Salomon un coeur dévoué à l''observation de tes commandements, de tes préceptes et de tes lois, afin qu''il mette en pratique toutes ces choses, et qu''il bâtisse le palais pour lequel j''ai fait des préparatifs.
verses.am: ትእዛዝህንም ምስክርህንም ሥርዓትህንም ይጠብቅ ዘንድ፥ ይህንም ነገር ሁሉ ያደርግ ዘንድ፥ ያዘጋጀሁለትንም ቤት ይሠራ ዘንድ ለልጄ ለሰሎሞን ፍጹም ልብ ስጠው።

verses.en: And David said to all the congregation, Now bless the Lord your God. And all the congregation blessed the Lord God of their fathers, and bowed down their heads, and worshipped the Lord, and the king.
verses.fr: David dit à toute l''assemblée: Bénissez l''Eternel, votre Dieu! Et toute l''assemblée bénit l''Eternel, le Dieu de leurs pères. Ils s''inclinèrent et se prosternèrent devant l''Eternel et devant le roi.
verses.am: ዳዊትም ጉባኤውን ሁሉ። አምላካችሁን እግዚአብሔርን ባርኩ አላቸው። ጉባኤውም ሁሉ የአባታቸውን አምላክ እግዚአብሔርን ባረኩ፥ ራሳቸውንም አዘንብለው ለእግዚአብሔርና ለንጉሡ ሰገዱ።

verses.en: And they sacrificed sacrifices unto the Lord, and offered burnt offerings unto the Lord, on the morrow after that day, even a thousand bullocks, a thousand rams, and a thousand lambs, with their drink offerings, and sacrifices in abundance for all Israel:
verses.fr: Le lendemain de ce jour, ils offrirent en sacrifice et en holocauste à l''Eternel mille taureaux, mille béliers et mille agneaux, avec les libations ordinaires, et d''autres sacrifices en grand nombre pour tout Israël.
verses.am: በነጋውም ለእግዚአብሔር መሥዋዕት ሠዉ፥ የሚቃጠለውንም መሥዋዕት ለእግዚአብሔር አቀረቡ፤ አንድ ሺህ ወይፈን፥ አንድ ሺህም አውራ በጎች፥ አንድ ሺህም የበግ ጠቦቶች፥ የመጠጥ ቍርባናቸውንም፥ ስለ እስራኤልም ሁሉ ብዙ መሥዋዕት አቀረቡ።

verses.en: And did eat and drink before the Lord on that day with great gladness. And they made Solomon the son of David king the second time, and anointed him unto the Lord to be the chief governor, and Zadok to be priest.
verses.fr: Ils mangèrent et burent ce jour-là devant l''Eternel avec une grande joie, ils proclamèrent roi pour la seconde fois Salomon, fils de David, ils l''oignirent devant l''Eternel comme chef, et ils oignirent Tsadok comme sacrificateur.
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን በታላቅ ደስታ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በሉ ጠጡም። የዳዊትንም ልጅ ሰሎሞንን ሁለተኛ ጊዜ አነገሡት፤ እርሱንም አለቃ ይሆን ዘንድ ለእግዚአብሔር ቀቡት፥ ሳዶቅንም ካህን ይሆን ዘንድ ቀቡት።

verses.en: Then Solomon sat on the throne of the Lord as king instead of David his father, and prospered; and all Israel obeyed him.
verses.fr: Salomon s''assit sur le trône de l''Eternel, comme roi à la place de David, son père. Il prospéra, et tout Israël lui obéit.
verses.am: ሰሎሞንም በአባቱ በዳዊት ዙፋን ላይ ተቀመጠ፥ ተከናወነለትም፤ እስራኤልም ሁሉ ታዘዙለት።

verses.en: And all the princes, and the mighty men, and all the sons likewise of king David, submitted themselves unto Solomon the king.
verses.fr: Tous les chefs et les héros, et même tous les fils du roi David se soumirent au roi Salomon.
verses.am: አለቆቹም ሁሉ፥ ኃያላኑም፥ ደግሞም የንጉሡ የዳዊት ልጆች ሁሉ ለንጉሡ ለሰሎሞን እጅ ሰጡት።

verses.en: And the Lord magnified Solomon exceedingly in the sight of all Israel, and bestowed upon him such royal majesty as had not been on any king before him in Israel.
verses.fr: L''Eternel éleva au plus haut degré Salomon sous les yeux de tout Israël, et il rendit son règne plus éclatant que ne fut celui d''aucun roi d''Israël avant lui.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሰሎሞንን በእስራኤል ሁሉ ፊት እጅግ አገነነው፤ ከእርሱ በፊትም ለነበሩት ለእስራኤል ነገሥታት ያልሆነውን የመንግሥት ክብር ሰጠው።

verses.en: Thus David the son of Jesse reigned over all Israel.
verses.fr: David, fils d''Isaï, régna sur tout Israël.
verses.am: የእሴይም ልጅ ዳዊት በእስራኤል ሁሉ ላይ ነገሠ።

verses.en: And the time that he reigned over Israel was forty years; seven years reigned he in Hebron, and thirty and three years reigned he in Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Le temps qu''il régna sur Israël fut de quarante ans: à Hébron il régna sept ans, et à Jérusalem il régna trente-trois ans.
verses.am: በእስራኤልም ላይ የነገሠበት ዘመን አርባ ዓመት ነበረ፤ ሰባት ዓመት በኬብሮን ነገሠ፥ ሠላሳ ሦስትም ዓመት በኢየሩሳሌም ነገሠ።

verses.en: And he died in a good old age, full of days, riches, and honour: and Solomon his son reigned in his stead.
verses.fr: Il mourut dans une heureuse vieillesse, rassasié de jours, de richesse et de gloire. Et Salomon, son fils, régna à sa place.
verses.am: ዕድሜም፥ ባለጠግነትም፥ ክብርም ጠግቦ በመልካም ሽምግልና ሞተ፤ ልጁም ሰሎሞን በእርሱ ፋንታ ነገሠ።

verses.en: Now the acts of David the king, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of Samuel the seer, and in the book of Nathan the prophet, and in the book of Gad the seer,
verses.fr: Les actions du roi David, les premières et les dernières, sont écrites dans le livre de Samuel le voyant, dans le livre de Nathan, le prophète, et dans le livre de Gad, le prophète,
verses.am: የንጉሡም የዳዊት የፊተኛውና የኋለኛው ነገር፥ እነሆ፥ በባለ ራእዩ በሳሙኤል ታሪክ፥ በነቢዩም በናታን ታሪክ፥ በባለ ራእዩም በጋድ ታሪክ ተጽፎአል።

verses.en: With all his reign and his might, and the times that went over him, and over Israel, and over all the kingdoms of the countries.
verses.fr: avec tout son règne et tous ses exploits, et ce qui s''est passé de son temps, soit en Israël, soit dans tous les royaumes des autres pays.
verses.am: እንደዚሁም የመንግሥቱ ነገርና ኃይሉ ሁሉ በእርሱም በእስራኤልም በአገሮችም መንግሥታት ሁሉ ላይ ያለፉት ዘመናት ተጽፈዋል።
